chapters.title: Chapter 2630 Eons of Change! II
paragraphs: 2630 Eons of Change! II

When the massive Courier of Senatus neared close to the Vein Rifts ahead of them, the figure of the golden-haired man flashed forward as he only took a few steps to instantly appear past the transparent barrier of a Vein Rift that held three Tier 3 Havenly Siren Beasts and their Legions behind them!

The three Havenly Beasts became stern at the appearance of this existence before them, their fishlike lower bodies smashing their tails down as their gorgeous humanoid upper bodies veered away- the Legions behind them splitting left and right as they made a path.
It was a shocking phenomenon observed by others as this was the first time that the phrase [You may gain passage so long as you are victorious] was not repeated when an existence approached!
Instead...
[The stage of power you have attained grants you free entry.]
The sonorous voice of the Havenly Siren echoed out with glory.
Beings that had exceeded Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity did not need to prove themselves.
The stage of power they had achieved was enough of a deal of approval in itself!
The gaze of the golden-haired man was placid at this development as he waved his hands behind him.
And an instant later, tens of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities surged forward and appeared behind him, seemingly ready to traverse with him into the misty fog in the distance!
Their appearance caused the expressions of the Tier 3 Havenly Sirens to turn cold as before they could say anything...
[How many?]
WAA!
He didn't ask whether they would allow it or not.
His question was so tyrannical that he already made it known that he would be coming with those behind him, and he simply asked for the limit on the number!
The gazes of the Havenly Sirens were sharp as the Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity at the very forefront spoke out for all to hear.
[An existence exceeding Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity may at most take 100 other Existences to enter with him. That is the extent their authority can cover.]
The tyranny of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities was seemingly accounted for as for them, many rules were bent!

The golden-haired personage at the very forefront nodded as he began stepping forward, 100 Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities following his path as very quickly, they disappeared into the obsidian mist as they would find themselves near the Havenly Siren Archipelagos!

Outside of the Vein Rifts, others were shocked at the new development as on the Courier of Senatus, the tan woman whose skin shone with a caramel stellar luster smiled as she also began to float towards a Vein Rift.
[Esteemed Thadeus has gone ahead as the rest of you must follow. For those who have to fight for entry...defeat is not an option!]

Her words were directed to the masses of Existences atop the Courier of Senatus, her figure stepping into a Vein Rift and coming across the same treatment as she also waved her hands to select a chosen 100 Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities that disappeared along with her into the obsidian mist!
The myriad of Inheritances and Clans watched this scene playing out with brilliant eyes as at this moment, all Vein Rifts had multiple beings seeking entry.
One of the more quiet ones held a single Temporal Field of Dissolution that pulsed at this moment, the visage of a massive Titanoboa and the Adjudicator of Dissolution stepping out of it!

The veil on the Adjudicator of Dissolution remained calm as not a shred of evidence of battle could be seen on her, with the massive Titanoboa only nodding slightly towards the Lord Commander Smilodon as even though its massive obsidian scales were just as pristine, one could sense the aura around it being turbid and unstable.
The Adjudicator of Dissolution gazed around with her Will, observing the recent developments as after a few seconds, her figure disappeared into the obsidian mist ahead!

She had made her preparations already as her main body delved into the Supernal Havens of Extremity, her Hyperversal Extremity Clone would remain in the Haven she was leaving as her role...had never ended.
Within the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
In the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago.
[How does a Havenly Boundary feel compared to the concepts you've expanded before?]
The voice of the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity Laeta rang out as Noah opened his eyes and gazed at the genuine authority of Dissolution around his body.

It had achieved the 9th Boundary Layer through Quintessence as now...his visage of Alexander would place it in his Meridians for it to enjoy the ridiculous boon of matching the highest boundary layer that Noah had achieved!
As he felt how pronounced and different it was compared to other Concepts of Extremity, his reply to Extremity Laeta was mild.
"It's so so..."

[It's so so...hmph, come. They allowed me to be the one to tell you more about the Supernal Havens of Extremity and what a being like you fits into all this before you make a decision on where to go.]
As she spoke, Hyperversal Extremity Authority erupted around to encircle their figures- both of them being taken to the depths of the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago!

Not too far from the Archipelago, in front of an endlessly massive obsidian misty wall...the figure of the Adjudicator of Dissolution just so happened to emerge at this time as the auras of many turned towards her- Noah's will also only gazing briefly before he arrived at the depths of the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago.
[Mmm, a Zenith...the big dogs are beginning to come in it seems.]
Laeta spoke with a smile as they went past groves of ancient trees and passed through a veiled barrier, the reality around them changing as they seemed to have entered the depths of the Archipelago!

The massive trees disappeared around them as they appeared in a stellar enclosed domain shining with obsidian Singularities like stars all around, with a huge cylindrical architecture made of obsidian crystals pulsing with Dissolution floating at the very center.

On this massive structure, the auras of the Hyperversal Extremities within the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago could be felt as the figures of Laeta and Noah entered one of the many floors of this grand building- Noah observing pools of golden liquified treasure light on the four ends of this floor as in the center, a long rectangular table holding a dense cluster of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity in the form of ecstatic fruits and herbs overflowed.
Thrones were laid out around this grand table as the feline figure of Laeta began to change at this moment, her visage turning curvaceous and humanoid as a black dress came to drape over her.
Dazzling inky black hair flowed to her shoulders and endlessly black pupils smiled towards Noah as she went to sit on one of the thrones around the grand table.
[Even a Zenith's will can't enter in here. Come, be comfortable.]
At her words, Noah's figure also changed to become humanoid, though his face carried distinct changes as he seemed like a sharp genius of some faction!
Laeta pursed her lips at this as she reached out to grab grapes pulsing with tendrils of Dissolution around them.
[Not your original devilishly handsome face huh...too bad. Have a seat, and let me tell you about the Supernal Havens of Extremity.]
WAA!

Her dark eyes radiated an enticing majesty as she plucked the grapes before her, Noah sitting on an opposing throne naturally as he gazed at this Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity who continued with a smile.
[First, one of the crucial points every Underdweller needs to quickly grasp is that in these Supernal Havens of Extremity, Havenly Aurora is everything.]
Havenly Aurora was everything. Vitalis Hyperversal Authority mixed with the Authorities of the Supernal Havens was everything!
[Units of Havenly Aurora are a currency and a commodity- with the Naturally Formed Havenly Treasures you've seen in this Golden Havenly Archipelago...

being only the tip of the iceberg. In Obsidian and Crimson Havenly Archipelagos, there are things that individuals cannot acquire even if they accumulate Havenly Aurora for their whole lifetime- Hyperversal Havenly Treasures costing millions and Billions of Units of Havenly Aurora to acquire!]
WAA!

[There are Havenly Archipelagos one cannot even near unless they have a backing. Unless they are a part of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages. And herein lies your conundrum...my dear Underdweller Anomaly.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2631 Unfathomable Depth! I
paragraphs: 2631 Unfathomable Depth! I
His conundrum.

Within the Supernal Havens of Extremity, Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages were reigning over the masses as when it came to the truly critical Havenly Treasures- one couldn't even near the Archipelagos they were in unless they held the right status!
Noah gazed at the visage of Extremity Laeta before him as he asked lightly.
"Just to what extent do the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages hold sway in the Supernal Havens of Extremity?"
How grand was their position?
How unshakable was their might?
Noah asked simply to grasp a bit more about the structure of these new lands, but the reply was a heavy one as Extremity Laeta smiled brightly.
[They hold sway over everything.]

[Their influence has reached an unfathomable depth within these Havens as they...hold the most Havenly Aurora in their hands. And since Havenly Aurora is the most crucial thing in these Havens, they hold the most power. And this power...is centered around something forged and built by all Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages- the Havenly Vaults.]
Something enacted by the most powerful entities whose sheer influence across the Supernal Havens of Extremity was unfathomable!
As she spoke about it, Laeta's voice was calm as if all of this was simply the way of life.
When she spoke about the Havenly Vaults, her feline eyes lit up brightly as she continued with enthusiasm.

[Something you may not know yet is when one collects a great deal of the Units of Havenly Aurora, let's say beginning by exceeding 100,000...your body will start emitting a rich aura of Havenly Authority that actually acts like a beacon for others. It invites Challengers whether you like it or not. If you somehow overcome and accumulate 1,000,000 Units of Havenly Aurora for a pristine Hyperversal Extremity Treasure, even Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities will come to Challenge you no matter your stage of power as such a number is extremely enticing!]

[So at any point in time while you're working hard to collect tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of Units of Havenly Aurora, you can be challenged and defeated as you lose everything- years worth of accumulation. This is why a single being can never truly save up millions of Units of Havenly Aurora over their lifetime as the rich aura they automatically and uncontrollably emit will only become more powerful, inviting terrifying Challengers until they lose everything. And this...was where the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages came in. They forged the Havenly Vaults as they allowed the Haven Races...to willingly transfer their Units of Havenly Aurora to be stored and kept safe as in exchange, one is given...a Havenly Note of Extremity.]
As Laeta spoke, she waved her hands to reveal a gold piece of paper.

It was rectangular in shape as it pulsed with the Authorities of multiple Supernal Havens of Extremity, Noah seeing this gold note inscribed with a myriad of runic markings as it held a runic ecriture of [I] at its very center that pulsed with the authorities of all 7 Havens!
A Havenly Note of Extremity!
Laeta waved it in front of her serenely as she continued with a smile.

[A currency. This single Havenly Note in my hand is worth 10,000 Units of Havenly Aurora as this is the method Existences use to amass large units of Havenly Aurora over the years. They store what they accumulate before it reaches alarming levels to emit a rich aura of Havenly Authority and transfer it into the Havenly Vaults run by the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages for a fee, and whenever they have accumulated enough Units of Havenly Aurora for whatever they wish to attain, they exchange all their Havenly Notes for the equivalent Units of Havenly Aurora within the Sacred Crimson Havenly Archipelagos where no Challenges are accepted.]

[That's how the Havenly Vaults came to be as under the control of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages, they have amassed Billions of Units of Havenly Aurora- charging fees for all who use their services to store and keep their Units of Havenly Aurora and even Havenly Notes safe before they can be utilized. The fees of Units of Havenly Aurora they rack up alone on a daily basis are more than a lifetime's work that hundreds or thousands of Extremities can accomplish as those in the upper echelons of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages are the wealthiest of Existences. And the wealthiest...are naturally the most powerful as they can access the most glorious Hyperversal Havenly Treasures!]

Noah's eyes radiated brightness as this being before him spoke, with the things she currently said making Noah think of these Havenly Vaults she was mentioning as some form of a banking system utilized by the upper echelons of power in the Supernal Havens of Extremity.

He even scrutinized the paper currency that seemed to be forged airtight and with profound authority as on the four corners of the Havenly Note of Extremity that Laeta had pulled out, Noah saw four symbols that should represent the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages.
It was a fantastical system as at the crux of it though...lay the question of how.
A question that Noah raised to the Extremity before him.
"These Havenly Vaults of Extremity that the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages enacted...what exactly are they? Isn't the transferring of Units of Havenly Aurora done person to person?"
When an existence began exceeding tens of thousands of Units of Havenly Aurora, an uncontrollable scent of Havenly Authority emitted from them that would invite Challenges!
How did the Havenly Vaults remain active and unbothered over the eons and allow the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages to amass the power that they now held?
When arriving at this question, Extremity Laeta became serious as she caused the Havenly Note in front of her to disappear, her words succinct as she stared at Noah closely.
[Because the ones who forged and stand guard over the Havenly Vaults...are those who have undergone Havenly Awakening.]
[For them, an immense authority has been grasped as unlike all of us, the scent of Havenly Authority is able to be controlled and even hidden!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2632 Unfathomable Depth! II
paragraphs: 2632 Unfathomable Depth! II
Havenly Awakening!
The moment Noah heard this term, he affirmed that there were an untold number of beings that had undergone Vitalis Awakenings within the Supernal Havens of Extremity.

Those who had their First Vitalis Awakening were half like him, while those who had undergone their Second Vitalis Awakening were ahead of him as they could actively control Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
And such beings were considered the most powerful as with their means, they enacted the Havenly Vaults of Extremity.

A massive system that circulated Billions of Units of Havenly Aurora, with the influence of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages being so vast that they even controlled who could access Archipelagos that could generate the most quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Treasures.

With his unique power and the fact that he had already undergone his First Vitalis Awakening, there were many ways Noah could play things going forward as with sharp eyes, he joined Laeta in enjoying the feast before him as she continued!

[Those who have undergone Havenly Awakening are rare, but they have increased in number over the years as the privilege granted to them is an indescribable one. But don't you worry about them, they're too far from our grasp.]
Her dark eyes let out an enticing light as she stopped eating the grapes pulsing with Dissolution and focused her feline eyes on him entirely, as if she had arrived at the most crucial part.

[Now, your choice to make is which of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages to join...but at the same time, it's not really much of a choice. The Smilodons, Titanoboas, and Dragonflies you have come across so far...we all stem from the Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage. Under the Animalia Extremity Lineage, there are branches of sub-families like the Smilodons, Titanoboas, Dragonflies, Sirens, Mammoths, Saurischians, and many others. Joining any of us is joining the Animalia Extremity Lineage, with the only difference being the level of power we hold compared to others.]
The Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage!
After Laeta spoke about this one, she continued slowly on what the other 3 were right after.

[The other Havenly Extremity Lineages that you would have to travel far from here to come across are the Havenly Plantae Extremity Lineage, the Havenly Riboviria Extremity Lineage, and Havenly Celestia Extremity Lineage. You're an interesting Underdweller as after drawing our eyes, the Smilodons, Titanoboas, or Dragonflies can grant you a Havenly Recommendation to join any of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages. The biggest boost I can tell you without being biased is that joining any of them...will allow you access to the Havenly Vaults of Extremity.]
A Havenly Recommendation was required to join any of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages!
For all incoming Underdwellers- unless they showed a tremendous level of power as Hyperversal Extremities or displayed something unique like Noah, they could not freely join the Havenly Lineages.
And only by joining would one gain access to utilize the Havenly Vaults of Extremity!
[So those are the basic facts to allow you to make an informed decision. The question for you is...what will it be?]
Extremity Laeta asked with a rosy smile even though Noah's choice was already made.
He wouldn't reveal anything about his First Vitalis Awakening as he needed to collect more information and understand this other side of the Seven Havens more!
This was still just supposed to be the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification as who knew what more surprises the future held?
The most critical thing remained his path.
The most critical thing remained his enemies!
So he gazed at the feline Extremity before him as he tapped on the glimmering table, his voice steady and filled with majesty.
"I shall join the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage through the Smilodons."
WAA!
His words caused Laeta to smile brilliantly as she nodded and caused waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority to erupt in the surroundings.

[I'll pass on the good news to the Titanoboas and Dragonflies. See if you want to obtain any other Havenly Treasures in this Golden Havenly Archipelago, or you can save up your Units of Havenly Aurora for where we have to go to in order to officially grant you a status as an existence belonging to the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage...we shall head to an Obsidian Havenly Archipelago. There, you will find Havenly Treasures that can aid you in bringing Dissolution or any of your concepts of Extremity towards the 15th, 16th, or even the 17th Boundary Layer. Along with Havenly Treasures to reinforce your Extremity Foundation or to further elevate your Apocryphal Havens and bring your Realm to an even greater level.]
Fantastical words were released from her as they both rose, her curvaceous figure emanating great power as she continued with a sharp smile while walking towards him.

[You'll come to love the Smilodon Lineage. Our strongest reach the upper echelons of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage as some even oversee Branches of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity, and you'll come to find that most Smilodons truly know how to have fun...]
As she spoke the last set of words, her hourglass figure and blessed chest were even further magnified as she came to stand beside Noah, tendrils of Hyperversal Extremity Authority rising from her.
Noah raised his brows as he asked calmly.
"Even you?"
[Me?] Her dark eyes were filled with a light of innocence as she blinked while letting out a laugh. [Ask me about that again when you attain Extremity. Maybe then I will entertain you...]
The Hyperversal Extremity Authority emanating from her fully wrapped around them thereafter as within an instant, their figures disappeared.
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

Noah's Main Body was calmly discussing with the Wealdian Council of Extremity along with Dr. Hall and The Haven Lich on the creation of a Virus that utilized the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority at its core, with multiple new Boundaries including Pathogenicity and Plague being expanded for this endeavor as everything was proceeding smoothly this far!
And in the midst of all of this, Noah's will was moving to do something else entirely.
Within his Main Body.
Towards the peak of his Origin where his Fourth Aletheian Haven stood...his soul focused on at as at this moment, an obsidian spark of a singularity bloomed.
An obsidian spark of Dissolution!
Amidst the Havens that were only forged with 9 Dimensions at their base, another entirely different type of Haven sought to come to fruition!

The moment Noah heard this term, he affirmed that there were an untold number of beings that had undergone Vitalis Awakenings within the Supernal Havens of Extremity.

Those who had their First Vitalis Awakening were half like him, while those who had undergone their Second Vitalis Awakening were ahead of him as they could actively control Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
And such beings were considered the most powerful as with their means, they enacted the Havenly Vaults of Extremity.

A massive system that circulated Billions of Units of Havenly Aurora, with the influence of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages being so vast that they even controlled who could access Archipelagos that could generate the most quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Treasures.

With his unique power and the fact that he had already undergone his First Vitalis Awakening, there were many ways Noah could play things going forward as with sharp eyes, he joined Laeta in enjoying the feast before him as she continued!

But don't you worry about them, they're too far from our grasp.]
Her dark eyes let out an enticing light as she stopped eating the grapes pulsing with Dissolution and focused her feline eyes on him entirely, as if she had arrived at the most crucial part.

The Smilodons, Titanoboas, and Dragonflies you have come across so far...we all stem from the Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage.
Under the Animalia Extremity Lineage, there are branches of sub-families like the Smilodons, Titanoboas, Dragonflies, Sirens, Mammoths, Saurischians, and many others.
Joining any of us is joining the Animalia Extremity Lineage, with the only difference being the level of power we hold compared to others.]
The Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage!
After Laeta spoke about this one, she continued slowly on what the other 3 were right after.

[The other Havenly Extremity Lineages that you would have to travel far from here to come across are the Havenly Plantae Extremity Lineage, the Havenly Riboviria Extremity Lineage, and Havenly Celestia Extremity Lineage.

You're an interesting Underdweller as after drawing our eyes, the Smilodons, Titanoboas, or Dragonflies can grant you a Havenly Recommendation to join any of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages.
The biggest boost I can tell you without being biased is that joining any of them...will allow you access to the Havenly Vaults of Extremity.]
A Havenly Recommendation was required to join any of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages!
For all incoming Underdwellers- unless they showed a tremendous level of power as Hyperversal Extremities or displayed something unique like Noah, they could not freely join the Havenly Lineages.
And only by joining would one gain access to utilize the Havenly Vaults of Extremity!
[So those are the basic facts to allow you to make an informed decision.
The question for you is...what will it be?]
Extremity Laeta asked with a rosy smile even though Noah's choice was already made.
He wouldn't reveal anything about his First Vitalis Awakening as he needed to collect more information and understand this other side of the Seven Havens more!
This was still just supposed to be the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification as who knew what more surprises the future held?
The most critical thing remained his path.
The most critical thing remained his enemies!
So he gazed at the feline Extremity before him as he tapped on the glimmering table, his voice steady and filled with majesty.
"I shall join the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage through the Smilodons."
WAA!
His words caused Laeta to smile brilliantly as she nodded and caused waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority to erupt in the surroundings.
[I'll pass on the good news to the Titanoboas and Dragonflies.

See if you want to obtain any other Havenly Treasures in this Golden Havenly Archipelago, or you can save up your Units of Havenly Aurora for where we have to go to in order to officially grant you a status as an existence belonging to the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage...we shall head to an Obsidian Havenly Archipelago.

chapters.title: Chapter 2633 Unfathomable Depth! III
paragraphs: 2633 Unfathomable Depth! III
Havens filled with Dreams, Prana, Avalon, Elysium, Fantasia, Niflheim, Mirror, Quantum, and Apollyon at their source were ever present in Noah's Origin.
They enacted his Aletheian Havens of Extremity that if completed up to the Ninth Aletheian Haven of Extremity...Noah would attain a profound level of Extremity!
He wouldn't be like other beings who achieved Extremity in a concept and slowly worked to then bring other concepts to Extremity.
His starting line would be multiple concepts instantly reaching Extremity at the same time as would he truly only be Tier 1 when the time came?
This was a question for the future.
For now, Noah was once more trying something marvelous as in addition to the Havens of past Dimensions, a spark of Dissolution bloomed above the Fourth Aletheian Haven!
And with it, the Havenly Boundary of Dissolution seethed and churned in Noah's Origin as it began to cycle and propagate within his Origin.
The Singularity was a starting point. Thereafter, a construct began to bloom!
[The Source of a New Haven has emerged in your Origin.]
[Due to incongruency with the Havens within the Fourth Aletheian Haven, the New Haven has begun as the basis of the Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity!]
Above the Fourth Aletheian Haven, a Fifth one began to form.
It was minuscule in scale compared to the other Four Havens below it, but the breadth and power it displayed was utterly unfathomable!
[The Haven of Dissolution has been born in your Origin.]
[The potential and immensity of the Haven of Dissolution vastly outstrips your prior Havens, and so does its requirement to expand, refine, and strengthen.]

On the Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity, Dissolution ran free and rampant as stellar obsidian Cosmos began to rise along with inky black rivers of reality, and they were proliferating quickly as the little essence gathered within Noah's Origin towards it was being used up!
But there was something Noah had at this moment that gave him confidence in being able to successfully enact and expand this new glorious Haven.
And his Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable was looking at it at this very moment above the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago as he was obtaining anything he might need before he set off with Laeta!
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain Epione's Golden Realm Blessing. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
[Epione's Golden Realm Blessing].
A profound Havenly Treasure that actually required many Units of Havenly Aurora, but it was the mainstream and one of the more profound treasures to elevate one's Realm!
Noah knew so without even buying it yet as he had seen the Unrecorded History where he had bought such a wondrous thing through Oraculum.
The cost of 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora was paid as the halo of light around a blinding halcyon statue of a woman could be seen.

She was adorned in a light gold robe as her eyes were forever closed, her beauty never to be seen again! This was Epione's Golden Realm Blessing as the moment Noah attained it in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, it entered his Vaults of Quintessence that his Main Body instantly pulled it out from as within moments...
SHAA!
It appeared above the barely forming Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity!

[Epione's Golden Realm Blessing]:: Epione was an existence trying to scale an unknown Hyperversal Tier of Extremity when she took an action that could affect the Supernal Havens of Extremity themselves. She ultimately failed in her endeavor as her Will, Soul, Concepts, and everything that made her were assimilated into the Supernal Havens of Extremity. To this day Havenly Treasures that are geared towards the ultimate progression of Apocryphal Havens in one's Origin continue to be generated within the Supernal Havens of Extremity...
A fantastical Havenly Treasures whose description revealed a few fantastical things.

But Noah sent his will into it and activated such a wonder as a moment later, the statue cracked and radiated glorious golden light- a massive illusory figure of a woman with her eyes closed appearing above Noah's Havens, her hand waving outwards as seas of golden essence rained down only the forming Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity as if it was rain hitting a dry earth!
And the instant the sea of essence cascaded down, the budding Haven of Dissolution trembled as trillions of Cosmos and Realities began to emerge and proliferate.
The size and sheer magnitude of the Haven began to expand rapidly as the illusory figure of the golden woman remained, Epione's Golden Realm Blessing continuing its wonders even now!
And when the growth of the Haven of Dissolution reached a certain threshold...
BZZT!
Noah felt something within his body pulse and react.
Gradually, a devilish smile rose on his main body as he felt...his Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians pulsing!
The meridians holding Vitalis Hyperversal Authority he couldn't control.

At this moment, they pulsed as from them, small streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority rose and sank into Noah's Origin- appearing above the emerging Haven of Dissolution as the obsidian light of grandeur from this Haven rose up to meet the streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
[A Unique Quality of the Haven of Dissolution has unveiled itself!]

The streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and the Authority of Dissolution mixed with each other as in a wondrous turn of events...it resulted in the budding of a blinding halo of light above the Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity.

[The authority within the Haven of Dissolution will passively attract Vitalis Hyperversal Authority at the very peak of the Haven, the two authorities mixing naturally to birth Hyperversal Extremity Treasures!]
'Haha!'
Noah had theorized it.
Oraculum had seen the Unrecorded Histories and confirmed it, and Noah proceeded with it!

He had thought that since the Supernal Haven of Dissolution was drawing and mixing with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to make the shocking Havenly Treasures above the Archipelagos...what would happen if he enacted a similar Haven within him along with his Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2634 Unfathomable Depth! IV
paragraphs: 2634 Unfathomable Depth! IV
The answer was a glorious one.

[The level and size of the Haven of Dissolution within the Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity is extremely low as the Hyperversal Extremity Treasures born will be of low tier and of limited amounts. The expansion of the Haven of Dissolution and other types of Havens similar to it will allow for more possibilities.]
[At its current stage, a single Hyperversal Extremity Treasure can be forged within 24 hours.]
It was small.
It was a scale that was miniscule even while comparing it to a single Havenly Archipelago of the countless Archipelagos within the Supernal Havens of Extremity!

But on this day, Noah had managed to replicate an action of unfathomable importance as at this time, his Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Authority pulsed with activity as small streams of it steadily flowed and mixed into a Singularity at the very top of his Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity, Dissolution being the other counterpart as together, they created something grand.
Noah's will pervasively gazed at all other parts of him as when his eyes came to land on his Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians...he saw they were utterly still and silent.

They didn't react to any of this as Noah gazed at the Meridians with a pondering gaze, Epione's Golden Realm Blessing in his Origin still continuing as the Haven of Dissolution continued to expand silently!
As this process unfolded.
Outside of Noah's main body.
The voice of the Haven Lich Ra'Zan could be heard as it was filled with power and reverence.

[Council Member Thanatos is right...if Master was forced to undergo cycles of death because of the clash between Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, what if the poison veils Vacuous Hyperversal Authority in the midst of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority without causing them to clash, and during the moment that an Extremity is absorbing Havenly Authority into their Havenly Organ...they take in streams of a bomb that is yet to go off in their Havenly Organ?]
Noah smiled at the words another part of him had uttered out that the Haven Lich expanded on.
He then raised his head to stare past the Prana Aletheian Haven they were in as he spoke serenely.

"Mmm, if this can successfully be done, all that is needed thereafter is a pathogenic element that will allow the virus to spread across all of their existence- to their very Recorded History as well!"

Utterly dreadful and deadly discussions were taking place as Noah's eyes tore across the veils of space- his will coming to cover the vastness of these lands that were constantly expanding as at this moment, within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven itself...
Noah's soul made yet another move as a massive singularity bloomed in a corner of this Haven itself.
Beautifully obsidian in color and radiating the authority of Dissolution, Noah also sought to enact a Haven of Dissolution within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
Across the folds of spacetime.
Past the broken-down walls of the Seven Aeonic Havens of Extremity, a circular Extremity Vein continued to pulse- radiating multicolored light all around as it took the eyes of many.
At this point though, the vast majority had made their way towards Dissolution.
The vast majority.
There were still some that didn't go, whether it was through a reason of weakness, strength, or any other!
Within the Haven of Elera.
A man with deeply blue eyes stood atop a fractured crimson Planar sun, his eyes pulsing with cerulean arcs of light as his dark hair flowed grandly.
Behind him, a dark-haired woman with a gorgeous figure and sleek obsidian hair that fell past her shoulders floated over as she spoke.
"Your sister is still stabilizing her Meridians...we're sure about not going towards Dissolution? It seems like the center point of change unfolding in these Havens is occurring there."
The woman was a gorgeous one all around as her identity was a unique one, stemming outside of the Seven Havens not too long ago!
The man smiled while shaking his head.
"No, Europa. If I didn't come across that, then I would have definitely rushed over. But with it...too many other possibilities open up."
As he spoke, his endlessly blue eyes became dim and were replaced by an immense darkness of an authority of utmost nothingness!

"Who could have expected clusters of Vacuous Malignancies to be so deeply embedded into the Seven Havens? And for me to Dominate the dying shred of soul a Vacuous Malignancy hunted by the Senatus of Extremity...ah, with such a thing in my hands, I'll take my path elsewhere entirely. As soon as I gain full control of its body, we shall set off outside the scope of reality and time itself."
The dominance of the dying shred of the soul of a Vacuous Malignancy!
The being standing beside Europa thought of this unimaginable fortune, however broken and shattered it was.
Since the Vacuous Malignancy was quite literally at death's door, their Records were shattered and scattered, their Concepts of Extremity broken and scorched from their existence.
But he could still feel them.
In time, he felt like he could piece them together.
When that time came, Extremity would be within grasp.
But for now, his path was crystal clear!
His head rose as he stared out at the Aurora of crimson lights all around them.

"The Vacuous Hyperversal Domains...my destiny will continue to unfold there. Just as there are countless possibilities within the Seven Havens, there are countless more outside of it. And who knows, maybe while outside the scope of Space and time, I may actually stand a chance of catching up to Osmont. He's already made Dissolution into his playing field from the recent news..."
His eyes returned to their bright luster as the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority faded within them.
Beside him, Europa shook her head as she clutched onto his arm and stared out into the expanse of crimson light.

"Who knows. But you'll have to be careful, Eckert. From the memories you've obtained about these Vacuous Malignancies...their lands are steeped with even more dangers than anywhere within the Seven Havens."
At her words, Noah Eckert smiled with a devilish glint while letting out a laugh soon after.

"Dangers and opportunities go hand in hand. I want to know more, Europa. I want to understand why the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains and the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains are the way they are. I want to know more about the memory that makes Vacuous Malignancies act with such urgency...I want to know more about The Ones Above Extremity!"

From the memories you've obtained about these Vacuous Malignancies...their lands are steeped with even more dangers than anywhere within the Seven Havens."
At her words, Noah Eckert smiled with a devilish glint while letting out a laugh soon after.
"Dangers and opportunities go hand in hand.
I want to know more, Europa.
I want to understand why the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains and the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains are the way they are.
I want to know more about the memory that makes Vacuous Malignancies act with such urgency...I want to know more about The Ones Above Extremity!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2635 All in! I
paragraphs: 2635 All in! I
One being chose their path while they stood within a corner of Elera.

Meanwhile, countless others within the Seven Havens chose their own paths as in the Haven of Dissolution, every single Vein Rift was pulsing with battle as many beings were rejected entry, while some unique and powerful ones were granted entry as they passed through!
At this moment, in a corner that had few Inheritances cautious to even approach it, a Temporal Field of Dissolution trembled as two figures came out of it.
One was an existence actually granted the title of Lord Commander- a Perennial Oak whose aura should have been at the very top of Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity!

And yet the gaze of the titanic Perennial Oak whose visage was that of a glorious stellar tree with a dominant face curved at its center point...such an entity held shock in its eyes as it looked at the man who also came out from the Temporal Field of Dissolution.
His white robe was untouched as his sword remained sheathed behind his back, his light caramel-colored skin pulsing with a stellar radiance as this being was none other than Emperor Shao!
He had faced a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity with an earned title of Lord Commander and came out of the battle as if nothing had happened.
The gaze of the Perennial Oak was stern as it spoke out, a light flashing in front of it as a verdant scroll of light emerged and floated towards Emperor Shao.

[You have gained entry. When you delve deeper into the Supernal Havens of Dissolution, you will come across Obsidian and Crimson Havenly Archipelagos where you can utilize this- a Havenly Plantae Recommendation.]

The scroll arrived before him as Emperor Shao waved his hands and accepted it, nodding towards the Perennial Oak as a moment later, he turned into a glimmer of light that disappeared into the obsidian mist ahead!
Only at this point did the forces of Inheritances in the surroundings feel like they could breathe again as Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms surged forward to gain entry.
In another Vein Rift.

Fluctuations of the 11th Boundary Layer of Dissolution buzzed around a Havenly Siren as she was knocked back forcefully, the visage of Erikson in light crimson beach attire standing opposite to it as a cold voice rose.
[You have gained entry.]

The words were emotionless ones as on the other side, Erikson merely smiled while taking the easy win. On his person, he held enough Extremity Treasures to propel a few of his concepts across the Boundary Layers as if it were nothing- this being the product of his father and the Sima Clan!
Yet he didn't utilize them all as he only dipped his feet into the reserves of treasures to bring his Boundary of Probability to the 11th Layer.

He wanted to give himself an easier time gaining entry as hereafter...he could begin fully devouring the trenches of Extremity Treasures prepared by his Clan to quickly go towards the 17th Boundary Layer!
He wasn't the only one doing this as when he turned his head to the distance, he could see Ayame, Atlas, and a few others that were just like him!
"Mmm, nepotism at its best..."
He nodded with a smile as he proceeded forward, the Extremity of Foundation and a few others who had gained entry waiting for him.
Being born into the right family or Clan was also destiny and fortune.
Erikson planned to use such a fortune fully as he would never deny something freely granted to him.
He would use it to attain a power capable of true change in these vast havens where currently, he was still one of its weakest creatures.
He wouldn't have dared to dream of it before, but with the Last Extremity Sanctification proceeding this way, many Extremities would be forged in a short period of time!
Whether he would attain Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity or Tier 4 at the end of it...remained to be seen.
With a glimmer of light and innumerable thoughts, he disappeared into the obsidian mist along with multiple forces of the Sima Clan.
One after another.
Little by little.
It was a gradual process, but the vast Inheritances and Seven Clans of the Nether Havens of Extremity converged as they went all in!
All into the unfolding wonder of Dissolution...that currently acted like a gateway into a grand stage.
A stage that at this moment already had main players running rampant...but none of them knew of the monsters stepping onto this stage and about to shake things up for better or for worse!
Across Dissolution, towards the Vein Rifts where the abundant forces of Avernus were stationed and beginning to gain entry.

Chamber Master Gayacus had a solemn expression as he stood beside multiple other Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities atop a massive Titanic vessel that looked like an exclusive ship constructed out of crystals radiating waves of silent Extremity!

In front of the many Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities, a man veiled in pristine purple light stood valiantly as everything about him was veiled, his aura and power far exceeding those behind him as beside such a figure, a veiled woman also covered by a veil of purple light stood strong.
Chamber Master Gayacus had a difficult expression as he spoke around such powerhouses.

[I realize this may be presumptuous to be a topic of conversation with Sire and all of us, but we aren't making any headway with the public enemy of Avernus. This is my failure as the Chamber Master tasked with this issue. Extremity Blue lost his tracks and hasn't gotten close to finding him even though she entered the lands ahead right after him. He is just an Apex Aeonic Lifeform but...there are instances in history where beings even weaker than him eventually became grave issues for inheritances or Clans. I don't know how to proceed with this...if Sire can shed some light.]
It was difficult for him to say these words.
After all, the enemy was an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
Beside him, a few other Chamber Masters sneered as a woman with radiant crimson hair spoke with some admonishment.
[Merely an Apex Aeonic Lifeform and you can't even-]
[Do not treat him as a mere Apex Aeonic Lifeform.]
WAA!
Before the crimson-haired Extremity could finish, the magnetic being ahead of them spoke as all those behind him stared with astonishment!

chapters.title: Chapter 2636 All in! II
paragraphs: 2636 All in! II
An Apex Aeonic Lifeform truly caught the eye of their Sire!
Of the Avernus Extremity Overlord!
The being shrouded with royal purple light continued calmly.
[Amestris, tell them of your findings.]
His words were directed to the veiled woman beside him who radiated power almost in line with his, but it felt more mysterious- more obscure!
Many eyes turned towards her as this veiled existence let out a beautiful voice.

[There are very few existences that I cannot see in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. Even those that have achieved Extremity and enacted an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity veiling then within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity...I can still find and obtain information. And yet this Noah Osmont...I can find nothing.]
Beside Chamber Master Gayacus, Extremity Ariana was entirely solemn as she and the others listened.

[This leaves very few possibilities for this being as an Entity. It means that in addition to an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, he is either being actively masked by at the very minimum a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity, or he has a type of authority very few of us understand in his grasp in addition to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.]
WAA!
When she arrived here, many gazes changed.
Chamber Master Gayacus turned ashen as he voiced out slowly...
[You don't mean...]
[Vitalis.]
BOOM!
Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
Something they barely understood, and yet beings of their level knew to be an intricate part of the Seven Havens!

[All of these are theories and conjectures, but with any of them- the outcome is not ideal. The Unrecorded Histories I can view are becoming murky and cloudy. With the advent of the Supernal Havens of Extremity ahead of us, eliminating any uncertainties coming for us is crucial. So yes, this enemy...do not treat them as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform. Use all means at your disposal to find him. Your mission for these Supernal Havens of Extremity...half of it will be locating and containing this threat.]
[As for the one whose actions sparked all this...]
Her veiled gaze turned to go towards a corner behind the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities standing side by side with Chamber Master Gayacus and Ariana.
Behind them...towards the row of Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities!
Her gaze was singularly on a being whose face had turned entirely ashen as if blood was no longer flowing!

[Destruction...the only reason you are still alive is because of the Hyperversal Extremity of Chaos. She has brought you one week. If the threat of Osmont isn't reigned in at that time, your soul will be used as the basis of an Extremity Soul Compass- unless you bring another Extremity to stand on your behalf as the material for it.]
Dreadful words emanated from her as a heavy silence descended!
Extremity Ariana stared back at Destruction whose face convulsed with countless emotions.
How did he arrive here from such a high stature?
For him to even be standing alongside Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities!
All of it boiled down to choices.
And at this moment, even more choices were made as a burning purple light erupted around the Avernus Extremity Overlord that enveloped him and a select number of Extremities behind him.
When this light disappeared, they were all gone.
And an instant later, they appeared before the transparent veil of a certain Vein Rift that held a Havenly Saber Smilodon Lord Commander, Titanoboas, and Dragonflies!
The same gateway that Noah took.
The Havenly Saber Smilodon gazed at them calmly as when he saw the two beings wrapped by a veil of purple light ahead of the cluster of Extremities, his voice was a calm one.
[Your standing grants you free entry.]
Without a word, the Avernus Extremity Overlord and the most terrifying Seer of the Avernus Clan known as Seer Amestris floated forward!
Behind them, 200 Hyperversal Extremities followed in order as they delved into the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
Past the obsidian mist, they very quickly appeared as they gazed at the wondrous scene of floating Havenly Archipelagos.
Seer Amestris gazed at the surroundings quickly as her gaze came to land on the Golden Havenly Smilodon Archipelago, her veiled figure pulsing with power as a shocking voice emanated soon after.
[He was there.]
He couldn't be tracked in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, yes.
But there were other methods apart from this.
One of the more straightforward ones...was to have a terrifying Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity trace his steps!

[Amestris, lead them to track down this Osmont. The rest of you...with me. The Hyperversal Extremity Treasures within these lands must be made use of. The goal is to produce as many Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Avernus Extremities as possible...otherwise we will not even be able to carve out any domains within these lands to occupy.]

The Avernus Extremity Overlord spoke in a regal tone as the forces behind them split in half, the means and goals of the leaders of Clans being unfathomable to grasp as one moved to achieve his own ideals!
The surroundings were becoming filled with even greater concentrations of Dissolution.

Enclosed within a circular domain of Hyperversal Extremity Authority, Noah's Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable was standing beside Extremity Laeta in her Smilodon form as they had already begun their venture towards an Obsidian Havenly Archipelago!

Noah continued talking with Extremity Laeta and expanded his breadth of knowledge regarding the Supernal Havens of Extremity he had just stepped into, as well as the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages and their distinctions.
But even though his Reified Source was carrying this calm demeanor, his Soul that was stretched out across many domains was churning and moving rapidly to elevate his power and pace of progression!

This was because on the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago that he had just left, he had taken a small part of his will and left it behind- simply to observe who else apart from Extremity Blue would be making their way over here.

And he was just faced with a scene of hundreds of Hyperversal Extremities- including Gayacus and Ariana that he came across in the Cult of Endless Shadows and later learned of their positions through Erikson and the Sima Clan!

He saw the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities, as well as the veiled beings ahead of them as one held a penetrative gaze that gave him unprecedented danger- causing him to instantly release the portion of will be left behind as he calmly analyzed everything.
His enemies this time were truly not small. They moved with power and precision as they stood like a blade above his head waiting to cleave down!
He could feel his Reified Source of Oraculum urging him on.
At this very moment, within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
His Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum was gazing at Unrecorded Histories of what was to come as it had always been.
While gazing at a particular Unrecorded History at this juncture, the light of Lotra began to shine within the eyes of Oraculum as he found yet another target of Plundering!

chapters.title: Chapter 2637 Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor! I
paragraphs: Noah's Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum was a nexus of countless waves of information and ideas that constantly flowed in.

He viewed a great deal of possible futures and even Recorded Histories to learn more about the current reality and the enemies he came across, and he eventually came across Unrecorded Histories that granted him extremely beneficial knowledge!
The Unrecorded History he was gazing at this time was a particularly profound one.
{{...The process of becoming a part of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages was a sacred one.

While utilizing the Golden Havenly Recommendation granted by Extremity Laeta, Noah was allowed to become a part of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage by undergoing a process called Havenly Blood Ablation.

One's old lineage would be burned and vaporized as the Blood Source of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage would be branded into their very marrows- their being forever becoming a part of the Havenly Lineages!

{With a Golden Havenly Recommendation, you will be able to undergo Havenly Blood Ablation with a Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source. Most beings with strong wills survive it...with the results being your Lineage fully changed to become a Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage.}
As she spoke, Laeta walked with Noah across an elevated platform radiating rivers of Dissolution.
At the very peak of this platform, there was an obsidian crystalline path that led into a circular sea that was the size of a small world!
Golden Blood Source filled with minute traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority could be seen within this enclosed space- a heart-shaking aura releasing from this flowing blood ahead!
Enclosed areas like these could be seen stretched out across this space as the others were not as full, with the volume of Blood Source being very limited.

{The Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source...although the gains you will make are not going to be as much as Obsidian or Crimson Havenly Animalia Blood, the processes involving those are not things the current you can afford. Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineages have to pay a minimum of 10 Havenly Notes of Extremity just for the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood in order to undergo their Second Bloodline Ablation.}
Her voice traveled far as the gorgeous stellar landscape of Dissolution around them shimmered, Noah's will catching the sight of a massive enclosure of Havenly Animalia Blood Source!
But this was darker. Denser. Filled with a shocking amount of possibilities and many more streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
But to even gain access to it, 10 Havenly Notes had to be paid!
This was equivalent to 100,000 Units of Havenly Aurora!
It was something far outside his current scope of power.
And yet when Noah gazed at it from afar...he couldn't help but form a devilish smile.
He wondered...if this current reality was a future that was playing out and being watched by his Soul in a distant past, would he be able to do something outrageous?...}}
The Unrecorded History was a unique one.
Even Noah's thoughts in this Unrecorded History were fantastical ones as truly, his future self thought the same as his past self!
His Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum gazed at the playing Unrecorded History as in the next moment....
{Hyperversal Plundering}.
BZZT!
A bejeweled illusory golden hand formed in the skies of the emerging scene.
Its target was a unique one as it domineeringly hovered over the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source that Extremity Laeta and Noah could only gaze at from a distance!
{You are attempting to Plunder and Unrecorded History!}
{The authorities involved are at a high enough Tier.}
{The target of Plundering is at a manageable Tier.}
The glorious golden hand came down as its fingers pinched.

The History of the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source trembled as moments after, the brilliant light cascaded all around as Noah's Soul Values were squeezed out along with seas of Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Values!
But the end result was a mighty one.
{You have succeeded in Plundering the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea!}
A singularity of wonder emerged as a vast Obsidian Sea was transported towards his Vaults of Quintessence.
Around them, the concentration of the authority of Dissolution only became heavier as they passed multiple gorgeous floating Archipelagos.

Each of them were Golden Havenly Archipelagos as after a few hours of Noah getting a view of the vastness of the Supernal Havens of Dissolution, they were finally arriving at their target as ahead of them...a floating island more massive than any of the ones observed beforehand bloomed!
It was no longer the size of a plane as the light years it extended all around were enough to make it a Minor Haven.

Drizzling gorgeous black waterfalls of emerge fell from its edges and dripped down as above it, a massive singularity spinning and collecting Vitalis Hyperversal Authority while mixing it with potent Authority of Dissolution to produce even grander Havenly Treasures could be seen.

{The first Obsidian Havenly Archipelago after the clusters of Golden Havenly Archipelagos in this region. It is a center point of power as here, we can find a Branch of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity. The Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago.}
The Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago!
One couldn't see an array of vessels or guards surrounding it as there was truly no need to.

It was still one of the most protected domains because at this very moment, one could feel an overwhelming and silent aura of a Hyperversal Extremity spread out constantly around the Obsidian Havenly Archipelago!
Its might and grandeur...was not something a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity could release.

Seeing Noah's eyes, Extremity Laeta smiled as they entered the area of effect of the spread out will and landed on the floating landmass that looked like a paradisical domain filled with an array of vegetation and tall rising structures pulsing with Dissolution.

{Oh yes, the Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago is overseen by a Havenly Saurischian Lord Commander. Their presence here is not just for the monitoring of Havenly Treasures that only those of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages are allowed to obtain, but truly here for the Branch of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity. They are a personage that has undergone Havenly Awakening}
WAA!
The explosive words were heavy ones to hear as they arrived at a shocking location

sentences.text: Noah's Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum was a nexus of countless waves of information and ideas that constantly flowed in.

He viewed a great deal of possible futures and even Recorded Histories to learn more about the current reality and the enemies he came across, and he eventually came across Unrecorded Histories that granted him extremely beneficial knowledge!
The Unrecorded History he was gazing at this time was a particularly profound one.
{{...The process of becoming a part of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages was a sacred one.

While utilizing the Golden Havenly Recommendation granted by Extremity Laeta, Noah was allowed to become a part of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage by undergoing a process called Havenly Blood Ablation.

One's old lineage would be burned and vaporized as the Blood Source of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage would be branded into their very marrows- their being forever becoming a part of the Havenly Lineages!
{With a Golden Havenly Recommendation, you will be able to undergo Havenly Blood Ablation with a Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source.
Most beings with strong wills survive it...with the results being your Lineage fully changed to become a Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage.}
As she spoke, Laeta walked with Noah across an elevated platform radiating rivers of Dissolution.
At the very peak of this platform, there was an obsidian crystalline path that led into a circular sea that was the size of a small world!
Golden Blood Source filled with minute traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority could be seen within this enclosed space- a heart-shaking aura releasing from this flowing blood ahead!
Enclosed areas like these could be seen stretched out across this space as the others were not as full, with the volume of Blood Source being very limited.

{The Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source...although the gains you will make are not going to be as much as Obsidian or Crimson Havenly Animalia Blood, the processes involving those are not things the current you can afford.
Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineages have to pay a minimum of 10 Havenly Notes of Extremity just for the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood in order to undergo their Second Bloodline Ablation.}
Her voice traveled far as the gorgeous stellar landscape of Dissolution around them shimmered, Noah's will catching the sight of a massive enclosure of Havenly Animalia Blood Source!
But this was darker.
Denser.
Filled with a shocking amount of possibilities and many more streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
But to even gain access to it, 10 Havenly Notes had to be paid!
This was equivalent to 100,000 Units of Havenly Aurora!
It was something far outside his current scope of power.
And yet when Noah gazed at it from afar...he couldn't help but form a devilish smile.
He wondered...if this current reality was a future that was playing out and being watched by his Soul in a distant past, would he be able to do something outrageous?...}}
The Unrecorded History was a unique one.
Even Noah's thoughts in this Unrecorded History were fantastical ones as truly, his future self thought the same as his past self!
His Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum gazed at the playing Unrecorded History as in the next moment....
{Hyperversal Plundering}.
BZZT!
A bejeweled illusory golden hand formed in the skies of the emerging scene.
Its target was a unique one as it domineeringly hovered over the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source that Extremity Laeta and Noah could only gaze at from a distance!
{You are attempting to Plunder and Unrecorded History!}
{The authorities involved are at a high enough Tier.}
{The target of Plundering is at a manageable Tier.}
The glorious golden hand came down as its fingers pinched.

The History of the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source trembled as moments after, the brilliant light cascaded all around as Noah's Soul Values were squeezed out along with seas of Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Values!
But the end result was a mighty one.
{You have succeeded in Plundering the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea!}
A singularity of wonder emerged as a vast Obsidian Sea was transported towards his Vaults of Quintessence.
Around them, the concentration of the authority of Dissolution only became heavier as they passed multiple gorgeous floating Archipelagos.

Each of them were Golden Havenly Archipelagos as after a few hours of Noah getting a view of the vastness of the Supernal Havens of Dissolution, they were finally arriving at their target as ahead of them...a floating island more massive than any of the ones observed beforehand bloomed!
It was no longer the size of a plane as the light years it extended all around were enough to make it a Minor Haven.

Drizzling gorgeous black waterfalls of emerge fell from its edges and dripped down as above it, a massive singularity spinning and collecting Vitalis Hyperversal Authority while mixing it with potent Authority of Dissolution to produce even grander Havenly Treasures could be seen.
{The first Obsidian Havenly Archipelago after the clusters of Golden Havenly Archipelagos in this region.
It is a center point of power as here, we can find a Branch of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity.
The Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago.}
The Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago!
One couldn't see an array of vessels or guards surrounding it as there was truly no need to.

It was still one of the most protected domains because at this very moment, one could feel an overwhelming and silent aura of a Hyperversal Extremity spread out constantly around the Obsidian Havenly Archipelago!
Its might and grandeur...was not something a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity could release.

Seeing Noah's eyes, Extremity Laeta smiled as they entered the area of effect of the spread out will and landed on the floating landmass that looked like a paradisical domain filled with an array of vegetation and tall rising structures pulsing with Dissolution.
{Oh yes, the Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago is overseen by a Havenly Saurischian Lord Commander.

Their presence here is not just for the monitoring of Havenly Treasures that only those of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages are allowed to obtain, but truly here for the Branch of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity.
They are a personage that has undergone Havenly Awakening}
WAA!
The explosive words were heavy ones to hear as they arrived at a shocking location

chapters.title: Chapter 2638 Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor! II
paragraphs: Even with the dangerous words that relayed the identity of the extremely powerful being overseeing this location, Noah's heart didn't steer as he maintained his sense of calm.

Even he couldn't yet fully grasp the extent of power a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity held when Existences such as the Adjudicator of Dissolution at the Zenith Tier 3 level were already so unbelievably powerful.
Their means and power were approaching the peak of power of the Nether Havens of Extremity and the Supernal Havens of Extremity from all the information Noah had collected so far!
And yet even while stepping into a domain that had the eyes of such an entity covering everything, he didn't worry.

His confidence didn't stem from the Quintessential Absolute Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity being able to cover him- but his Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians and his Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians!
Their product of him becoming an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable Existence!
Who else had survived millions of cycles of death until their soul accepted both the Awakenings of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority?
The only sliver of worry Noah held came to other Existences who had undergone Vitalis Awakening.
Would he or they be able to recognize like existences?
Even this, he was only being more cautious as his eyes swept across the Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago he had arrived in.

Here, he could see many more variations of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineages as keeping in line with the specific Lineage of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity keeping watch in this region, there were many Saurischians here in addition to Smilodons, Titanoboas, Dragonflies, and a few other Havenly Lineages!

{Many Havenly Lineages converge in this Archipelago for business and pleasure, and we'll likely see more Underdwellers converging here as they get acclimated to the Supernal Haven of Dissolution. The more prominent ones can fight for recognition to become part of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages or make deals with the Havenly Beasts here for what they want. Though the cost of Havenly Aurora they will have to pay will be high!}
The reality around them constantly changed as Laeta utilized her Hyperversal Extremity Authority to quickly take them through the periphery of the Havenly Archipelago as they entered its depths.

They only came to a stop in front of a massive structure built with reinforced black metals radiating Dissolution, a massive dome covering this architectural wonder as huge double doors were open with a few Havenly Beasts entering in and out constantly.
Most were at the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level as some adorned humanoid forms while others kept their beastial forms!
The building ahead of them that rose up to be as vast as a Large World held the label {Havenly Bloodline Ablation Center}.

Extremity Laeta pulled Noah into such a grand building as the moment they crossed the double doors, the reality around them changed as they entered an area that held floating 81 kiosks that looked like vibrant Singularities- the auras of 36 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities being behind 36 of these kiosks as the other 45 were occupied by top tier Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
Some Havenly Beasts were already in front of these kiosks discussing their own matters as Laeta went towards one of the 36 kiosks occupied by a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity with a smile.
{Little Sister Ruby, the benefits of working for the Havenly Vaults of Extremity must really be enticing for you to still be working here after all these years.}

Her figure morphed to a gorgeous humanoid form as the visage behind the kiosk she addressed was an utterly stunning woman with light crimson hair, an air of power and authority wrapping around her as her blessed chest threatened to spill out of the black robe Extremity Relic she wore!
Gorgeous freckles covered her face as she smiled with an annoyed expression while replying.
{Big Sister Laeta, are you here on business or pleasure?}
{Bah, business. Here's a Golden Havenly Recommendation for my young friend behind me.}
Laeta waved her hands to pull out a scroll of golden light that Extremity Ruby accepted, nodding and causing it to disappear in her hands as she turned towards Noah with a professional smile.

{A recommendation that grants you the right to utilize a Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea to undergo the Havenly Blood Ablation for free. If my friend here has yet to tell you, it is a process that entirely replaces your current Bloodline and replaces it with the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage. There are minimal risks associated with it but...do you wish to proceed?}
The employee of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity spoke towards Noah calmly as he nodded.
A process that would erase his current Lineage? Noah smiled at such a thought.
'Would Quintessence truly allow for it to be burned out of existence?'
A grand question whose answer would be revealed soon enough!
With Noah's agreement, a black portal soon formed beside the floating kiosk they were standing in front of, Extremity Ruby pointing towards it and voicing out with a smile.
{Name?}
Noah raised his brows at this as the Extremity before him continued calmly.

{Your identity is entirely protected and assured by the authority of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity. Even a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity cannot forcefully attain your information without your permission. You can also use a pseudonym you wish to go by instead.}
Her words were serene as Noah's bright eyes smiled while replying.
"A pseudonym it is then. Indefatigable."
WAA!
Indefatigable!

The word raised the brows of the two Extremities here as Laeta laughed lightly, but Extremity Ruby materialized a feathered pen that pulsed with the authority of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as she began to write down.

{It shall be recorded that Extremity Laeta of the Havenly Smilodon Lineage was the backer for the Entity with the Pseudonym Indefatigable. Any grand Achievement he attains in the future or any large transactions through the Havenly Vaults of Extremity will generate proceeds to Extremity Laeta, and if significant enough, even towards the Havenly Smilodon Lineage.}
The reason for someone at Extremity Laeta's caliber or even the other Extremities who wanted to have Noah join their factions after they saw his actions with Havenly Authority!
If he turned out to be a major player in the future- they would benefit greatly from it!
After recording this down, Extremity Ruby smiled and nodded towards Noah while pointing to the obsidian portal beside her.
{I wish you success and offer you congratulations in advance for joining one of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages.}

Her status as an Employee of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity trumped everything else as this existence led with cordiality, Extremity Laeta shaking her head at this while pulling Noah along, her head turning back briefly towards her friend.
{Tell me what new benefits they added for you guys working here. I may just join you for the next few years.}
At this, Extremity Ruby only smiled and nodded.
Noah and Extremity Laeta disappeared past the portal and appeared in a brand new location where the auras of Tier 2 and 3 Hyperversal Extremities were abundant.
Rivers of Dissolution flowed as around them, the earth was raised into small mountains that acted like roads leading to pools of viscous golden light.

Some were fully filled while others were half or barely filled, with streams of Dissolution slowly being gathered into these pools as minute traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority were also attracted into it!

The level they were in showed many Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas as just like Noah had seen in the Unrecorded History, events began to play out with little variation as Laeta talked about the Blood Source Seas, up until the scene of them walking up one of the elevated mountainous platforms that had a gold sea in front of them.
The scene of the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea in the distance that Noah had plundered in an Unrecorded History faded from his sight.

{Alright, I've taken you as far as I can. I don't expect you to fail...but take a dip in the Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea. When you come out, you will have been purged of all your lesser bloodlines as your marrows will course with a Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineage, granting you a profound edge over others in your path to Extremity!}
