chapters.title: Chapter 2639 Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor! III
paragraphs: 2639 Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor! III
The purging of all of his lesser bloodlines as his bone marrows themselves would produce the makeup of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage thereafter!
These were the words of Extremity Laeta, as well as the expectation for how all of the processes of Havenly Bloodline Ablation went.
Standing on the precipice of the mountainous platforms, a smile became etched on the face of Extremity Laeta as she spoke teasingly while seeing Noah's calm gaze.
[Haha, are you getting a little sentimental to say goodbye to your old bloodlines? Don't look at this as losing something, but instead as a process of gaining something much, much grander.]
As she spoke, she bent down and dipped her fair fingers into the edges of the Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source in front of them as she spoke with remembrance.

[I've undergone the Second Advancement of the Havenly Animalia Bloodline Ablation that utilized the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source. Just having this made it so that my rate of progression towards Extremity was increased by 1,000%, the success rate of converging Absolute Dynamis of Extremity more than doubled, along with many more minute boosts to my existence all around- but the most astonishing boon for having one of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages is the fact that in your blood...
you will now have Havenly Authority flowing through you!]
WAA!
One would have Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing within their blood.

All the existences of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages held traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing within them- the concentrations greatly differing as it would truly only be significant enough if they underwent a Second Bloodline Advancement with Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source!

[So do not despair in losing something you hold dear. Know that after this, with Havenly Authority running through your veins...your chances of undergoing a Havenly Awakening will go from 0% to a numerical value that at the very least gives you a chance. Of course, one of your goals should be what my goal is currently...to collect enough Units of Havenly Aurora to undergo a Third Bloodline Advancement with Crimson Havenly Animalia Blood Source. A measly 5 Million Units of Havenly Aurora, or the equivalent of 500 Havenly Notes of Extremity...]
She shook her head as she spoke of this and pulled her fingers out.
Her eyes nudged Noah as his lips curved into a silent smile, his now humanoid figure losing the loose obsidian shirt as his chest was laid bare.

The gorgeously sculpted shoulders, pectoral muscles, and abdominal muscles seemed like the layering of celestial metal fibers as half of his body soon became covered with the blaringly stellar golden liquid.

He went deeper into the Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea as tendrils of viscous golden liquid began to rise and react with his body as if they were tendrils of lightning, his figure giving off a grand feel of an ancient entity as the golden sea around him soon began to churn and swirl with him at the very center, even more tendrils beginning to form and surge towards him as they sought access into his body!
The process of the Havenly Bloodline Ablation was about to begin.

And yet as his Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable was taking a dip in a Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea, his main body in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was doing something else entirely!

His main body had briefly taken an existence from the council that was meeting to design a deadly virus for Hyperversal Extremities, his figure currently standing around a gorgeous obsidian region that had spinning obsidian Cosmos filled with the authority of Dissolution all around him.

It was the newly enacted Dissolution Aletheian Haven that was still being built even now as at the center of his proliferating Haven, Noah waved his hands to take out the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea he had plundered from an Unrecorded History.
WAA!

It came out into the open as it was vast, the much greater concentrations of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within it making Noah's body begin to buzz as he could also feel a dense concentration of Dissolution...along with a trace amount of the Authority of the Six other Supernal Havens of Extremity!
"The change that makes Havely Lineages intricately connected to the Supernal Havens of Extremity..."
Noah spoke with a smile as his body descended into the center of the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea, its calmness instantly interrupted as it began to seethe.

At this very same moment, in the Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea far away, the tendrils of golden viscous liquid surged into his Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable as a moment after, this liquid traversed across the bounds of space and time through the connection Noah shared with his Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable as streams of gold began to appear in his Main Body!
They appeared at the same time as the stellar obsidian gold liquid he had plundered also began to pierce into his body and seek the origin of his blood.

It was like tendrils of flames coursing through him as wondrously, he was undergoing both the First Bloodline Advancement and Second Bloodline Advancement of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage at the same time!
[A pristine and highly potent Bloodline Source is entering your Aspects of Existence.]
It didn't just enter his body.
It also thought to proliferate into his Origin and Soul as they were part of and boosted by his Bloodline!
And the gold of the Bloodline Source in all this...

[The potent Bloodline Source burns with a profound authority as it seeks to scorch and erase the records of your current Bloodlines while making itself the dominant and only present Bloodline within your Existence!]
Havenly Bloodline Ablation.
The process was a serious one as Ablation truly meant erasing everything about one's old lineage!
And nobody could truly stop this as the viscous Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea surging and entering Noah's body at this moment held something that made such a process possible.
It made the obsidian and golden viscous tendrils of liquid spread so quickly within one's body that it was terrifying.
It was Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!

It came out into the open as it was vast, the much greater concentrations of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within it making Noah's body begin to buzz as he could also feel a dense concentration of Dissolution...along with a trace amount of the Authority of the Six other Supernal Havens of Extremity!
"The change that makes Havely Lineages intricately connected to the Supernal Havens of Extremity..."
Noah spoke with a smile as his body descended into the center of the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea, its calmness instantly interrupted as it began to seethe.

At this very same moment, in the Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea far away, the tendrils of golden viscous liquid surged into his Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable as a moment after, this liquid traversed across the bounds of space and time through the connection Noah shared with his Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable as streams of gold began to appear in his Main Body!
They appeared at the same time as the stellar obsidian gold liquid he had plundered also began to pierce into his body and seek the origin of his blood.

It was like tendrils of flames coursing through him as wondrously, he was undergoing both the First Bloodline Advancement and Second Bloodline Advancement of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage at the same time!
[A pristine and highly potent Bloodline Source is entering your Aspects of Existence.]
It didn't just enter his body.
It also thought to proliferate into his Origin and Soul as they were part of and boosted by his Bloodline!
And the gold of the Bloodline Source in all this...

[The potent Bloodline Source burns with a profound authority as it seeks to scorch and erase the records of your current Bloodlines while making itself the dominant and only present Bloodline within your Existence!]
Havenly Bloodline Ablation.
The process was a serious one as Ablation truly meant erasing everything about one's old lineage!
And nobody could truly stop this as the viscous Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea surging and entering Noah's body at this moment held something that made such a process possible.
It made the obsidian and golden viscous tendrils of liquid spread so quickly within one's body that it was terrifying.
It was Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!

chapters.title: Chapter 2640 Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor! IV
paragraphs: 2640 Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor! IV
[The Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within the Havenly Animalia Blood Source has entrenched and anchored onto your existence and current Lineage.]
[The Havenly Animalia Blood Source is targeting your Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage!]

[The mixture of the Havenly Animalia Blood Source, Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, and the Authorities of the Supernal Havens have located Records of your Lineage as they begin the process of Havenly Bloodline Ablation!]
The mixture of three different Authorities.
As Noah monitored the fantastical changes occurring within his body, his mind also blared as his eyes shone with a shocking light at this moment!
It was because...he was experiencing a phenomenon firsthand that caused millions of computations to bloom in his soul.

It was because he experienced the process of a foreign authority- the Golden and Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source...entering his existence and proliferating very quickly across all of his Aspects of Existence, even to the extent that they located the Records of his Lineage that they sought to purge in order to establish the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage!
Was this...not what he wanted the virus he was designing as a weapon against Hyperversal Extremities to be?!
To be capable of even affecting the Recorded History of Hyperversal Extremities?!

The moment this thought came, his existence felt like it was being scorched inside out as the Havenly Animalia Blood Source became akin to a blazing flaming sea, seeking to dominate and erase everything about Noah's lineage.
Everything about Quintessence.
And at such a juncture, a rousing, booming roar emerged as it felt like an ancient celestial entity awakening.
The trillions of cells that made Noah's blood came to life as they shone with multicolored radiance.
They shone with profound Quintessence as filled with an Innate authority of utmost majesty, they roared out their denial!
[The Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage expresses great superbity at the authority trying to erase it!]
[The Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage fights for its sovereignty and clashes against the Havenly Animalia Blood Source seeking its eradication!]
Extremity Laeta truly believed something that was set in stone and that everybody went through to be the same for Noah.
She truly expected his Lineage to be purged and erased out of existence!

At this moment, Quintessence said otherwise as it rose with glorious splendor, pulling upon its very concept, the Dynamis it was connected to, and all of Noah's Soul and Aspects of Existence it was spread across.
It fought for its sovereignty!
But the other side had terrifyingly profound authority.
[The Havenly Animalia Blood Source erupts with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to accomplish its purpose.]

Noah's body was akin to a battlefield as at this moment, the thick streams of Havenly Animalia Blood Source countered the rising grandeur of Quintessence, Vitalis Hyperversal Authority rising and protecting its dominant advancement as it began to burn Quintessence!
HOONG!
And such an action was received with extreme prejudice as Noah's Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage erupted with magisterial grandeur.
Quintessence.
It wasn't just a part of Noah.
It quite literally flowed in everything about him.
All of his other concepts of Extremity held Quintessence within them.
His Dynamis.
His Foundation.
His Heart.
His Havenly Organ.
His Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians...and his Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians.
Quintessence flowed pervasively within them!
And at this moment as its enemy sought to prove it by bringing up Vitalis Hyperversal Authority....
BZZT!
The Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians within Noah's body began to tremble forcefully.

Quintessence battled for its life and glory as with shocking tyranny and majesty...it emphatically pulled on the Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians as tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority instantly erupted from it!
It pulled on the authority Noah could not and would not be able to actively control until he had his Second Vitalis Awakening!

It fought fire with fire as since there was a decent concentration of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority in the Obsidian and Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas, it pulled upon the pure concentrated streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within Noah's Meridians and used them as Sword to cut across the might of the Havenly Animalia Blood Source, erasing its dominance as after it lay unprotected...
OOH!
Quintessence bellowed out as it ate up the Havenly Animalia Blood Source.
It devoured and assimilated it to become a part of Quintessence as a raging battle unfolded!
At the same time, the Havenly Animalia Blood Source realized that it was failing to achieve its purpose.
Instead of purging and erasing the records of a bloodline within a host, it was actually the one being erased.
Something undeniable then rose in the depths of this Blood Source.
Animalia.
Apart from it, there were Plantae, Riboviria, and Celestia.
They made up the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages!

Within the Havenly Animalia Blood Source, the profound and undeniable grandeur of Animalia was roused and enraged at its authority actually being denied against a bloodline it had never come across before.
And this bloodline actually erupted with dense and pure concentrations of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
It could not stand for this.
It could not stand to fail, especially as it was the one getting devoured and assimilated by this foreign bloodline at this moment!
But...to gain dominance once more, it needed to have more Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
And the streams continued in the Obsidian and Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas currently surging into the body of this ridiculous Entity were not enough.
And yet the Havenly Animalia Blood Source did not have the authority to quickly amass and control Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
In this case...it could only call in more parts of itself.
And so.
Within the depths of the Havenly Bloodline Ablation Center.

Extremity Laeta was watching with interested eyes as Noah's figure had already reduced the Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea by half, everything proceeding as usual as at this time, Laeta expected this being before her to have his bloodline entirely changed to Animalia!
'Indefatigable is a grand aspiration, but it is hard for one to stand out above others in these Supernal Have-'
BOOM!
Her thoughts were stopped short.

The Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea she was looking at instantly erupted with fervor as if it were enraged, and in the gorgeous stellar surroundings where clusters of encirclements with some fully filled, half filled, and some almost empty Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas were...an explosive attractive force erupted out as these calm seas instantly formed into tendrils of massive rivers of effulgent light that surged towards the half depleted Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea that Noah's figure was in!

chapters.title: Chapter 2641 Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor! V
paragraphs: 2641 Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor! V
A commotion in the domain where Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas were cultivated!

The Havenly Bloodline Ablation Center was a massive structure, with spatial runic circles filled with Hyperversal Extremity Authority etched throughout it as the domain spaces within it were far faster than even the building itself.
Within, domains light years in size were contained!
The region that Noah was granted entry to was one of the many Golden Ablation Domains that held Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas.
Above it was an Obsidian Ablation Domain that Extremities could only gaze at from below!
But within the Golden Ablation Domain Noah was in, there were 81 Animalia Blood Source Seas.
At this moment, it didn't matter if there was another existence undergoing their First Bloodline Advancement or if the viscous golden seas were barely filled.
Every single one formed into glorious stellar rivers that snaked out to pierce into the body of a single being!
A being that Extremity Laeta was standing at the edges of the Blood Sea while gazing with a stupefied expression that soon turned cautious.
An instant later, space around her shimmered as the crimson-haired visage of Extremity Ruby appeared beside her.
[You're making trouble in one of the Ablation Domains I manage...what exactly was the thing that made you grant this being a Havenly Recommendation?]
The two Extremities didn't stop the occurring process as they observed closely, Laeta's eyes squinting as she spoke cautiously.

[His first time operating a Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi generated thousands of Units of Havenly Aurora- something only Extremities are capable of. I thought he possessed an Aspect of Existence that just had a greater inclination and attraction towards Havenly Hyperversal Authority. That investing in him before he even became an Extremity would yield a positive return. But this...this is more than just an inclination....]
WAA!

The surging golden streams of bloody light all tumbled forth as if they were in a hurry to enter his body- as if the very Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source was moving with autonomy to achieve something within his body!
The figure of Extremity Ruby that had just appeared had her eyes glazed with golden light as spoke.

"For his body to naturally and forcefully attract the Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea like this, he either has an Innate Constitution or Foundation that is very conducive to Havely Authority, or he has somehow already stepped on the Road of Havenly Awakening.]
She released a few possibilities to explain what was happening before them.
The Road of Havenly Awakening!
What every being had to step on as their bodies slowly accumulated more and more Havenly Authority until...they proceeded with their First Havenly Awakening.
As for the possibility that this Apex Aeonic Lifeform had somehow already attained the First Havenly Awakening? This was something too farfetched to even entertain!
One had to be a Hyperversal Extremity for such a grand accomplishment. This was a type of logic akin to light and darkness. Akin to night and day. Akin to life and death.

It had never been violated across Recorded History, nor would it be something violated by an Apex Aeonic Lifeform that was a full Underdweller mere moments ago- a being from the Nether Havens of Extremity that held a very limited access to Havenly Authority!
As Extremety Ruby finished her words, Laeta smiled brightly while continuing to gaze at the scene ahead with great attention.

[My investment may just pay off to be something grand. An Innate Inclination towards Havenly Authority or already an existence that has embarked on the Road of Havenly Awakening...it is something envious even for me and you!]
Even they, as Extremities...had not embarked on the Road of Havenly Awakening.
The Havenly Authority within their Aspects of Existence and flowing through their Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineages had remained stagnant and immovable even now!
They had Havenly Authority flowing within them in trace amounts, and yet they couldn't will even an iota of it to ever move according to their will.

For any being who was lucky or talented enough to be capable of storing the Havenly Authority within their bloodline vessels- within their meridians....they had embarked on the Road of Havenly Awakening.
The formation of complete Havenly Meridians was indicative of an existence undergoing their First Havenly Awakening!
They were not even close to this.
They gazed towards Noah's visage with looks of expectations and unveiled envy as Ruby abruptly spoke amidst all this.
[Oh, I'll be putting all the Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas being pulled towards him on your tab by the way. Your investment, your responsibility.]
The words instantly roused Laeta as her dark hair shimmered with incredulousness.
[The hell I am...you want me to go broke? I should be getting remuneration for discovering someone like this instead!]
While their wills observed with rapt attention, the two Extremities talked amongst themselves as even they didn't know something even more crucial occurring within Noah's body.

They didn't know that the Blood Source Seas converging towards him were doing so because his current Lineage was actually devouring and assimilating the Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage!
And as the Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage began this process, its standing also began to rise.
[The Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage has begun its ascension towards becoming a Havenly Lineage!]

Instead of it being purged out of existence, it had turned the tables and continued to devour every ounce of Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas that came in- with Noah's main body making the most rapid gains by devouring the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea.

Even as larger quantities of the Havenly Animalia Blood Source flowed in, the trace amounts of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority couldn't compare to the readily available reserves of pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority contained in Noah's meridians.
It was akin to more and more fuel being added to an ever-burning flame that only devoured and assimilated with greater intensity!
It was to the extent that all of the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Sea entirely disappeared into Noah's body- not a single drop missed.
And the 81 Blood Seas in the domain within the Ablation Center were also quickly drying up as...
[The Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage is being born through sheer and unabated Quintessence!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2642 Primitive Vitalis Manipulation!
paragraphs: 2642 Primitive Vitalis Manipulation!
A Havenly Lineage.

The Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage granted beings like Extremity Laeta boosts to their rate of progression towards Extremity and more, and Noah was devouring and assimilating such a lineage to elevate his own!
At this point in time, the flow of quite literally everything within him felt unabated and free.

This was because the moment of its formation, he felt the uncontrollable Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that had only been ushered forth to move by unique instances...he felt his connection with such an authority strengthen in an unimaginable manner- as if he had crossed a gateway of an absolutely endless path!
And this change was ushered forth by Quintessence.
[The 16th Boundary Layer of Quintessence has revised an additional feature to its standing.]
[The Feature of Primitive Vitalis Manipulation has been generated through the 16th Boundary Layer of Quintessence!]
[You have gained an extremely rudimentary, low level of control of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority before your Second Vitalis Awakening!]
His cells cried out with euphoria.

His whole existence felt like it had taken a step forward as his swathes of Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage blood flowed within him like roaring rivers across his vessels and Aspects of Existence, and they carried with them Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
They cycled Vitalis Hyperversal Authority across Noah's Aspects of Existence- this authority no longer being contained in the Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians.
And when Noah focused on the glorious streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority...
His will descended on the raging streams of Vitalis coursing within his Blood as when he beckoned...
BZZT!
A small, miniscule, snaking stream of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority deviated from its flow as it followed Noah's will.
This was Primitive Vitalis Manipulation!
It was small.
It was Primitive.
But it was manipulation nonetheless!
The manipulation of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority was something that should have only become available at the Second Vitalis Awakening.
That was how astonishing the actions of Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage were as one of its first boons was a small yet significant manipulation of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
And what did this translate to?
It meant that he now had a controlled methodology and vessel to transport his poisonous virus being forged to infect Hyperversal Extremities!
And in addition to this...
[The Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage has been recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]

[When a Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Blood Source is extracted from you and placed into a targeted existence, it is possible to alter the Lineage of a targeted existence entirely by altering their records. Depending on the potency of the extracted Blood Source, the target can gain a different level of purity of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.]
His Lineage was solely shared by his close family members as others did not enjoy the benefit of the Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor.
And yet now...Noah could spread his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Source onto his Vassals as he could grant them a semblance of his lineage!
A semblance of Quintessence.

This was the way it was supposed to be utilized. But...if Noah took it into an entirely different direction and used his Blood Source wrapped with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to carry a poison into his enemies- would this not achieve what he wished so long as he tweaked to make sure his enemies would only attain destruction and nothing else?
All of these were currently possibilities.

But the sheer fact that his Lineage could be spread freely left behind shocking implications as he thought of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages that were widespread across the Supernal Havens of Extremity...and just who would be benefiting from these Lineages the most.
He had to ask this question because of the next prompt that followed.

[Whenever an existence with the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage gains any achievements towards Extremity and scales past the Gradations of Extremity, you and those with an extreme level of purity within this lineage will obtain increasingly purer concentrations of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority reinforced into your Aspects of Existence.]
The authority that could be considered the most important thing within the Seven Havens- whether it was the Nether Havens or the Supernal Havens.
It could be attained with even greater and purer concentrations from the mere achievements of others of his Lineage.
It also shed light on the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages.
It showed that at the very top of these lineages...there were some extremely terrifying beings that had been getting baptized by Vitalis Hyperversal Authority for a great number of years!
Noah...would only just be starting now.

His body continued to cycle the blood of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage across his existence as any Havenly Animalia Blood Source still flowing in was quickly burnt and devoured- this fight being on its last death throes unless an even greater concentration of this Blood Source entered Noah's body.
But prompts continued to come as this elevated Lineage truly settled within Noah!
[As the Progenitor of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, you express the boon of 100,000% Increased Rate of Progression towards and past Extremity.]
[The Innate Lineage Ability of the Illuminating Light of Quintessence has been born!]

[Illuminating Light of Quintessence]:: A holder of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage is able to activate the Illuminating Light of Quintessence at the cost of 50% of the Soul Values. While under this Illuminating Light, the convergence of Concepts of Extremity will be guaranteed to succeed for 9 Concepts or Less, and those with a profound level of purity of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage can even converge 21 Concepts of Extremity with a high chance of success. The Progenitor of this Lineage is now able to converge up to 36 Concepts of Extremity into a single Dynamis of Extremity...
[The Innate Lineage Ability of Havenly Quintessential Animalia Entity Form has been born!]
One after another.
The prompts rained down with glory as they ushered the advent of a stupendous Havenly Lineage.
A lineage that stepped on the limelight by devouring the Source of an already existing Havenly Extremity Lineage!

A Havenly Lineage.

The Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage granted beings like Extremity Laeta boosts to their rate of progression towards Extremity and more, and Noah was devouring and assimilating such a lineage to elevate his own!
At this point in time, the flow of quite literally everything within him felt unabated and free.

This was because the moment of its formation, he felt the uncontrollable Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that had only been ushered forth to move by unique instances...he felt his connection with such an authority strengthen in an unimaginable manner- as if he had crossed a gateway of an absolutely endless path!
And this change was ushered forth by Quintessence.
[The 16th Boundary Layer of Quintessence has revised an additional feature to its standing.]
[The Feature of Primitive Vitalis Manipulation has been generated through the 16th Boundary Layer of Quintessence!]
[You have gained an extremely rudimentary, low level of control of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority before your Second Vitalis Awakening!]
His cells cried out with euphoria.

His whole existence felt like it had taken a step forward as his swathes of Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage blood flowed within him like roaring rivers across his vessels and Aspects of Existence, and they carried with them Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
They cycled Vitalis Hyperversal Authority across Noah's Aspects of Existence- this authority no longer being contained in the Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians.
And when Noah focused on the glorious streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority...
His will descended on the raging streams of Vitalis coursing within his Blood as when he beckoned...
BZZT!
A small, miniscule, snaking stream of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority deviated from its flow as it followed Noah's will.
This was Primitive Vitalis Manipulation!
It was small.
It was Primitive.
But it was manipulation nonetheless!
The manipulation of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority was something that should have only become available at the Second Vitalis Awakening.
That was how astonishing the actions of Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage were as one of its first boons was a small yet significant manipulation of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
And what did this translate to?
It meant that he now had a controlled methodology and vessel to transport his poisonous virus being forged to infect Hyperversal Extremities!
And in addition to this...
[The Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage has been recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]

[When a Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Blood Source is extracted from you and placed into a targeted existence, it is possible to alter the Lineage of a targeted existence entirely by altering their records.

His Lineage was solely shared by his close family members as others did not enjoy the benefit of the Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor.
And yet now...Noah could spread his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Source onto his Vassals as he could grant them a semblance of his lineage!
A semblance of Quintessence.
This was the way it was supposed to be utilized.

But...if Noah took it into an entirely different direction and used his Blood Source wrapped with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to carry a poison into his enemies- would this not achieve what he wished so long as he tweaked to make sure his enemies would only attain destruction and nothing else?
All of these were currently possibilities.

But the sheer fact that his Lineage could be spread freely left behind shocking implications as he thought of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages that were widespread across the Supernal Havens of Extremity...and just who would be benefiting from these Lineages the most.
He had to ask this question because of the next prompt that followed.

The authority that could be considered the most important thing within the Seven Havens- whether it was the Nether Havens or the Supernal Havens.
It could be attained with even greater and purer concentrations from the mere achievements of others of his Lineage.

chapters.title: Chapter 2643 Splendiferous! I
paragraphs: 2643 Splendiferous! I
Many prompts cascaded down with the advent of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, with some of them shedding light of truly grand things to come in the future.
Any holder of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage...was guaranteed to be capable of forming Absolute Dynamis of Extremity with 9 Concepts or Less!
Any!
And for those with a great level of purity of such a lineage like his Son...
Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity could be forged as the upper tier of converged boundaries was brought to 21.
This alone was worthy to make any lineage the backbone of the Seven Havens, and yet this was only a singular feature of Noah's lineage!
Then, there was the term Gradations of Extremity introduced in the description of what Noah as the Progenitor of this Lineage would benefit from.
Gradations of Extremity!
They should relate to the different Tiers of Hyperversal Extremities, and why some beings were segmented into Tier 1, 2, 3, or 4.
What was truly crucial was just how these stages were demarcated...and the fact that Noah's lineage will grant benefits to him whenever existences scale towards and past the Gradations of Extremity!
It meant he needed to spread his Lineage far and wide.
To spread it towards Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Hyperversal Extremities alike!
And with the boons of such a lineage...would it truly be such a hard thing to do?

Just like how there was the Havenly Animalia Bloodline Ablation Center where beings were granted a Havenly Bloodline and knew they would gain boosts to aid them ever closer to Extremity, he could do something even more profound.

If he approached a Hyperversal Extremity and told them to take into their Aspects of Existence an extracted Blood Source that would further aid them across the Gradations of Extremity and improve their power...why would they deny it?
As he thought of this, Noah's brilliant eyes swirling with multicolored blood of Quintessence shone.
His thoughts naturally went to the poor and hungry.
The Cult of Endless Shadows that had just lost their Armament of Extremity and dreams of becoming a genuine Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity!
They held unbound anger towards the Avernus Clan, and yet they couldn't do a single thing against their power if the Senatus of Extremity didn't enforce the rules.

And with the advent of the Culmination Step of Dissolution that led to the opening of the Supernal Havens of Extremity...everything else had taken a back burner as nobody cared or even mentioned how the Investiture of Extremity was immensely violated just days ago by one of the Seven Clans.
As Noah thought about the Cult of Endless Shadows and felt the continued changes of his unfolding Lineage, he couldn't help but form a devilish smile!

[The Values of Hyperversal Dignity and Hyperversal Mastery are generated for all those with the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, with greater values correlating with the level of purity.]
[The Innate Progenitor Exclusive Lineage Ability of Havenly Quintessential Link has been born!]

[Havenly Quintessential Link]:: Across space and time, across Walls of Realities and Dimensions...this ability allows for only you as the Progenitor of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage to share the senses of any chosen existence carrying your lineage. Through the link of blood, you can even go a step further to open a Havenly Bloodline Rift and appear anywhere within a thousand light years of a chosen existence carrying your lineage...
[The Innate Lineage Ability of Havenly Quintessential Obfuscation has been born!]

[Havenly Quintessential Obfuscation]:: The Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage is a grand one as everything about it can easily become the center of attention. It also holds the capability to obscure and erase any knowledge or records of oneself actively and passively. As the Progenitor, you will display this ability to the fullest, with its activation coming at no cost to you. Your Records and very existence become thin and veiled to the extent that even if you were floating next to other Existences and passing by them, their eyes would not be able to perceive you. This ability actively alters records of the unfolding reality around you as even existences that have reached the Second Tier of Hyperversal Extremity cannot bypass its veil. When you take an action against Tier 1 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities, their senses will then be capable of perceiving you as the effects of Obfuscation will only be reestablished once 5 seconds pass without another action being carried out. The extent this ability can be displayed by those with lesser purity of your lineage will determine up to which level of existence it works against. An increased accumulation of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage will allow for this feature to be elevated to an even greater stage...

The utterly ridiculous boons of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage continued to come as magisterial things like Havenly Quintessential Link and Havenly Quintessential Obfuscation came to be!
Each unfolding feature of this bloodline seemed grander than the last as after the last set of prompts, things seemed to slow down.

The incoming tendrils of Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas carried over by his Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable continued to be devoured the moment they appeared as his multicolored blood was fully in control.
It flowed with streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority as well as minute traces of the authority of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.

His body brimmed with Lifeforce and power as any remaining boons and extra features that had yet to be quantified would be known by the time everything settled and this glorious Lineage was packed full of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!

This was because even at this moment, Noah utilized Primitive Vitalis Manipulation to allow streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to flow from his Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians and into his Blood.

This would cause Vitalis to be slowly depleted within his Meiridans as thereafter, streams of unseen Vitalis Hyperversal Authority entered his Aspects of Existence to refill the missing areas within the Meridians.

And as Noah made his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage even more pure and even more filled with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority as the features yet to enfold in the future would be nothing but splendiferous wonders!

chapters.title: Chapter 2644 Splendifirous! II
paragraphs: 2644 Splendifirous! II

[The Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage has been fully assimilated into the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage as the essence of Animalia can be displayed outwardly by choice.]
Slow and steady.
Like the flow of an endless river of time.
Like the pulse of an entity that had lived through eons.

This was the feeling that Noah's Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable gave off while it began to display the effects of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage- but the feeling it gave off was that of one of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages!
Animalia.

Extremity Laeta and Ruby watched as Noah entirely drained the 81 Blood Source Seas, Ruby carefully watching the veil separating them from the Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas above to make sure they weren't affected.
Even if this existence held unknown means and potential, they couldn't freely allow him to carry out what just occurred here with something as pristine as Obsidian Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas!
That would be millions of Units of Havenly Aurora.

But after they saw the last tendrils of the Blood Source Seas disappear into him and his body begin to emanate the grandeur of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage, the two Extremities nodded with pleased expressions as Laeta was the first to speak as she looked at Noah's figure.
[He can no longer be referred to as an Underdweller...]

As she spoke, her will peered at every part of Noah as his sculpted bare chest was somehow giving off an even gender sense of magnetism, his muscles glowing with a Havenly splendor as one could almost feel the pulsing of Havenly Authority flowing within the blood coursing through these muscles!
Everything they saw was indicative of this being expressing the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage as his own blood and disposition would decide what Animalia form he would take when he transformed.
With everything calming down, Noah's bare body opened its gaze as his eyes released an animalistic sense of wonder and power!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
His Main Body opened its eyes at the same time as ever now and then, prompts continued to pass over them.
[Your Blood Source is passively extracted and channeled towards the Existences that currently carry the lesser version of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.]
The extraction of his Blood Source!

He felt his Quintessential Hyperversal Mana and Soul Values burn as a portion of his Blood was isolated and contained in a singularity- the authority of Dissolution and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority retained in this singularity as after it was formed, it warped across the lineage connection Noah held with his closest family.

Three of such Singularities were extracted as it didn't cost much for him to do this, and these three Extracted Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Blood Source Pearls went towards Henry, Adelaide, and Noah's own mother!
Their Records were about to be charged and elevated to something even grander as Noah didn't stop there.
He rose up from the swirling mist of Dissolution in the newly budding Dissolution Aletheian Haven as his figure disappeared.

Minutes ago, he had already sent word to all of his pertinent Vassals to leave their current tasks and gather their main bodies just below the newly formed Haven of Dissolution that currently looked like an expansive floating island light years in size, waterfalls of Dissolution cascading from it and drizzling onto the other Havens below as the authority of this Havenly Boundary of Extremity was slowly permeating across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
And it was part of the authorities that would be required for what was to come.

Below the Dissolution Aletheian Haven, Noah's figure reappeared as in front of him, the figures of Barbatos, Aurelia, Katelyn, Orion, Hyperion, Kazuhiko, Caesar, Oathkeeper...many of his pertinent people gazed towards him with interest, while some held looks of reverence!
Noah smiled at them as his right hand rose, Mana and Soul Values churning out gloriously as the skin of his palm split open.

Crimson gold Singularities that shone with multicolored radiance of Quintessence then began to proliferate around him and float towards the beings before him, his voice magnetic as his Extracted Blood Source Pearls were produced en masse!
[Drink.]
WAA!

When he spoke, his voice carried forth the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that was now flowing with his thick blood across his existence- his presence seeming ethereal and grander than all those here even though he had yet to achieve Extremity!
[Drink, and take a step closer to Extremity. Drink, and get ready to enter the Supernal Havens of Extremity.]
With the advent of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, Noah had to spread his Source wide and let loose the Existences seeking Extremity upon the Seven Havens.
His people...were only the first step!
In the Nether Haven of Dissolution.
In front of a small Vein Rift towards the very corner where many Inheritances and the Seven Clans were clustered, there were tendrils of Shadows in this region as the atmosphere was a heavy one!

The faces of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Hyperversal Extremities were dark and somber as these...were the remnant forces of the Cult of Endless Shadows after they called over everyone from all the branches they had.

They had sent in many of their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and even the injured Flashing Shadow who barely made it out of the battle with Extremity Blue with the help of the Shadow Extremity Overlord, and yet none of them had gained entry!
Absolutely nothing seemed to be going right for them.

They had lost their Armament of Extremity as their forces were splintered, and they could only watch from afar as the ones responsible faced no repercussions- and they couldn't even speak up as a few of the Tier 3 Hyperversal Avernus Extremities making a move would mean an end to their Inheritance!
Thus, the morale of the Cult of Endless Shadows was at an all-time low.
At such a time...
SAA!
The figure of Noah's Fantasia Aletheian Chassis appeared nearby, floating towards the cluster of existences belonging to the Cult of Endless Shadows.
His entrance caused no fluctuations as gloriously, the effects of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage were displayed fully.
The effects of Havenly Quintessential Obfuscation were displayed fully!

His figure floated close to the visage of the Primeval Elder Silas as this Apex Aeonic Lifeform and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around him did not even notice, sense, feel, nor see that there was anyone near them.
The Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage was this domineering as the reality around Noah was actively warped to fool the senses of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms inches away from him!
But this wasn't all.
Noah continued floating ahead as his grand figure near the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity who was Silas's Master.
Extremity Laos.
A Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity!

Even though he was within the lowest Gradations of Extremity, this was still a being that Noah could currently not do anything again as if they made a move against him, they would be able to kill his clones over and over again.
Noah couldn't yet contend with such a being, and yet at this moment...he came to float inches away from this Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity.
He saw the wrinkles of worry and uncertainty on his face.
He saw the coiling tendrils of Hyperversal Extremity around his body.
He looked straight into the eyes of this Hyperversal Extremity...and this being could not perceive him.
This being didn't even know that Noah was standing right there!
The possibilities and applications of this unfolding reality...were too glorious to even imagine!

They had lost their Armament of Extremity as their forces were splintered, and they could only watch from afar as the ones responsible faced no repercussions- and they couldn't even speak up as a few of the Tier 3 Hyperversal Avernus Extremities making a move would mean an end to their Inheritance!
Thus, the morale of the Cult of Endless Shadows was at an all-time low.
At such a time...
SAA!
The figure of Noah's Fantasia Aletheian Chassis appeared nearby, floating towards the cluster of existences belonging to the Cult of Endless Shadows.
His entrance caused no fluctuations as gloriously, the effects of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage were displayed fully.
The effects of Havenly Quintessential Obfuscation were displayed fully!

His figure floated close to the visage of the Primeval Elder Silas as this Apex Aeonic Lifeform and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around him did not even notice, sense, feel, nor see that there was anyone near them.
The Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage was this domineering as the reality around Noah was actively warped to fool the senses of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms inches away from him!
But this wasn't all.
Noah continued floating ahead as his grand figure near the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity who was Silas's Master.
Extremity Laos.
A Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity!

Even though he was within the lowest Gradations of Extremity, this was still a being that Noah could currently not do anything again as if they made a move against him, they would be able to kill his clones over and over again.
Noah couldn't yet contend with such a being, and yet at this moment...he came to float inches away from this Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity.
He saw the wrinkles of worry and uncertainty on his face.
He saw the coiling tendrils of Hyperversal Extremity around his body.
He looked straight into the eyes of this Hyperversal Extremity...and this being could not perceive him.
This being didn't even know that Noah was standing right there!
The possibilities and applications of this unfolding reality...were too glorious to even imagine!

chapters.title: Chapter 2645 Isn't it unfair? I
paragraphs: 2645 Isn't it unfair? I
He stared at a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity, and this being didn't even know he was there!
That was how astonishing the power brought about by his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage was!

The feature of Havenly Quintessential Obfuscation was simply that obscene as just imagine if he was actually capable of damaging a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity...and he could arrive right in front of them without their knowledge.
Or whenever he finishes the poisonous virus he wanted to create...he could integrate and infect a being before they could even react!
Many possibilities and ideas bloomed with this terrifying feature as Noah moved in after gazing at a Hyperversal Extremity who couldn't even notice him.

His figure moved past other legions of Shadowlings and Apex Aeonic Shadow Elders, bypassing multiple more Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities as he even passed inches away from Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities!
And still, nothing.

When such a reality played out, it truly made it seem like he was an entirely different Lifeform on another plane of existence compared to those around him, to the extent that even to the best of their abilities...they wouldn't even realize his existence unless he wanted them to.
That is until...
[Hmm?]
The senses of the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities ahead noticed an incongruency.

The Flashing Shadow and The Shadow Extremity Overlord were the first ones to turn and gaze towards Noah's direction as their expressions changed, even more so when their gazes received blank questioning stares from the Tier 1 and 2 Hyperversal Extremities as if they didn't know why they had suddenly gazed at this direction!
It was at this point that Noah released the effects of Obfuscation as...
[Motherfu-]
BZZT!
He was right next to a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity who instantly flashed away into shadows the moment she sensed an existence who had bypassed her senses appear near her!
When her will and the wills of others refocused, they were even more shocked to find that it was an Apex Aeonic Lifeform that was among them whom they couldn't even sense before!
And even more so...the identity of this Apex Aeonic Lifeform.
[You.]
The Shadow Extremity Overlord uttered out as this single word meant too many things.
In their current state, one could blame a myriad set of choices and actions that contributed to how things played out.
Some from the Cult of Endless Shadows placed blame on the being who had declared war on the Avernus Clan and was supposed to be viewing the very Armament of Extremity that was stolen that day!
At the same time, they all knew how the events had truly gone down as their gazes towards Noah were complex.
In the midst of all of these gazes and before they could react any further, Noah nonchalantly floated among them as he spoke out.
"Isn't it unfair?"
WAA!
His voice wasn't filled with the heaviness and grandess of the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, and yet it resonated in the minds of all those here!

"Isn't it unfair that when you are weak and poor, the rules are always enforced against you? But when you have influence and power...the rules are merely suggestions that can be broken without consequences? That the Investiture of Extremity is merely a glorified agreement meant to control the masses but not the ones who contributed in forging its commandments?"
His words struck deep into the hearts and minds of the Cult of Endless Shadows- especially their leadership!
It was the the extent that while the Shadow Extremity Overlord remained silent while gazing towards Noah, Flashing Shadow's visage spoke vigorously against Noah's words.
[The Cult of Endless Shadows is not weak..nor are we poor.]
"And yet the Avernus Clan came into your home, killed your Extremities, and took your Armament of Extremity. And now, they're right over there going about their lives like nothing happened."
His words caused waves of flaming shadows of wrath to rise within the Hyperversal Extremities around him as Noah continued before anything else unfolded!

"You all can glare as much as you want, or you can read between the lines. Being weak and poor is not a crime. But being weak and poor and choosing to stay on such a path without any drive for change...that is the biggest waste of life in all of Extremity."
When he arrived at these words, Noah snapped his fingers as above him, tendrils of a profound authority that caused the Origins of all nearby beings to tremble and be drawn to it!

"So..here is an opportunity for change. Something I obtained in the Supernal Havens of Extremity that you all cannot even manage to enter yet. Something that will reform your very being into one that is capable of easily forming Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, and even increasing your rate of progression towards Extremity and past it in the thousands."
Terrifying words only entered the minds of the existences belonging to the Cult of Endless Shadows as after Noah uttered them...
HOONG!

A massive veil of shadows erupted from the Shadow Extremity Overlord as it covered everything in the surroundings, isolating the vast numbers of beings from the Cult of Endless Shadows away from the eyes and senses of others!
It now seemed like they were in a churning domain of stellar darkness.
And yet above Noah, many points of multicolored Singularity bloomed as they radiated an intense light of grandeur!
[...What?]
The Shadow Extremity Overlord uttered out slowly while others gazed forward with caution and incredulity.
Yet Noah remained impassive as more and more extracted Blood Sources proliferated around him!

"Exactly what I stated and more. These are Blood Sources that will grant a thorough change to your existence. As a Hyperversal Extremity...you should be able to discern the truthfulness of my words at the very least. Out of every opportunity and fortune that you have come across in your lifetimes, this will be the most significant one!"

His words domineeringly let the facts be known as the figure of the Shadow Extremity Overlord flicked his fingers, one of Noah's Blood Sources instantly appearing between his index finger and thumb as he gazed at it closely!
He could feel his very existence vibrating with excitement as it told him to devour this singularity in his hands right away!
And as a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity, he also felt something within this Singularity that he recognized from the few times he came across it.
[Vitalis...?!]
An authority that had eluded even him as he held very little of it in his Aspects of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 2646 Isn't it unfair? II
paragraphs: 2646 Isn't it unfair? II
The Shadow Extremity Overlord gazed at the blinding singularity in front of him as his soul pulsed with power.
He was an Overlord.
A title granted to any leader of an Inheritance or Clan who had at the very minimum reached Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Authority.
There was a heavy responsibility on his shoulders as unlike other Extremities who moved carefree, he had quintillions of Existences to think of!
Recent events had made his heart heavy.
Recent events had made him question.
He had denied joining any of the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances in order to elevate Domains of Shadows, and yet he found himself questioning if he made the right choice!
Now, Vein Rifts pulsed in the distance holding immense opportunities they couldn't even grasp.
And then the first being to enter these Vein Rifts came out to dangle an opportunity of profound proportions as the Shadow Extremity Overlord once more found himself at a crossroads!
Everything that was uttered from the mouth of this existence surrounded by hundreds of these dazzling singularities was not a lie.
And yet...
[What do you gain out of all of this? Why would you freely give off something that makes all of that possible?]
He couldn't help but question this existence surrounded by a light of mystery as at this, he tilted his head calmly.
"Does it matter?"

He didn't deny about any benefits he would receive. And he didn't need to as did it truly matter to them what he received out of all of this when they were in such dire straits and such a profound opportunity lay before their feet?

The gaze of the Shadow Extremity Overlord became stern as he looked around to see his forces gazing at the Singularities around Noah with a greedy light, his voice coming out as he focused on an Apex Aeonic Lifeform in the distance.
[Silas, come forward.]
The Primeval Shadow Elder who connected them all to Noah Osmont.
The one who made an oath with him for the Shadow Sword!
This being stepped away from behind Extremity Laos as the Shadow Extremity Overlord waved his fingers, the Blood Source within his hands rushing over to him as his intentions were clear.
Silas would be the first one to test this.
Surrounded by ever-increasing extracted Blood Sources, Noah smiled as he looked at the being he had an oath to elevate to Extremity.
This Apex Aeonic Lifeform could no longer look at him with the same gaze as before as with complex emotions, he took the extracted Blood Source in front of him and swallowed it!
THUMP!
He felt the beat of his heart.
And then...for the first time in his life, he experienced Quintessence.
BOOM!
His body exploded with a light of authority as his eyes opened wide, whatever lineage he held being exposed and erased from his records as a single Lineage took its place!
And this Lineage...had blood that flowed with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
It had tendrils of the Authority of Dissolution coursing within it!
And it came with shocking elevations as Silas felt his soul and boundaries cry out in euphoria, prompts beginning to flash before his eyes as waves of information emerged in his mind!
[You have devoured the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Source.]
[Your Aspects of Existence are being transformed as all lesser bloodline records are erased.]
[The level of purity of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage you have attained is less than 5%.]
The initial prompts that came were mild as they showed him just what he had swallowed.
But the prompts that came afterwards...caused Silas's figure to tremble as all eyes were on him for what would happen!
"What the hell? This...!"
"How is this possible?!"
BOOM!

A pristine authority radiated from him as he screamed out incoherently while gazing towards the Shadow Extremity Overlord who was using him as a test, his skin gaining a stellar hue as his eyes pulled with multicolored radiance.

"A Lineage! An Ancient Lineage! 10,000% increased rate of progression towards Extremity and past it! An Absolute Dynamis...I can form as many as my soul can handle with a 100% chance of success! Ah...there's more!"
His words were explosive.
The hearts of other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms trembled.
The wills of Hyperversal Extremities wavered as they looked at each other!
A heavily injured Extremity Gabriella who barely kept a sliver of her life after Extremity Ariana's attack felt her heart pulse with life and possibility.
Flashing Shadow and the Shadow Extremity Overlord looked at each other as countless waves of information were exchanged in an instant!
And a moment later...

A scramble began as Extremity Laos, Silas's Master, was the next and first being to move the fastest and appear in front of the extracted Blood Sources that had reached a few thousand around Noah and still continued to increase.

He instantly devoured one of these dazzling Singularities as his actions were akin to the tipping of dominoes, other Hyperversal Shadow Extremities scrambling forward as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms followed behind them!
They could currently only see thousands of the extracted Blood Sources.
They didn't know how many this being ahead of them could provide as they didn't want to miss out!

And because of this, a glorious scene unfolded in a hidden domain of shadows outside of the Vein Rifts as the splendiferous visage of Noah raised his arms out wide- a profound authority emanating from him as waves of Quintessential Hyperversal Mana and Soul Values were burnt to produce thousands of flickering Singularities of Blood Sources!
Blood Sources that caused Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to flock towards him on all sides in a scene that deserved to be recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.

The Shadow Extremity Overlord once more had another singularity in his fingers as while staring at the image of Noah with his arms outstretched as tens of thousands more Singularities proliferated out...he moved his hands in what seemed like the heaviest choice he would make in his life.
And then...he devoured the magisterial singularity.
One hundred. One thousand. Ten thousand!
Thousands of existences from the Cult of Endless Shadows devoured the Blood Sources and attained the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.

Some had already grasped Extremity, some had only arrived up to the 15th Layer of Shadows, and others were at the 17th Layer with Extremity forever out of their reach no matter how much they tried to grasp it these past years.

Out of thousands of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, there was one such being among those who devoured a Blood Source and underwent an unbelievable phenomenon at this moment- a phenomenon that never in her wildest dreams would she have thought would come on this day!
She had been stuck at the 17th Boundary Layer of Shadows for the last 10,000 years.
10,000 years, and not a single step forward could be taken!

But after she devoured the Blood Source and attained the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, the wall she could never scale all these years...she felt it fracturing as her 17th Boundary Layer of Shadows went towards the 18th- what she found so difficult to comprehend before falling into place ever so easily as if she had gained another set of eyes. As if her existence was now more geared to head towards a certain far away prize.
Towards Extremity!
Her soul was dazed as she stared blankly- a profound transformation beginning around her as her authority was slowly transformed to become Hyperversal Extremity Authority!

Such a shocking scene was captured by all the Shadow Extremities here as of there were any with reservations, they were utterly destroyed as every single member of the Cult of Endless Shadows here scrambled to attain a dazzling Singularity of a Blood Source...

In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, Noah's Main Body was overseeing the changes of his people as they attained the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage when in the stellar space above him...
CRACK!
Reality split open as waves of profound authority of utmost purity gushed out.
Transparent and yet laced with a stellar white hue.

It was streams of none other than Vitalis Hyperversal Authority- and they came due to nothing else other than the grandeur of Noah spreading his Lineage to thousands of beings so far as they made accomplishments towards Extremity and past it!

chapters.title: Chapter 2647 Hyperversal Anomalous Virion! I
paragraphs: Initially, Noah had come in contact with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority by accomplishing a grand feat of Plundering an Unrecorded History.
It meant that when other existences performed feats astonishing enough, they would also have their existence bathed with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
This was why in the upper echelons of the Seven Aeonic Havens, the more powerful Extremities knew of and had even come in contact with Vitalis!
But none of them could continue to gain a source of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority freely. Otherwise, many of them would have undergone their First Vitalis Awakening.

This...was the case for the Nether Havens of Extremity anyway. The Supernal Havens of Extremity were much different as Vitalis was termed Havenly Authority by its inhabitants, and it could be accessed in these Haves much more freely!
It was why a great deal of their most powerful existences had undergone Vitalis Awakening.

And the four major powers within these Supernal Havens...were all tied to Lineages that had existences at the very top benefitting from those below them ascending towards and past the Gradations of Extremity.

Within the first day of entering the Supernal Havens of Extremity, Noah established a Havenly Lineage just like the major powers of these Havens as at this moment...he already began to benefit from it!
Pure, unadulterated streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowed into his Existence as everything was further refined by it.
His Blood attracted it most of all as the concentration of Vitalis coursing through him became even purer and denser!
[Your existence is gaining extremely pure concentrations of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.]
[The purity of your Havenly Lineage is increasing as with it, the grander the boosts it provides.]
And in addition to his blood, streams of Vitalis also flowed into something else!
[Your Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians absorb even purer concentrations of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority as they embark on a path taking you closer to the Second Vitalis Awakening.]
His path to power was a unique one.

Other beings would achieve a grand foundation or embark on the Road of Havenly Awakening as after they began, they would proceed on it slowly to go towards a grander path. And yet Noah...seemed to be finding means that made his path faster and faster the stronger that he became!
And at this moment, the pathway towards the Second Vitalis Awakening opened up as he began walking on it speedily.

He wouldn't even have to do anything as he just had to let those he had obtained his Havenly Lineage continue getting stronger and ever closer towards Extremity, and his Lineage made that even more possible for them as it was a glorious positive feedback loop of power.
HOONG!
The first burst of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority was immense as it was the inclusion and strengthening of thousands of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and 26 Shadow Extremities!
They were all that remained from other Branches of the Cult of Endless Shadows after the incursion of Avernus!
After this initial burst, the inflow of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority became slower, almost turning into a drizzle, but it continued to bathe Noah nonetheless.
The Havenly Authority he emanated became even more potent as his presence could be mistaken for an esteemed personage of the Hyperversal Extremity Stage!
And yet...he hadn't even undergone Apexification with his Main Body yet.

His eyes opened as he breathed out stellar brilliance, his gaze landing on his Vassals who currently had an average achievement of the 13th Boundary Layer after they utilized the Loot obtained from the Apex War that Noah had multiplied through RUINATION.

Their existences were currently being elevated and resonated with his Havenly Lineage as many of them had already begun converging boundaries to form their Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that they couldn't do before!
He didn't need to guide them for this.
The Havenly Lineage would do it all for him as a moment later, Noah's figure disappeared from this location and returned to where the Wealdian Council was gathered.

Dr. Hall had received his extracted Blood Source as he looked at it with immense focus and marvel- his eyes burning with a shocking light as if he wanted to break down everything that made this singularity before him!

The figure of the Haven Lich was an Entity that stemmed from Noah as its bony body was already crackling with a Havenly Authority, the massive Champions of Thanatos that were being constructed in the distance also beginning to pulse and transform in a maddening way!
Noah's Wealdian Sources of Extremity looked at him as all of them smiled devilishly, Noah's voice ringing out.
"It seems like all the parts of a diabolically quintessential virus have come together...let us design the first one."
WAA!

With his eyes becoming immensely sharp, Noah took out a Blood Source filled with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and the Authority of Dissolution as he placed it in one hand, while his left hand pulsed with immense darkness as Vacuous Hyperversal Authority rose!
All the pieces had fallen into place.

He had Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that he could hide within the folds of the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority. The forged virus would gain access into the body as Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, and after it was in...there was Noah's Blood Source to spread across the Records of the target.

What Noah had to do was edit the Blood Source to make sure the target wasn't granted a Havenly Lineage, with the clashing effects of Vitalis and Vacuous that would be released being allowed to infect and spread across the Records of this being!
This was his poison.
This was his virus.

The part of his soul that was Pathogenic Will shone as the Boundaries of Pathogenicity, Biochemistry, Epidemiology, Essensology, Pharmacology, and a few others were reigned in by Quintessence as Noah altered the quality and purpose of the particular Blood Source before him into something vile!

His Vacuous Hyperversal Authority formed into a sliver of nothingness that became covered by heavy waves of Thanatos, Lotra, Quintessence, Manadynamics, and Infinity, followed by the altered Blood Source splitting apart and forming into tendrils of crimson gold light that also went to cover the sliver of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
And then...Primitive Vitalis Manipulation was utilized as Noah called forth a stream of pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to cover the concoction.

A thin layer of Thanatos, Lotra, Quintessence, Manadynamics, and Infinity along with his altered Blood Source separated Vacuous and Vitalis as the moment these barriers faded...a heavy clash would occur- and especially so if it was within the soul of an existence!
And as Noah's soul intricately controlled all of these pieces to come together...
[You are forging an extremely unstable Hyperversal Anomalous Virion!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2648 Hyperversal Anomalous Virion! II
paragraphs: The prompt identified what Noah was about to make!
Hyperversal Anomalous Virion.
And in addition to this...
[The Infinite Hyperversal Haven's Alchemy Hall is recording down the process and formation of the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion!]
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven itself gazed at Noah's actions as things it may have to replicate as it recorded everything down!

The formation of the Virion caught the rapt attention of the Haven Lich Ra'Zan and Dr. Hall as it was a profound alchemical achievement that was carried out from the mixture of many different authorities.
[The Authorities within the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion have so far remained stable!]
When looking at it, it seemed like any normal stream of Havenly Authority as one wasn't able to grasp any of the other authorities hidden within it.
Noah's eyes shone with unprecedented focus as after maintaining the Primitive Vitalis Manipulation to maintain its stability for another few seconds...
[The Hyperversal Anomalous Virion has successfully come to fruition!]
The transparent and yet gorgeous white stream of authority flowed by itself freely as it was recognized as completed!
[A unique construct with profound potential effects Unrecorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!]

Noah nodded happily as he waved his hands and caused the pulsing stream of authority to flow around him, its innocence being the most gorgeous factor as when it settled in his hand, its details flowed out.

[Hyperversal Anomalous Virion]:: A construct formed under the guise of many authorities to achieve the purpose of infecting and causing irreversible damage onto the intended target. Layers of an altered Blood Source flow between Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority as the qualities of the Blood Source have all been degraded, excluding the quality of quickly attaching to the records of the targeted existence. Lotra flows in between the two Hyperversal Authorities as any damage done will be sought to grant Loot- the severity of the damage to the target's Aspects of Existence determining the quantity and quality of loot as the effects of the Virion unfold. Its results have yet to be seen, but to spark its effects, simply allow it to flow into the Aspects of Existence of the target unhindered and remove the layers of authority standing between Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, and the clash of these two authorities will do the rest...
A profound wonder was made.
Its true usefulness and power still had to be tested as its purpose was meant to target enemies that Noah couldn't yet damage.
He was relying on Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities to do this on his behalf as he would even attain Loot depending on the level of chaos caused by the Virion!
Now, all that was left was to find an opportunity to utilize it!
In another part of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
In a region within the Apollyon Aletheian Haven, waves of Sources of Chaos surged like endless storms as in one area, there were tendrils of Ruin thundering in all directions.

At the center of it all, there was a young woman whose body shone with a gorgeous makeup of quasars, every part of her brimming with a terrifying sensation of chaos and ruin as this was none other than Xiaomi!

Currently, a Havenly Aura surrounded her figure that made her seem even more exquisite, her dark hair composed of stellar quasars dangling part her shoulders as her eyes opened with a profound radiance.
Beside her, Noah's Apollyon Aletheian Chassis gazed with scrutiny as he asked.
"How is it?"

"Still on the 16th Boundary Layer of Ruin and the 15th layer in other Sources of Chaos...but I feel like the 17th layer of Ruin is not too far away. Especially after obtaining another increased rate of progression from the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage!" Her voice was no longer meek as it still held some of its innocent charm, her smile brightening up the surrounding space as her words held shocking implications.
The 16th Boundary Layer of Ruin!

Apart from Noah, this existence had reached the highest Layer in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as it was due to nothing else other than her Unrecorded Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos that Noah unearthed when he saved her with the Extremity Panacea!
The description of this Foundation had explicitly stated that her Foundation could elevate Ruin and 8 other Sources of Chaos towards Extremity in a short period of time.

And it was truly living to this description as when Xiaomi cultivated near Noah who unearthed this foundation, it was stated that she would have an increased rate of progression of all her Boundaries linked to Sources of Chaos by 100,000% to 1,000,000%!

With no outside help, no absorption of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity...with nothing at all apart from the soul and comprehension of the existence holding it, the Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos took its holder towards Extremity with the fastest speed.

On the other hand, Noah only benefitted by 10,000% to 100,000% in the increased rate of progression by Cultivating near or with the Holder of the Unrecorded Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos.
He looked at the young Quasarian woman before him as he spoke calmly.
"It is time to take you towards Extremity."
Seconds ago, the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum had begun to see different versions of Unrecorded Histories playing out- moments after the creation of the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion!
One of them related to this unique existence before him with a constitution that guaranteed her Extremity at the fastest possible pace.

It showed that depending on the results of the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion, Noah could gain something significant enough to further propel himself towards Extremity...but also significant enough to be given to Xiaomi as with her disposition, Extremity would be within her grasp in a matter of days!
She would be the first existence to gain the authority of a Hyperversal Extremity in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
And through her, Noah would experience the ascension of a concept towards Extremity and the subtle changes it brought!
Through her, Oraculum felt an inkling of Noah's own progression towards Extremity near instead of a hazy light of uncertainty on whether it would take weeks or months!
