chapters.title: Chapter 2649 Change in the Vacuous Domains! I
paragraphs: Extremity was not so hazy anymore.
There was an idea of how far it could be as Noah rushed towards it with even more fervor!
Different parts of him were doing many different things- and each of them were geared towards Extremity as Noah waited for it all to fall into place.
And at this time, another one of his bodies was coming across something utterly critical!

It was a body that had been in the Haven of Penumbra when the Avernus Clan attacked the Cult of Endless Shadows, and in the face of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities, it had entered the Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts that were called forth by the Domain Expansion of Indefatigable Quintessence!
He had entered the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains with his Reified Source of Quintessence- the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity.
And during this whole passage of time- or truly non-passage of time, this body has come across exactly what it was in.
Nothing.
To the senses of this body, time did not exist as it was a truly mind-bending thing to experience with different parts of his soul both the passage of time and the absence of it!
In such a space, Noah's thoughts came and went as he pondered on Quintessence.
As he pondered on Infinity!
He continued to move across the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains as soon enough, he had adorned the Vacuous Havenly I Entity Form that was accessible after the First Vacuous Awakening.
And the form was an astonishing one.

His body had enlarged to a Titanic size as he became a thousand miles in length, which paled in comparison to Major Worlds, much less Cosmos or Realities in size- but it seemed like the base size of a Vacuous Havenly 1 Entity.
His body retained its humanoid stature, but his feet turned into obsidian hooves that pulsed with Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.

His upper body showed a stellar obsidian existence whose makeup was the very Vacuous Hyperversal Authority itself, with a forged eight-pack being laid bare to all as above the muscular chest was a head that was adorned by nine horns rising in a circular fashion!
The horns converged at the top to reveal burning flames of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
His face carried magnetic devilish charm, his eyes seeming like endless swirls that would devour everything as the authority of [Hyperversal I Assimilation] was fully displayed by this form!

[Vacuous Havenly I Entity]:: A state of existence you can call upon that grants you a body uniquely yours, and yet aligning with the forms of the Vacuous Lineages stretched out across the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains. It can display the authority of Hyperversal I Assimilation with utmost ease as any part of your body is capable of absorbing essence, authority, resources, and any entities you come across to assimilate them into a Source Authority that can be applied to any part of your existence. Being in this form while within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains will allow you to absorb Vacuous Hyperversal Authority freely and cycle it across your existence in order to achieve even more purity. This form is still juvenile as only when you attain the Vacuous Havenly II Entity form will you be granted access to a transformation that will greatly alter the power you can display...
Basically, he gained the identity of what the inhabitants of the Seven Havens called Vacuous Malignancies.
And with such a form, he moved across swathes of nothingness.
Only endless waves of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority surged around him as his body innately took it and cycled it across his existence, his soul continuing to experience elevation and strengthening!
And he floated in such an environment for what seemed like millions of years until...
"Hmm?"
His will caught something.
It wasn't signs of life or anything like that, but the dense and overpowering appearance of even grander waves of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.

And it was stretching out for light years as it rapidly moved across nothingness- with Noah's eyes very quickly beginning to see outlines of Titanic figures crossing across the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains towards his right!
Each of them held different humanoid variations and statures, their bodies gloriously shining with an obsidian light as they radiated power and wonder!
The one thing was that...there were too many of them.
Noah saw the ones passing to his right as when his gaze peered deeper, he couldn't see the ends of their forces!

Among those passing, many turned their wills and eyes towards his direction before they continued forward, their figures moving across Vacuous Hyperversal Authority in a sort of tune and rhythm as it felt ancient.
As it felt like the beat of an ancient force moving since the beginning of nothingness!

The thousands passing nearest to Noah barely spared him a glance, and the only reason he even received any glances was due to his form of a Vacuous Havenly I Entity that was more distinguished than the masses of Vacuous Lineages passing beside him.
Such a scene continued as Noah counted hundreds of thousands of Entities passing with every passing moment, and an instant later...the voice of a Hyperversal Extremity thundered out.
[Soudeour...fall back into rank and continue the march. Even if you are distinguished, you will follow the March of the Commander Legeionnaire.]
Even if he was distinguished.
Even if he had undergone his First Awakening!
He had to follow the Commander Legionnaire who led this Legion of Vacuous Lineages before him!

His gaze went to this Commander Legionnaire who actually had a small humanoid female figure, her skin shining with a stellar obsidian hue as she had nine horns twisted into a flaming vacuous crown of flames.
Dense waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority emanated from her as at her words, Noah nodded sharply and floated to stand on the fringes of the passing Legion.

The Commander Legeionnaire snorted at his actions and floated above others who moved in a single plane, her gaze overseeing this region as a distance away, another Hyperversal Extremity floated above another legion...and the deeper into Legions of Vacuous Malignancies Noah gazed into, the more Hyperversal Extremities he could see as above those moving in a single file, there were thousands of Extremities floating above them as each one held an aura more terrifying than the other!

As it felt like the beat of an ancient force moving since the beginning of nothingness!

The thousands passing nearest to Noah barely spared him a glance, and the only reason he even received any glances was due to his form of a Vacuous Havenly I Entity that was more distinguished than the masses of Vacuous Lineages passing beside him.
Such a scene continued as Noah counted hundreds of thousands of Entities passing with every passing moment, and an instant later...the voice of a Hyperversal Extremity thundered out.
[Soudeour...fall back into rank and continue the march.
Even if you are distinguished, you will follow the March of the Commander Legeionnaire.]
Even if he was distinguished.
Even if he had undergone his First Awakening!
He had to follow the Commander Legionnaire who led this Legion of Vacuous Lineages before him!

His gaze went to this Commander Legionnaire who actually had a small humanoid female figure, her skin shining with a stellar obsidian hue as she had nine horns twisted into a flaming vacuous crown of flames.
Dense waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority emanated from her as at her words, Noah nodded sharply and floated to stand on the fringes of the passing Legion.

The Commander Legeionnaire snorted at his actions and floated above others who moved in a single plane, her gaze overseeing this region as a distance away, another Hyperversal Extremity floated above another legion...and the deeper into Legions of Vacuous Malignancies Noah gazed into, the more Hyperversal Extremities he could see as above those moving in a single file, there were thousands of Extremities floating above them as each one held an aura more terrifying than the other!

chapters.title: Chapter 2650 Change in the Vacuous Domains! II
paragraphs: Noah had actually come across the fringes of Legions of Vacuous Malignancies as they were marching.
Just with his perception, he could feel billions of Apex Vacuous Malignancies stretched out in countless legions as this...was just what he could see.

The clusters and forces of Vacuous Malignancies continued to spread out even further than where his will could currently cover on this domain of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as there were likely billions more there.
And since Noah was on the fringes of these vast legions...he was seeing their weaker forces now as towards its center and forefront should be maddeningly powerful existences!
As he joined the ranks of the Apex Vacuous Legionnaires, the ones he came across uniquely made space for him after gazing at his body that gave off a calm glow of power.

Noah's Vacuous Havenly I Entity Form held a status among others as one who had achieved their First Vacuous Awakening, and his figure saw the treatment in status as he was able to pull in deeper into the Legions until he came across another existence giving off a similar glow to him.

Others like them seemed to be stretched out from here in larger numbers as Noah stopped going inward when he arrived at this position, joining the march as the Vacuous Malignancy that had achieved their First Vacuous Awakening gazed towards him with eyes of power and brutality as he spoke.
"Did you get cold feet, Comrade? Why fall out of ranks for such a Holy Mission?"
The words were carefree as if one family member was talking to another, with Noah's bright eyes showing annoyance as he harrumphed and replied.
"I'm lazy by nature, I just don't understand...why now?"
Why now?
Why were endless legions of Vacuous Malignancies marching?
Noah didn't have to wonder where these endless legions of Vacuous Malignancies were marching towards.
He could feel the direction they barreled towards as the other parts of his soul were moving within those lands freely.
The place where he could feel the tug of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
The endless legions of Vacuous Malignancies were marching towards the Seven Havens of Extremity!

"Why now? The passed word from the Commander Legionnaires is that something happened within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains. Something significant enough to spread their forces and spur us to move in a way we never have before. Even if you are lazy, this is a time for glory, Comrade. Imagine ripping into the soul of an Extremity who cannot defend against Vacuous Hyperversal Authority...imagine assimilating their soul onto your own concepts. By devouring and assimilating a single one, Extremity arrives right at your doorstep!"
WAA!
Something significant had occurred within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains!
The Vacuous Lineages knew full well what was happening within the Seven Havens as the Culmination Step of Dissolution was a match that had triggered too many things.
As Noah thought of this, his eyes radiated immense brightness as the Apex Vacuous Legionnaire beside him laughed.
"Bahaha, I see that hungry light in your eyes. Be patient, Comrade...for we are close. I am Igor, you are?"

Igor was a burly humanoid Apex Vacuous Lifeform, his body built like stones as his face had eyes aflame with obsidian light that formed complex tattoos across his whole body- his whole figure seemingly set aflame.
Noah looked at such a being as after an instant of pondering, he smiled while replying gloriously.
"Aleksandr, comrade. I am Aleksandr!"
Noah hit it off with another Vacuous Havenly I Entity as he talked freely to obtain more information, an ancient rhythm coursing through the Legions around him as they matched forward with purpose!
They didn't consider themselves Vacuous Malignancies just like those from the Seven Havens didn't consider themselves Vitalis Malignancies.
And yet both sides called each other Malignancies who wanted to spread their cancerous authorities into the other's homes.
Both sides thought they were fighting a holy war to save their dominion and home from extinction!

Amongst the Vacuous Lineages, Awakenings were widespread and greatly supported, with institutions built within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains that directed and taught newly born Vacuous Lifeforms towards Vacuous Awakening.

Those talented enough like Igor and many more would achieve it even before grasping Extremity, with the only possibility for the Second Vacuous Awakening truly only rising after one became a Hyperversal Extremity.
As for the Third Vacuous Awakening? It was too far for many Extremities to even dream of!

Waves of such information entered Noah's mind as with the absence of time, it wasn't entirely clear whether they had quickly arrived and taken a long period of time to do so, but the endless nothingness all around them began to change.
The Legions stopped moving.
Because ahead of them, in the midst of all of this darkness and emptiness...
The allure of a blinding white light could be seen as even getting near it for most Vacuous Malignancies was unbearable!
OOOM!
The rhythm of the Legions reached a crescendo as they stayed far in the distance.

Their glare towards the blinding white light far ahead was sharp, with perceptive existences being able to appreciate that as the obsidian of Vacuous and the transparent white of Vitalis neared each other, a hazy field of misty gray light was formed in between as the two authorities seemed to dim when they got close to each other!
But one thing was clear.

The transparent white light of Vitalis was ever radiant as more of it blared out with glory, with Vacuous not even coming close as left and right....the ends of the transparent white light couldn't be seen.

And similarly, the ends of the obsidian Vacuous Hyperversal Domains also couldn't be seen as it felt like two endlessly vast walls trying to encroach on each other in a constant and endless battle that would never end!
Vitalis was more potent and powerful as it reigned in Vacuous.
And yet Vacuous was vastly grander in quantity as even though the transparent white domain seemed endless all around, it stretched towards an illusory horizon and seemed to make a turn.
The Vacuous Hyperversal Domains were much larger and vaster than the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
And on this day, after countless past skirmishes and battles...an untold number of Legions of Vacuous Lineages were knocking on the door of Vitalis!

chapters.title: Chapter 2651 Two Sides Seeking Destruction! I
paragraphs: The scene was an ecstatic one.
Endless swathes of Legions of Vacuous Lifeforms stared at the distant lands of Vitalis as they did not enter the grayish region of contention between the two authorities yet.

They were still within the folds of the light of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as the stopped Legions felt a wave of Hyperversal Extremity Authority wash over them from above, their Commander Legionnaires beginning to speak as each one emanated a wave of valor and anger that only their region could hear!

[Before you lies the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains...a cancerous thing that has been spreading its light into our homes and eradicating our very existence everywhere it spreads. Just imagine if this cancerous thing is successful, imagine if its light that burns us for merely existing covers all of the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains!]
Dangerous words echoed out as the faces of all Apex Vacuous Lineages became stern.
If everything was covered by the light of Vitalis...would they all be dead?
Only those capable of withstanding Vitalis Hyperversal Authority would remain alive as their Lineages would all face extinction!
[That is how dangerous and of utmost importance our holy mission is.]

The voice of the Hyperversal Extremity echoed out as Noah saw her pass over their bodies, her visage brimming with immense battle power as truly...she and all others here believed that they were fighting for their home and livelihood.

[With every passing moment, Vitalis spreads its horrific light of extinction. With every passing moment, Vitalis brings into our folds the constraints of the very reality and time. This is why we're here.]
Her gaze became forlorn as her words were filled with unprecedented emotion.
[We...are here to fight for our very right to exist before such a choice is taken away from us!]
OOOOH!

A clamor and heavy waves of agreement erupted out from the Apex Vacuous Lineages in this region, and those stretched out across the Legions where thousands of other Hyperversal Extremities gave similar speeches!
Noah listened to such a speech with a smile as he looked at the perspective of the Vacuous Lineages.

Did they truly have an argument and fair reasoning to do what they were doing? And in this fight where Vitalis Hyperversal Authority was poisonous to them where they had to fight it the whole time...just how would they invade the Seven Havens?
HOONG!
As if to answer Noah's question.
As if to let the blinding radiance in the distance know they were coming!
From the depths of Legions of Vacuous Lineages, blinding obsidian light erupted out as the Hyperversal Extremity above spoke out with even more emotion and reverence!
[To achieve our purpose of protecting our home, our Holy Champions have sacrificed their very existence to bring forth the tools to fight against our enemies...the Hyperversal Savior's Ark!]
An unprecedented feeling of power and glory rose as Noah turned his will towards the depths of the countless Vacuous Lifeforms.
There, a unique aura rose as nine crystalline obsidian wheels could be seen, these wheels making up the backbone of a massive construct that overshadowed hundreds of Legions below it.

The circular rings of these wheels were spinning in the same vector as at their very center, one could shockingly see the visage of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Vacuous Extremity with their arms and legs tucked into their body in a fetal position, a bubble of obsidian light surrounding them as the moment the 9 wheels began spinning, a light of authority began to be drawn from the bubble of light at the very center!

This caused this construct called the Hyperversal Savior's Ark to light up brightly as a moment later, an expansive and wide domain of light spread from it and covered Legions led by hundreds of Extremities.

In the distance, similar Hyperversal Savior's Arks also rose as when they began to spin and draw from the authority of the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity at their very center, a wide domain expanded outwards to cover everything as after a short period of time...Noah was able to utilize his authority to discern what he was looking at!

[Hyperversal Savior's Ark]:: A Construct of Extremity born with the fusion of 50% of the Aspects of Existence of a Hyperversal Extremity who has undergone their Second Vacuous Awakening and holds Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meiridans. It allows for a Vacuous Savior's Field of Benevolence to be released once activated- forming a domain that rejects Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and can block off basic attacks containing Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Authority. The domain will continue to be maintained for as long as the Soul of the Hyperversal Extremity at the very center can continue providing the required expenditure. The longer and more frequently this Hyperversal Savior's Ark is utilized, the faster the soul of the Hyperversal Extremity at the very center will be fused with the construct until they become one with it...
An utterly terrifying Construct of Extremity rose as Noah gazed towards it with surprise!
[Remain within the Light of the Savior's Ark and take down our enemies from within it. Follow the lead of your Commander Legionnaires and we shall have our salvation!]

As she spoke, her figure entered the depths of the Hyperversal Savior's Ark, floating right outside the spinning 9 wheels of this construct as 99 other Hyperversal Extremities floated over from different directions to protectively surround the rings of the Hyperversal Savior's Ark.

Thereafter, the millions of Apex Vacuous Lifeforms who were under the banner of the 100 Hyperversal Extremities that had entered the Hyperversal Savior's Ark also surged over into the expansive Vacuous Savior's Field of Benevolence, the Legion Noah was in doing the same as within moments, he also appeared within the expanded field of the fantastical Construct of Extremity!
[You have entered the Vacuous Savior's Field of Benevolence.]
[All abilities relating to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority are granted a 50% Boost within the bounds of this field.]
[Any existences that die from the attacks of enemies within the Vacuous Savior's Field of Benevolence will have 50% of their Existence devoured as fuel for the Hyperversal Savior's Ark.]
[If you die within an hour of being within the Vacuous Savior's Field of Benevolence, your dying Aspects of Existence will be recalled into the Hyperversal Savior's Ark to be used as fuel.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2652 Two Sides Seeking Destruction! II
paragraphs: 100 Hyperversal Extremities entered a Hyperversal Savior's Ark as approximately 100 Million Apex Vacuous Lifeforms followed them, every single one contained in the massive Vacuous Savior's Field of Benevolence released by this Ark as thereafter...its nine crystalline obsidian wheels radiated ancientness and power as it began to move forward!

Those within faced a profound sensation where they felt as if their bodies were anchored into the Vacuous Savior's Field of Benevolence and moving along with it, never having to worry about somehow being taken out of its domain.
In other regions, other Hyperversal Savior's Arks also became filled with Hyperversal Extremities that protected its core all around, 100 Million Apex Vacuous Lifeforms also filling every other Ark.
The Legions were in abundance, and the Hyperversal Savior's Arks were more so.
Just with what Noah's senses could perceive, over a hundred Hyperversal Savior's Arks had risen and began to move towards the gray region between Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities.
That was 10,000 Hyperversal Extremities, and over 10 Billion Apex Vacuous Lifeforms alone!
It was a grand show of power that showed the utmost seriousness of this venture was as even this number...was not the highest.
There were other Hyperversal Savior's Arks Noah could barely discern in the far distance!
They all barreled forth as while wrapped up in an Ark himself, Noah had a myriad of choices opening up before him.
Wars...were frankly where he benefited the most.
His power rose the quickest and highest during times of conflict as the conflict unfolding before him was one of utmost severity.
It involved too much history and too many things as how should he personally navigate it?
He had bodies within Vitalis, and he had his Quintessential Emperor of Extremity within the Vacuous forces.
The Vacuous Lineages were fighting for their home and very existence, and the Vitalis Lineages were doing the same!
There were many paths he could take.
And some...held much, much greater possibilities of Loot compared to others!

With the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion he had just designed and yet to utilize, the recent developments were about to provide a chaotic battlefield where utilizing such a thing was going to be the most opportune path.
He closed his eyes.
He felt the movement of the Hyperversal Savior's Ark carrying him and millions of other Apex Vacuous Lifeforms towards Vitalis.
The golden light of Oraculum was veiled deep within as possible Unrecorded Histories tried to be unearthed!
Towards the center of the endless forces of Vacuous Lineages now entering Hyperversal Savior's Arks.
An entity shrouded in darkness was surrounded by Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities held 10 floating miniaturized Hyperversal Savior's Arks above his palm as his gaze was far-reaching.
He gazed towards the radiant light of Vitalis in the far distance as he voiced out grandly.

[Little Svetlana...we haven't heard from you since you became an Adjudicator of a Haven. Are you and the other Champions going to be ready to move when you are called upon? Will you be ready to sacrifice?]
WAA!
The words were filled with a brutal light of power that seemed to buzz at the very Zenith of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!
The light was one of maddening grandeur as it pierced across the veils of nothingness and Vitalis to flash far in the distance.
In the region surrounded by a transparent white glow.
A dull glow of Vitalis covered everything around here as in one region, a golden platform floated into the grayish domain where Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities clashed.
The golden platform was light years in size as it was filled with auras of existences, and towards the very center of it...a prominent aura of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity could be felt!
An aura that was blazing brightly at this moment as it spoke to the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities around it.

[Let all branches and forces of the Senatus of Extremity know to send as many forces back as possible. To even return some of those who delved into the Supernal Havens of Extremity...otherwise we may not have a Haven to protect.]
His words were terrifying ones as the Extremities around him moved rapidly, their wills seeing the heavy and overpowering aura of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority coming from the distance!
A woman clad with silver hair nodded with a heavy expression as she replied.
[Yes, Esteemed Cornelius!]

On the body of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity that was addressed as Great Cornelius, tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority moved with pristine control as this was a being that had undergone his Second Vitalis Awakening!

His body was pushing with a metalloid Armament of Extremity in the form of a full body armor, his two hands also grasping an ancient saber and sword that also radiated the aura of Armaments of Extremity!

Such a being had eyes shining with a light of power as he turned towards a certain direction where amidst the scrambling Extremities, one being with a white rob, caramel-colored skin, and a sword on his back sat down calmly while gazing at the spinning 9 ringed constructs light years away.
[Shao...we could use your main body here. One of you will be capable of filling up the battle power of more than a hundred Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities.]
The words were directed to Emperor Shao whose visage pulsed with silent glory, but he shook his head calmly as he replied to the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.

[I waited for the Supernal Havens of Extremity to open and undergo my Awakenings successively. My main body is at a critical moment currently as it cannot come. And these Vacuous Lifeforms...will not be throwing everything they have at once. They will probe and see just to what extent we can defend ourselves. They will wait to see the extent of the forces that will come from the Supernal Havens. Their spies within our lands are working hard, but even they didn't have access to the Supernal Havens until now. Only after they see the extent of all the forces of Vitalis will they throw everything they have. Until then...there is time.]
The words were filled with utmost certainty and confidence as Esteemed Cornelius calmly received them while shaking his head!

[Even we do not know the extent of their power. But since they were the ones chosen to bask in grander concentrations of Vitalis...they should have triple or quadruple what we have amassed over the years. Thadeus has gone into the Supernal Havens to represent the Senatus of Extremity and communicate with their leadership as we will know soon enough.]

The two beings exchanged words as Extremities scrambled around them, billions of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms stretched out across this Golden platform that was known as the Third Bastion of Vitalis pulsing with power and getting ready for what was to come!
Around the radiant light of Vitalis, many other Bastions of Vitalis were stretched throughout as the entities here all had the same thought- to defend their home.
Two sides.
Both of them sought to defend their livelihood.
Both sides...sought the destruction of the other as the ultimate solution to prevent their extinction!

sentences.text: 100 Hyperversal Extremities entered a Hyperversal Savior's Ark as approximately 100 Million Apex Vacuous Lifeforms followed them, every single one contained in the massive Vacuous Savior's Field of Benevolence released by this Ark as thereafter...its nine crystalline obsidian wheels radiated ancientness and power as it began to move forward!

Those within faced a profound sensation where they felt as if their bodies were anchored into the Vacuous Savior's Field of Benevolence and moving along with it, never having to worry about somehow being taken out of its domain.
In other regions, other Hyperversal Savior's Arks also became filled with Hyperversal Extremities that protected its core all around, 100 Million Apex Vacuous Lifeforms also filling every other Ark.
The Legions were in abundance, and the Hyperversal Savior's Arks were more so.
Just with what Noah's senses could perceive, over a hundred Hyperversal Savior's Arks had risen and began to move towards the gray region between Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities.
That was 10,000 Hyperversal Extremities, and over 10 Billion Apex Vacuous Lifeforms alone!
It was a grand show of power that showed the utmost seriousness of this venture was as even this number...was not the highest.
There were other Hyperversal Savior's Arks Noah could barely discern in the far distance!
They all barreled forth as while wrapped up in an Ark himself, Noah had a myriad of choices opening up before him.
Wars...were frankly where he benefited the most.
His power rose the quickest and highest during times of conflict as the conflict unfolding before him was one of utmost severity.
It involved too much history and too many things as how should he personally navigate it?
He had bodies within Vitalis, and he had his Quintessential Emperor of Extremity within the Vacuous forces.
The Vacuous Lineages were fighting for their home and very existence, and the Vitalis Lineages were doing the same!
There were many paths he could take.
And some...held much, much greater possibilities of Loot compared to others!

With the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion he had just designed and yet to utilize, the recent developments were about to provide a chaotic battlefield where utilizing such a thing was going to be the most opportune path.
He closed his eyes.
He felt the movement of the Hyperversal Savior's Ark carrying him and millions of other Apex Vacuous Lifeforms towards Vitalis.
The golden light of Oraculum was veiled deep within as possible Unrecorded Histories tried to be unearthed!
Towards the center of the endless forces of Vacuous Lineages now entering Hyperversal Savior's Arks.
An entity shrouded in darkness was surrounded by Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities held 10 floating miniaturized Hyperversal Savior's Arks above his palm as his gaze was far-reaching.
He gazed towards the radiant light of Vitalis in the far distance as he voiced out grandly.
[Little Svetlana...we haven't heard from you since you became an Adjudicator of a Haven.
Are you and the other Champions going to be ready to move when you are called upon?
Will you be ready to sacrifice?]
WAA!
The words were filled with a brutal light of power that seemed to buzz at the very Zenith of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!
The light was one of maddening grandeur as it pierced across the veils of nothingness and Vitalis to flash far in the distance.
In the region surrounded by a transparent white glow.
A dull glow of Vitalis covered everything around here as in one region, a golden platform floated into the grayish domain where Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities clashed.
The golden platform was light years in size as it was filled with auras of existences, and towards the very center of it...a prominent aura of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity could be felt!
An aura that was blazing brightly at this moment as it spoke to the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities around it.
[Let all branches and forces of the Senatus of Extremity know to send as many forces back as possible.
To even return some of those who delved into the Supernal Havens of Extremity...otherwise we may not have a Haven to protect.]
His words were terrifying ones as the Extremities around him moved rapidly, their wills seeing the heavy and overpowering aura of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority coming from the distance!
A woman clad with silver hair nodded with a heavy expression as she replied.
[Yes, Esteemed Cornelius!]

On the body of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity that was addressed as Great Cornelius, tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority moved with pristine control as this was a being that had undergone his Second Vitalis Awakening!

His body was pushing with a metalloid Armament of Extremity in the form of a full body armor, his two hands also grasping an ancient saber and sword that also radiated the aura of Armaments of Extremity!

Such a being had eyes shining with a light of power as he turned towards a certain direction where amidst the scrambling Extremities, one being with a white rob, caramel-colored skin, and a sword on his back sat down calmly while gazing at the spinning 9 ringed constructs light years away.
[Shao...we could use your main body here.
One of you will be capable of filling up the battle power of more than a hundred Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities.]
The words were directed to Emperor Shao whose visage pulsed with silent glory, but he shook his head calmly as he replied to the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
[I waited for the Supernal Havens of Extremity to open and undergo my Awakenings successively.
My main body is at a critical moment currently as it cannot come.
And these Vacuous Lifeforms...will not be throwing everything they have at once.
They will probe and see just to what extent we can defend ourselves.
They will wait to see the extent of the forces that will come from the Supernal Havens.
Their spies within our lands are working hard, but even they didn't have access to the Supernal Havens until now.
Only after they see the extent of all the forces of Vitalis will they throw everything they have.
Until then...there is time.]
The words were filled with utmost certainty and confidence as Esteemed Cornelius calmly received them while shaking his head!
[Even we do not know the extent of their power.
But since they were the ones chosen to bask in grander concentrations of Vitalis...they should have triple or quadruple what we have amassed over the years.
Thadeus has gone into the Supernal Havens to represent the Senatus of Extremity and communicate with their leadership as we will know soon enough.]

The two beings exchanged words as Extremities scrambled around them, billions of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms stretched out across this Golden platform that was known as the Third Bastion of Vitalis pulsing with power and getting ready for what was to come!
Around the radiant light of Vitalis, many other Bastions of Vitalis were stretched throughout as the entities here all had the same thought- to defend their home.
Two sides.
Both of them sought to defend their livelihood.
Both sides...sought the destruction of the other as the ultimate solution to prevent their extinction!

chapters.title: Chapter 2653 17th Layer! I
paragraphs: In the gray region where Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities clashed.
Space was distorted as even though this area seemed calm, it was akin to the eye of the storm when one was actually within it.
Reality constantly twisted and folded as Vitalis established it, while Vacuous eradicated it.
The whole region was a source of immense entropy and disharmony as any being below the stage of a peak Apex Aeonic Lifeform would likely be shredded out of existence just by being in such a space.

And within such a region...a woman with dark hair and pristinely azure eyes floated in a sitting position as the chaos around her twisted and reflected only other sources of chaos, her figure becoming veiled amidst all of this disorder as very few beings could actually find her!
She went by multiple monikers, but she was most well known as the Extremity of Chaos.
A being who thrived and grew stronger from the ever-increasing entropy and chaos!
At this moment, her gaze shifted between the far away Hyperversal Savior's Arks and the Bastions of Vitalis standing on opposite sides.
Both sides would soon begin clashing as from it, even more chaos would bloom.
[But just because there is more chaos, it does not necessarily translate to more power.]
Her voice was one that only she could hear as she spoke with a pondering mood!
The connection between a concept and Extremity as just because a certain concept was a truth of unfolding reality- it did not mean one was guaranteed to ascend to a shocking peak with it!
A more recent example was Destruction.
Someone she was connected to as his concept was one that defined something constantly occurring day in and day out.
He should have quickly attained Zenith Tier 3 and gone to become a pillar of support as a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity, and yet he actually regressed to Tier 2.
Within Extremity, nothing was guaranteed.
The concept had to be great, yes...but one also had to move properly if they wanted to raise their Concept past the Gradations of Extremity!
This was why for this coming conflict and chaos...
[I hold no allegiances.]
WAA!
The Extremity of Chaos spoke to herself as she made a shocking choice.
[Whoever the victor is matters not...as I will only follow chaos to the very end.]
The moment she made this choice, her restrained aura that had profoundly stood at Zenith Tier 3 began to warp and distort as...it began to edge upwards ever so slowly.
Renowned geniuses of the current eon like her made their choices.
Each one held their own dreams of Extremity and what they wanted at the end of it all, with nobody being the wiser on whether they would actually be able to attain what they wanted at the very end!
The only thing that could be said for certain...was that their choices would either take them where they sought to go, or they would be the exact reason for their downfall.

In the Nether Haven of Dissolution, the visage of Alexander King- Noah's Vitalistic Clone, had the Curagulus Mask adorned as the display of this glorious relic flashed speedily and with warnings, everything else being pushed aside as a single blaring task took the spotlight.

[Crimson Tier Mission]:: Support, Defend, and Destroy- Aid in stopping the advancement of the Vacuous Malignancies that have appeared with swathes of their Legions around the Seven Havens of Extremity. Every Apex Vacuous Malignancy or Vacuous Hyperversal Extremity Malignancy killed with be recorded as an Achievement Point, with accumulated points capable of being exchanged in real time For Hyperversal Treasures of Extremity, Armaments of Extremity, and anything else within the Vaults of Curagulus. Guardians wishing to participate in this mission will be guided to specific coordinates within every Haven where a Tier 3 Guardian will be waiting and departing every hour to bring forces towards the Bastions of Vitalis outside of the Seven Havens of Extremity....

Missions relating to the recent appearing legions of Vacuous Lineages began to bloom en masse as in addition to the main one, there were other missions dealing with reconnaissance of the enemy lines, obtaining information regarding the circular vessels that had appeared, and any useful energy from the enemy side that could be beneficial in the future to come!

Noah looked at the many missions through the eyes of Alexander as he accepted all of them, his gaze flickering with unknown thoughts as he began to head towards the specified location within Dissolution where a Guardian of Extremity would be transporting all Apex Guardians towards the Bastions of Extremity.
He needed a great deal of resources- much more than others due to the path he walked on.
The only reason he kept the pace of his rapid progression was his continued acquiring of loot through enemies and his ridiculously established foundation.
But while other beings going towards Extremity had a single concept to support, Noah had dozens!
While it was immensely difficult for others to cross from the 17th Boundary Layer and into the 18th Layer to attain Extremity, it was almost an impossibility for Noah.
Because the moment he did, it was equivalent to taking 80 other concepts to also achieve Extremity.
An impossibility.
Yet Noah dealt with making the impossible happen as if it were normal!
His foundation guaranteed this. His Origin deemed it...and Quintessence would assure it!
So he continued to seek more resources and open pathways even while concurrently walking on multiple other paths.
As Alexander crossed Dissolution, his gaze turned towards the risen Extremity Vein as he could see the burning authorities of Helios and Genesis at this very moment along with the other Havens.

In the aforementioned Havens, two of his bodies had arrived at the prizes of two paths as Noah sought to use the rewards of these unfolding Histories to break past another Wall that took others years.
The first path to progress first was in the Aeonic Haven of Helios.
At the entrance of the Infinite Oni Haven.
Three beings stood on the doors of a Haven where an Armament of Extremity was being born!

chapters.title: Chapter 2654 17th Layer! II
paragraphs: In front of the crimson portal of the Infinite Oni Haven- standing beside the figures of Noah and Ayame, the gaze of a Hyperversal Extremity changed as he cursed while throwing a crimson medallion towards Ayame.
[Infinite Balor will stand guard here while you guide him in...it seems something even more pressing has happened!]

The Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity about to enter with them into the Infinite Oni Haven that held an Armament of Extremity being born quickly left as only a single aura of Hyperversal Extremity remained in this region!

Ayame blinked sternly as they had already been delayed in entering when the Extremity Vein rose and the Culmination Step began, where after they gained Entry and began slowly exploring the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, things were back on track.
Now...what had happened?

Her eyes flickered as she read the uncertainty and chaos spreading within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, her gaze becoming increasingly stern as she took light steps towards the portal while Noah followed along.
Attaining more strength and completing promises came first.

The medallion in her hands shone as an authority wrapped around her and Noah, the two of them disappeared into a wormhole and passed through layers of twisted space to finally arrive in a reality of utmost serenity and grandeur.
The skies were tinted with a crimson light as all around them, the peaks of mountainous horns seemed to be facing each other and pointing towards a central location in the whole Haven.

The skies and earth were all littered with mountain-like horns light years in size as their tips shone with the iridescent glow of billions of suns, golden liquid constantly dripping from them as shockingly...Noah felt traces of abundant authority of Helios from it!

Tendrils of this extremely scorching golden liquid twirled from the many massive mountain peaks and went towards the massive Singularity in the center of it all where Noah could barely make out....a Bow.

"Very few Armaments of Extremity require three Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity to guard it, much less one that hasn't been fully born. And yet our Infinite Extremity kept such guard over this one until now because in this unique Haven...threads of Helios with higher potency than within any other region of the entire Havens gather. They gather as tendrils of their authority are constantly being devoured by the Armament of Extremity, allowing it to express a semblance of Infinity in the Aspect of Heat. This is what I seek..."

As she spoke, the aura around Ayame subtly changed as it had been the past few minutes, her body radiating authorities of Boundaries at the 13th Layer in one moment as now, she radiated immense heat of the 14th Layer!

This was due to her main body that had just entered the Supernal Haven of Dissolution with the Extremities of her Infinite Extremity devouring the resources accumulated by this major Inheritance and set aside just for her similar to Erikson!
Her power was rising in real time as her entering this Haven again after stepping to become an Apex Aeonic Lifeform with an Extremity Foundation was meant to be her rebirth as well.

She had grand designs to bypass hundreds or thousands of years worth of work by assimilating the Hyperversal Extremity Treasures from her Inheritance, and refining it all and stabilizing her foundation with the pressure of the Armament of Extremity being born here.

The pressure the both of them currently withstood was immense as the Armament of Extremity neared completion, Ayame feeling the stifling heat and being able to handle it as when she turned towards Noah...

Her eyes opened wide as she saw his body had already turned a shade of crimson gold light as a mountain peak near them releasing the scorching golden liquid that was flowing towards the Armament of Extremity...it had suddenly changed directions to come towards Noah's body!
And before his eyes, waves of prompts rose.
[The Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage is reacting to the potent Authority of another Havenly Authority.]
In his Aspects of Existence connected to his main body, the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing within his body buzzed along with the Havenly Boundary of Dissolution.

Another function of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage unveiled itself as at this time, it felt the extremely potent waves of Helios and began to draw them into Noah's body naturally!
Prior to this, he would need to go to the other Supernal Havens of Extremity to attain an Entry Albatross of their specific authority to begin stepping on its path towards Extremity.

But now it seemed that with his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, so long as he was in a region that had enough potent Havenly Authority...the dense Vitalis and already attained Havenly Authority within his Aspects of Existence would draw in the other Havenly Authorities!
BZZT!

The tendrils of extremely scorching golden liquid entered his body as they turned to ash the clothes he was adorned in, his glorious figure blazing with golden light and becoming laid bare as the potent scorching liquid was taken across his Aspects of Existence and into his main body.
Very quickly, the distinction of [HELIOS] began to form in his soul in an astonishing turn of events.
The Vitalis Hyperversal Authority is his body became extremely active as it seemed intent on making many impossible things a reality.
And Quintessence took the wheel as within moments...
[The 1st Havenly Boundary Layer of Helios has been attained.]
[An authority connecting to the very Vitalis Havens of Extremity!]
[The Authority of Helios has been subtly altered by Quintessence.]
Scorching golden light of utmost heat and purity.
It rose within his soul and caused everything to heat up as Noah's mind pulsed with possibilities.
'Vitalis and the Havenly Authorities share an intricate connection...'

Above the Archipelagos of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, Vitalis mixed with Dissolution to bring forth a myriad of Havenly Treasures that could only be obtained by Havenly Aurora...something that was also made up of streams of Vitalis and Dissolution.
Even at this moment, within Noah's Fifth Aletheian Haven, Vitalis and Dissolution were mixing to produce Havenly Treasures within his Origin!

Now, his Bloodline that was filled with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority attracted the Havenly Authority of Helios as the moment it began blooming in his Aspects of Existence...tendrils of it also flowed towards his Origin.
They seamlessly and without rejection flowed towards the Singularity at the peak of the Fifth Aletheian Haven where Vitalis and Dissolution were already mixing.
BZZT!
And a profound radiance shone at its inclusion as Noah's thoughts were further affirmed at this scene!
'What will occur if all Seven Havenly Authorities are freely flowing in my body?'
A daring thought.
A thought that asked what possibilities lay if Noah followed this path to do something phenomenal!

chapters.title: Chapter 2655 17th Layer! III
paragraphs: [The 2nd Havenly Boundary Layer of Helios has been attained.]
[The 3rd Havenly Boundary Layer of Helios has been attained.]
The scene was one of brilliance!

The mountain-like horns that were coursing with the Authority of Helios nearby altered their path as instead of flowing their scorching golden liquid filled with the authority of Helios towards the incandescent flaming bow towards the center of this Haven, they were pulled towards Noah.
His fair skin was tinged with crimson gold flaming light as he seemed like a living furnace, Ayame watching this scene with complex emotions as her face hardened soon after.
She was also here for a reason.
She was Ascending across the Boundary Layers at a fast pace due to her Inheritance's resources, and she had to cement the boundaries as truly her Records!

Beside her was an entity of unfathomable brilliance and genius, but she wouldn't simply gape in shock at his actions as moments later, she continued on her own path as she began floating towards the flaming bow in the distance.
It was so excruciatingly hot that even from afar, she had already grasped its record as it tried to melt everything around it.
[The Hyperversal Bow of Helios]
That was its distinction.
That was how immense of a treasure this was!

Just as Ayame began taking her first steps towards it, Noah's body also floated forward as if it was being pulled- the pace forward much faster as the closer he went towards the Armament of Extremity, the more scorching the authority of Helios was and the close he went towards the other mountain peaks that instantly had their crimson gold liquid diverted towards him.

And with this, his progression only became more insane as Helios was quite literally branded into his soul, Noah already taking measures to have it placed in his Extremity Meridians as the moment he did so...
BOOM!

The eruption of it cascading past the Boundary Layers caused his soul to feel even hunger for Helios, the body of his clone in the Infinite Oni Haven turning into an abyss that swallowed every nearby shred of crimson gold light.
[The 14th Havenly Boundary Layer of Helios has been attained.]
[The 15th Havenly Boundary Layer of Helios has been attained.]
The Havenly Boundary Layers of Helios continued to be scaled just like Dissolution.

His bodies were undergoing massive transformations during this process, but Noah's soul was calmly analyzing all of these changes as his will gazed at the pure, dense, and concentrated waves of Helios in the Infinite Oni Haven.
Even though his body here was swallowing everything nearby, the total concentration of the dense authority of Helios in this Haven had barely reduced by .1%.
The waves of Helios were never-ending in this Haven that had been accumulating them for billions of years until a singularity of an Armament of Extremity was forced to be born.
As he looked at such a treasured Haven under the control of Infinite Extremity...
'Let's put all of this authority to use...'
His will domineeringly did want to put to waste such a dense and pure concentration of Helios.
So amidst the rising of the Havenly Boundary of Helios...he focused on his Origin as officially, another singularity bloomed in the Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity
[The Source of a New Haven has emerged in your Origin.]
Firefly shining with a crimson gold light and radiating immense heat.
[The Haven of Helios has been born in your Origin.]
The Haven of Helios came to be as raising it, Noah would need many Treasures and Loot like Epione's Golden Realm Blessing.
But since he had access to a rich and pure source of Helios preserved and collected in a Haven for an unknown number of years...
BOOOM!
His body exploded with an even greater explosive force as his Origin hungrily called in pure waves of Helios.
The newly born Haven of Helios exploded as a Singularity as trillions of Hyperversal Quintessential Royal Cosmos bloomed in addition to an ever expanding landmass!

And as a consequence, even more waves of Helios joined Dissolution towards the spinning singularity where Vitalis Hyperversal Authority was flowing in for the purpose of forging Hyperversal Extremity Treasures.
[A new Havenly Authority is contributing to the feature of Hyperversal Extremity Treasure Generation above the Fifth Aletheian Haven!]
[Two Hyperversal Extremity Treasures can now be forged within 24 hours.]
[The Quality and Quantity of possible Hyperversal Extremity Treasures that can be generated is gradually increasing.]
His Origin soon became paired crimson gold as he sought a single goal while feeling the seas of pure Authority of Helios flowing into him through his clone in the Infinite Oni Haven.
'Why didn't we go for the completion of the Fifth Aletheian Haven by devouring everything here?'
His eyes shone with tyranny at such a thought!
It would mean that a majority of the Fifth Aletheian Haven would be covered by Helios.
It would create an unstable structure for now, but the concentration and proportion of Havens could always be organized later.
A chance like this to be in a Haven guarded by one of the more powerful Major Inheritances may not come again!
And so, Noah would make the best use of it.
In another Haven entirely, there was yet another one of Noah's clones who was given the opportunity to experience an Armament of Extremity.

Within the lands of the Sima Clan in the Haven of Genesis, Noah was led through the Ancestral Hall of Sima as the stout Extremity Clone of the terrifying existence known as the Iron Fist led him and Erikson into the Planar Vault holding an Armament of Extremity!
His gaze was currently dark as he spoke.
[Vacuous Malignancies are making a move with a force they've never displayed before...troubled times of war are coming.]
His voice was filled with strength that shook the very air around them when he spoke, Erikson's expression hardening as the three of them arrived in front of a massive royal purple door!

She was also here for a reason.
She was Ascending across the Boundary Layers at a fast pace due to her Inheritance's resources, and she had to cement the boundaries as truly her Records!

Beside her was an entity of unfathomable brilliance and genius, but she wouldn't simply gape in shock at his actions as moments later, she continued on her own path as she began floating towards the flaming bow in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 2656 17th Layer! IV
paragraphs: In the Ancestral Hall of the Sima Clan, there were many such doors like the one Noah stood in front of right now as one wouldn't know that past this one was a Planar Vault holding an Armament of Extremity!
Their arrival here was also masked by the news of the Legions of Vacuous Lineages appearing, with all of their three clones proceeding forward nonetheless as Erikson shook his head.
"The Senatus must have planned for or at least expected something like this, right?"

His eyes were deep as he looked at his father in the corner of his eyes, wanting to understand the larger picture that only a being like him knew as at his probings, the Hyperversal Extremity of Foundation actually let out a smile while opening the door ahead of them.

[There are always plans behind plans, and even more plans hidden behind what seems like complacency. You've seen the forces of the Senatus of Extremity and of the Clans and Inheritances moving about and being spurred by the Supernal Havens of Extremity, but...have you seen the Existences you've only heard legends about come out of the woodwork?]
WAA!
The existences whose feats and stories were etched across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity and even had their legends passed down over the eons!
Beings like the Extremity of Reality.
The Extremity of Madness.
The Extremity of Steel who designed 81 Armaments of Extremity that showed he had grasped Extremity in at the very least 81 concepts!
Where were these beings now?
Their legends were rarely heard of as had they perished in the river of time, or were they something the Havens of Extremity were keeping in a tight reserve for what was to come?

The words of the Extremity of Foundation caused many thoughts to bloom within Erikson and Noah as he laughed while the double doors closed behind them, the reality ahead of them brightening up as the scene was a unique one to see.
The whole space was bathed in a neon purple light with a heavy concentration that only pressed on one's body- where if they were too weak physically, they may just be ground down to dust!

[But don't think about all that and focus on elevating your own strength amidst this coming war. It will not end in a day as the stakes are much too high...and no side will reveal their strongest trump cards until they are sure the other side has nothing to counter it. Geniuses will rise, and even legends may fall. But at the end of the day...your own individual strength is what will matter the most. For now, see if the Iron Heart can help you temper your bodies.]
The Iron Heart!
The Extremity of Foundation spoke as he pointed in the far distance where one could see a massive full body armor floating and being the source that was radiating the intense neon purple light!
It emanated intense waves of a sensation Noah had continued to feel from Erikson's father who continued to introduce what he was seeing.

[It was an Armament forged with Foundation as its basis. If you can feel and absorb the pure waves of Foundation, you should be able to quickly pass through the initial layers. This...is the Armament I will be adorning soon when I am called to the front lines.]
The Iron Heart.

A defense type Armament of Extremity that covered an existence from head to toe, its crystalline purple visage making one thing it was the Armament of an Emperor ruling over celestial lands as it even had blazing purple metalloid wings behind it!
Noah already had the pure tendrils of Foundation enter his body the moment he arrived as Quintessence altered this concept ever so slightly, and he already stepped on its first layer.
This was shown by a dim purple light blooming from Noah that The Hyperversal Extremity of Foundation looked at with shining eyes while stroking his chin!

[Get as close to it as you can. The more pressure of the pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority you withstand, the more advanced you can make in Foundation. If you can hold on to it, you should be close to or at the 17th Layer. If you can actually equip it...you have achieved Extremity in Foundation!]
WAA!

The words of a Hyperversal Extremity were resonant as they foretold of many possibilities, but he left out that unless someone was already at the 17th Boundary Layer relating to their physical strength or foundation, it would be nearly an impossibility to actually arrive close to the Iron Heart...
For Noah, he had already touched an Armament of Extremity once before as another clone of his was making his way towards a Hyperversal Bow of Helios.
His steps were light as his already quintessential body floated ahead serenely- as if the pressures others would feel were absolutely nothing to him.
Quintessential.

This was truly the only word Noah could describe everything he was doing right now as many parts of him were spread out across the Havens and even outside of it, and each one had their own part to play that brought him ever closer towards Extremity.

Currently, his Main Body was...discussing Extremity with Xiaomi as with the collective boosts they had while dual cultivating with each other in addition to the increased rate of progression towards Extremity of his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, it felt like they were walking on a smooth path that only needed time and accomplishments to traverse as at the end of it, Extremity would be in their grasp!
His Main Body balanced everything occurring as the tendrils of Helios flowed into him and cycled with every Quintessential Breath, and now the concept of Foundation was doing the same.
From the first to the tenth boundary layer, the path was filled with ease as his clone delved ever closer to the Iron Heart in the Haven of Genesis!
Until...
[The 16th Boundary Layer of Foundation has been attained!]
[The 16th Boundary Layer of Helios has been attained!]
He came upon the door holding him from the 17th Boundary Layer.
And this time...there wasn't an Extremity to take the Armament of Extremity away from him before he achieved glory!

chapters.title: Chapter 2657 17th Layer! V
paragraphs: Extremity.
For some, it was a concept that was as far as their wildest dreams, while for others...it was but a certainty.
Noah was one of the few beings who inherently knew that for them, Extremity was a certainty. It was only a matter of when!
Erikson was another such being.
Ayame was one. Atlas was another!

There were a myriad more hidden across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as they bid their time and worked away from the spotlight, with Hidden Inheritances that didn't involve themselves with the outside matters and only focused on Extremity.
There were Scions of destroyed and long-forgotten Clans carrying the last vestiges of their inheritance on their shoulders as they tried to re-elevate their people to their past heights.
There were many of them...but none were like Noah!
BOOOM!

His main body buzzed with such a stupendous level of glory that the figure of Xiaomi that he was discussing Extremity with under him felt an influx of torrential waves of pure Authority- some of this being Helios and the newly obtained Boundary of Foundation as in addition to this, the streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within Noah were dancing wildly!
They seemed to resonate with the trace amounts of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority with Xiaomi's body who had attained the Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage as with such a catalyst...
The crimson light of Ruin around her body flourished like a blooming rosebud as her pupils became crimson Singularities of Chaos.
Within her body, the dense authorities of Chaos that were at the 16th Boundary Layer pulsed as from among them, Ruin took a step forward.
It blazed with ever-increasing brilliance and change as within Xiaomi's Aspects of Existence, the 17th Boundary Layer of Ruin was born!
Noah's eyes were luminous as bathed with the light of Quintessence, they could see every flow of authority within Xiaomi.
He saw the newly elevated authority of the 17th Boundary Layer of Ruin.
He saw...and then he pulled on it through their current connection as he breathed a Quintessential Breath.
And the authority of a newly risen 17th Boundary Layer of Ruin flowed into his body.
He took a step towards this door!
And he was ready to smash it down with a myriad of means as Xiaomi was one, and then there were his clones in the Havens of Genesis and Helios!
In the Infinite Oni Haven, Noah's body was akin to being the center of a spinning Abyssal singularity that devoured everything as seas of pure Helios Authority were flowing into him
Ayame was left far behind him with her eyes buzzing with disbelief as somehow, Noah had floated close to the Hyperversal Bow of Helios.
He withstood its pressure like it was nothing and appeared right in front of the pulsing Bow.
Touching it before attaining Extremity would scorch the records of average Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
And yet at this moment...Noah's hand moved forward to at the very least come in contact with the scorching object that was already making his skin and skin tingle!

At the same time, under the visage of Erikson who shook his head while whispering 'Monster' under his breath with a light of competitiveness in his eyes, Noah also seamlessly traversed the seas of neon purple light to arrive at the Iron Heart.
His Foundation was already far exceeding even unique Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as the essence of Foundation hammering down and refining his body only made him stronger the closer he was.
And so he came close to it as his clone here also reached out to come in contact with this glorious full body armor.

Separated across reality, different parts of him coalesced with the same intent and goal at the same time as simultaneously, his two clones exceeded the terrifying pressure given off by two Armaments of Extremity and came in contact with them!
His soul took a steady breath.
He felt the hard and indestructible metal of the Iron Heart.
He felt the unfinished product that was the Hyperversal Bow of Helios.
He only came in contact with them, and yet he could feel the intense and interminable Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority.
Vast seas of it surged into his body as this was his goal!
He felt how it was right before his grasp, and also so far away.
His heart thrummed in resonance as Foundation and Helios were taken in and cycled!
Simultaneously, Noah took a Quintessential Breath to experience a Boundary Layer he had yet to achieve from Xiaomi.
BZZT!

His body vibrated like a blooming celestial treasure as crimson gold light of Helios and the neon purple of Foundation built up in such a shocking level of concentration in his Aspects of Existence that with the sheer quantity and quality of these authorities paired with the burrowed authority of Ruin from Xiaomi...
CRACK!
A door was shattered.
Noah's heart was bright as his eyes radiated wonder when they watched the prompts arrive while his body further exploded with even grander waves of power!
[The 17th Boundary Layer of Foundation has been attained!]
[The 17th Boundary Layer of Helios has been attained!]
Ever so silently since the burst of the Boundary Layers of Helios and Foundation, Noah had already placed them in his Extremity Meridians.
Them taking the step to the 17th Boundary Layer meant that Quintessence, Infinity, Dissolution, Loot, Manadynamics, and many others also took this step along with them!
His Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians deemed it so.
And due to this, his Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values and all other Values began exploding upwards!
Austere waves of information emerged as the profound Layers of 81 Boundaries unveiled themselves before Noah.
Some granted Tens of Thousands of Hyperversal Values.
The 17th Boundary Layer of Blood alone granted an increase of 150,000 Quintessential Hyperversal Values!

The information of the 17th Boundary Layer of Dissolution, Helios, Foundation, and Infinity were just as astonishing if not more, but none of them compared to the waves of information that thundered in Noah's mind.
Information on Quintessence!
Its 17th Boundary Layer was so vast that its description was divided into two parts!

The information of the 17th Boundary Layer of Dissolution, Helios, Foundation, and Infinity were just as astonishing if not more, but none of them compared to the waves of information that thundered in Noah's mind.
Information on Quintessence!
Its 17th Boundary Layer was so vast that its description was divided into two parts!

chapters.title: Chapter 2658 17th Layer! VI
paragraphs: The first half of the description of the Seventeenth Boundary Layer of Quintessence showed itself.

[[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of Quintessence]:: You have traversed many layers to reach this stage as you are a step away from the Extremity of Quintessence. Extremity is a step that many beings never cross no matter the passage of time nor how many Treasures they consume if they do not represent what their chosen concept truly stands for. Quintessence relays to you that attaining Extremity for it and concepts like Infinity, Manadynamics, and many others you are expanding is much, much harder compared to what other Existences seek. The sheer weight of a single one of these concepts attaining Extremity is enough to make significant progress across the Gradations of Extremity as taking this last step may take you weeks or months. Such a passage of time to attain Extremity is not truly Quintessential and not befitting the weight of this concept. Quintessence lays out a maximum of 7 Days for you to achieve Extremity. If the last step is not taken within this period of time, the Extremity of Quintessence will forever be out of your grasp, no matter the means you take in terms of your Meridians, Origin, or Foundation...]]
Noah's eyes were sharp as he read half of the description of the 17th Boundary Layer of Quintessence.
It was supposed to grant him a stupendous Boundary Layer with resplendent reality altering possibilities, and yet it started with a warning!
Achieve Extremity within 7 days, or the Extremity in Quintessence will forever be out of his grasp.
This was a shocking reality, but it also showed how obscene this concept was.
His thoughts veered off to the idea of Dead Paths.
Concepts that were too grand that Existences who embarked on them only found nothingness at the very end.
A dead end as even if they achieved Extremity in other concepts, they could never achieve Extremity in a certain one!
Quintessence was considered a Dead Path to others whenever they heard this was something that Noah Osmont was expanding towards Extremity.

And how could it not be? If any normal genius was told that right after achieving the 17th Boundary Layer, they had to achieve Extremity within Seven Days...this would be akin to a death sentence for them!
Many beings were stuck on this stage for thousands or millions of years, with others never crossing it.
But Noah only had a smile on his face.

He ended the discussion of Extremity he was having with Xiaomi as waves of authority wrapped around her, her body floating away as she held a face of concentration to reign in the newly advanced 17th Boundary Layer of Ruin as well elevate the other Sources of Chaos within her.
Noah's visage became adorned in a regal white Emperor's Robe as he waved his hands to cause a blinding singularity of multicolored light to appear!
The reason for his smile.
The reason for his confidence even under the pressure of achieving Extremity within 7 days!
It was contained in the second half of the description of the 17th Boundary Layer of Quintessence!

[[...Of course, the 17th Boundary Layer of Quintessence shines with ever radiant glory as it illuminates the path towards Extremity, so long as you can correctly take hold of and utilize it. The 17th Layer opens the path of the Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos of Extremity- a tool that opens up multiple pathways of Extremity. Due to Quintessence, this tool was geared towards aiding you to achieve Extremity in the shortest possible time, with the Sporos of Extremity being capable of blooming into the Quintessential Hyperversal Ash Tree of Gradation when it has been cultivated to maturity. To bring a Sporos of Extremity to maturity, tremendous amounts of Loot Light, Relics, Armaments, Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, Havenly Aurora, Loot, or even the defeated Aspects of Existence of your enemies can all be used as fuel towards the maturity of the Sporos of Extremity. Once the Sporos of Extremity blooms into the Quintessential Hyperversal Ash Tree of Gradation, it will grant quintessential boons as thereafter, it will revert to become a Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity. Every subsequent cycle of the Sporos will require even more resources to cultivate to maturity as its subsequent boons will be even grander...]]

[[...When the Quintessential Hyperversal Ash Tree of Gradation blooms, half of its essence will grant a baptism to your soul and greatly elevate, refine, and prepare it to become a Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul- with its elevation even capable of granting you a Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul even before you achieve Extremity if you are baptized by enough cycles of the Ash Tree of Gradation. The other half of the essence of the Ash Tree of Gradation will allow you to choose any of the Seven Havenly Authorities stemming from the Vitalis Havens of Extremity to be generated in their Purest Form in quantities that will be sufficient to complete 1 Aletheian Haven of Extremity within your Origin. This boon is meant to guide you towards Extremity in the shortest possible time if you can make the best use of it, with the feat of having enough Pure Havenly Authority of the chosen Haven to establish 1 Aletheian Haven kept even as you near the completion of the Ninth Aletheian Haven of Extremity. The caveat is that the maturity of future Sporos of Extremity will be that much more improbable to achieve as it will require quintessential might to do so. For the feat of attaining the 17th Boundary Layer of Quintessence, the First Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos of Extremity that has been generated is fully matured and waiting to be utilized...]]
The seed that appeared in his hands.
The dazzling multi colored Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos of Extremity that was radiating such a heavy and tyrannical authority as his own Aspects of Existence were put under pressure!
It was something that truly opened up a pathway towards Extremity as one lay in Noah's Soul, and the other was his Origin!

chapters.title: Chapter 2659 The Ash Tree of Gradation! I
paragraphs: A grand seed!
A Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos of Extremity that for the feat of attaining the 17th Layer of Quintessence, Noah gained an entirely matured one.
Its purpose was twofold as through it, he could go towards a Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul. And through it, the hopes of building 9 Foundations to achieve Extremity became more realistic!
He could choose any of the Havenly Authorities corresponding to Havens of Extremity as enough of such authority to forge a complete Haven would then be granted.
And this was only half of the essence contained in the Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos of Extremity.
Noah couldn't take his eyes off of it as even though he held it within his palm, it felt denser and heavier than anything he had ever held onto before!
His soul cried out for it as he didn't outline it just yet.
He was waiting for a confirmation of something critical.
His luminous eyes that didn't look away from the Sporos of Extremity reflected the scenes within two different locations.
One was in the Vaults of the Sima Clan, and the other was within the Infinite Oni Haven.

Here, his two clones still held their hands on the Iron Heart and the Hyperversal Bow of Helios as the extremely Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority flowed into him and coiled on the Sources of Foundation and Helios.
And yet...
They only flowed and cycled, but did not grant any changes.
Pure waves of Helios and Foundation flowed into him as they resonated, but that was it!
No further advancement.
Extremity was not so easy that only by continuing to absorb Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority would take one towards it!
If this was the case, Clans and Inheritances would have produced millions of Extremities.
But even with this reality, Noah still wanted to test his limits as his hand that was touching the Bow of Helios moved- his intention being to take hold of the Armament of Extremity!
To wield such an Armament, one had to have attained Extremity.
So if someone who did not have this authority try...
KAAA!

A piercing cry rang out from the Bow of Helios as if it were a living thing, a burst of molten Helios Authority erupting out as an instant later, Noah's right hand was entirely missing- burnt and scorched out of existence!
It was a shocking scene as up to his shoulder, immense waves of heat simmered- and he couldn't even heal this hand fully as it felt like minuscule records of it were almost erased!
His gaze was brilliant as he gazed at the terrifying Bow of Helios.
Behind him, a shout came from Ayame who witnessed this scene.
"Are you okay?"

He turned back with a smile as the opportunity of the Infinite Oni Haven had granted what it could, and it showed a harsh reality that to go from the 17th Layer and reach Extremity...was an unscalable wall that wouldn't be breached so simply.
The same applied to the Iron Heart that radiated Foundation!
After Noah affirmed this, the eyes of his main body blinked.
The scenes showing his two clones within Helios and Genesis faded as his gaze was only on the Sporos of Extremity in his hands.
His ticket towards Extremity...if he could utilize it well!
If he had the resources for it.
As his eyes gazed at the completely matured Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos of Extremity, he released silent waves of Quintessence of this seed and uttered out simply.
"Genesis."
HUUM!
An aurora of multicolored light began to blaze around the Sporos of Extremity.

This blinding light rose along with the seed from Noah's hands as it came to float in the space before him, beginning to spin like a singularity that would birth a whole Haven as from it, a milky white light of utmost purity began to pulse!
Genesis.

Noah had many options to choose from as with the imbalance of the Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity being entirely composed of Helios so far with a corner of it being Dissolution, he could have chosen the Havenly Authority of Dissolution to bring back a sense of balance between the authorities making up this Haven. But the grander option was to open up access to his Third Havenly Authority.
He had the Boundary of Genesis from the musings of Orion that he made his own, but he didn't have the Havenly Boundary of Genesis.
He didn't have Genesis as it related to the Authority of the Haven!
And so...
THUMP!

Like a flourishing organ coming to life, the Sporos of Extremity thumped while radiating pure milky white light, a sprout gloriously rising from the seed with seven leaves that all shone with a pristine light of Genesis.

The sprout then became larger and larger as even though it didn't cause any surging waves of essence in the surroundings, reality itself creaked at the sheer pressure and grandeur that was contained in this emerging sprout!

A sprout that grew to be over a light year in an instant, the Sources of Chaos in the surroundings being calmed as within moments, the thousands and tens of thousands of light years around Noah within this Apollyon Aletheian Haven where he was discussing Extremity with Xiaomi...they all became utterly still and docile.
The Sporos of Extremity sprouted as the Ash Tree of Gradation came to be.
And during its first appearance, the entropy of reality and everything else was brought to a halt.

The active and fiery Apollyon Aletheian Haven was calmed and became docile starting from this point and throughout the whole Haven, a shocking scene arising for those worthy enough to feast their eyes on it.

It was a scene of an Ash Tree of Gradation shimmering with illusory milky white light as its trunk rose throughout the Apollyon Aletheian Haven, its innumerable branches and leaves spreading out across the very peak of this Haven!
With a contained pressure and power, its innumerable branches and leaves moved as they dropped down towards a single being!
