chapters.title: Chapter 2660 The Ash Tree of Gradation! II
paragraphs: [The Ash Tree of Gradation has bloomed.]
[The chosen Havenly Authority is Genesis.]
The seed would bloom into the Ash Tree of Gradation, and this tree would grant Noah a baptism of his soul along with enough Havenly Authority of a chosen Haven to complete a single Aletheian Haven!
Such unreal boons were truly expressed at this moment as after the Ash Tree of Gradation bloomed, its innumerable branches all drooped and pointed towards Noah's head.
The moment the first branch came in contact with him...
BOOM!
A blinding light flashed as his soul trembled.

A cooling sensation spread across his aspects of existence as his soul couldn't help but cheer. Because in the next moment, unimaginably pure waves of Hyperversal Authority washed over him and made it seem like every part of his soul was being burned by ever incandescent white flames!
His soul values instantly began to nudge upwards.
[The Baptism of the Quintessential Hyperversal Soul towards the Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul has begun.]
[The forging of a complete Aletheian Haven with the Havenly Authority of Genesis has begun!]

The immense quantity and quality of essence required to complete just the Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity were utterly insane as even with Noah absorbing the pure authority of Helios in the Infinite Oni Haven as its concentration continued to thin from his actions, he only barely completed 15% of this entire Haven.

And yet the moment the essence of the Ash Tree of Gradation flowed into him, resplendent milky white cosmos and an expanding white earth began to expand and proliferate within the Fifth Aletheian Haven, its size and magnitude quickly passing the lands of Helios already built as rapidly, Noah's Fifth Haven surged towards completion!

It felt like the formation of a planar circular domain where a sliver of it was Dissolution, over 10% of it was Helios, and now, a majority of it shone with milky white grandeur as Genesis finished the rest.

The proportions of the Havens occupying the Fifth Aletheian Haven were not at all equal as while this wouldn't prevent it from being completed, Noah still planned to equalize them later on as he approached the Ninth and final Aletheian Haven.

The process was a grand one, but also a quick one as the moment the branches of the Ash Tree of Gradation transmitted their terrifying authority to Noah, its massive trunk began to flicker and fade away into an array of stellar dust ever so slowly!
Dust that spread out and flickered out of existence as if it had never appeared, not even leaving behind a flicker of brilliance or what it was accomplishing within Noah.
Ashes to ashes, dust to dust!

Noah's will saw the infusion of authority into him and the gradual disappearance of the Ash Tree of Gradation as profundity surged within his eyes, the flow of time seemingly absent from them as he fantastically experienced the vicissitude of the fading tree before him from its lifetime as a seed to its maturity, to its disappearance right now!

His mind was wrapped up in such a profundity as he only came to moments later, not knowing how much time had passed as the Ash Tree in front of him now had its entire trunk gone, stellar dust continuing to disappear as only a few branches remained.
In his blank moment of profundity, he blinked as he felt his soul had made shocking advancements, his Soul Values alone being 50% greater than any of his other Values!

There was also a backlog of Prompts as when he gazed at his Origin...there lay a brilliantly shining Fifth Aletheian Haven radiating dazzling milky white light, a small portion of it burning with a Golden glow while a sliver of it was black!
And above this Fifth Haven, a Sixth one had already begun forming.
Noah saw an array of prompts that showed just how much had happened in the blink of an epiphany.
[The 16th Havenly Boundary Layer of Genesis has been attained!]
[The Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity has been completed!]
[The Sixth Aletheian Haven of Extremity has begun to be forged!]
[Your soul had drawn out even more power from the Ash Tree of Gradation due to a profound epiphany, its strength nearing the Unscalable Wall of Extremity!]
[The Ash Tree of Gradation has reverted to become the Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity.]

Along with its trunks, the few branches of milky white stellar light that remained faded away as the remnant ash didn't fade away entirely, accumulating into a Singularity that caused a dazzling multicolored seed to appear once more.
Noah beckoned towards it as it landed in his hands once more, its weight feeling even heavier as a line of words rose from it.
[Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity]:: 0% Maturity...
The freebie was gone.
He now had to cultivate it himself!

And just as a means of probing, he pulled from his soul and reached into the Infinite Forge that had been expanded and elevated along with his soul, taking away all of the accumulated Loot Light within it that RUINATION hadn't devoured as he channeled all of it towards the seed within his hands.
BZZT!
The gold grandeur of loot light blazed in his hands and sank into the Sporos II of Extremity silently.
The seed barely vibrated as after it devoured every remaining Loot Light from the Infinite Forge...
[Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity]:: .0001% Maturity...
The percentage of maturity was barely moved.
Seeing the accumulated Loot Light from the Infinite Forge sink into the multi-colored seed and show the percentage of maturity reach .0001%, Noah affirmed he would need a crazy amount of Loot!
He would need to farm crazily over the next week if he was to succeed in attaining Extremity, Loot from terrifyingly powerful enemies was what he required the most.
Loot...from Hyperversal Extremities!
His eyes radiated a profound light of hunger as he communicated with Oraculum.
Some of his cautious moves and paths had to be changed.
It was time for him to take some calculated risks and target Extremities!

[The Fifth Aletheian Haven of Extremity has been completed!]
[The Sixth Aletheian Haven of Extremity has begun to be forged!]
[Your soul had drawn out even more power from the Ash Tree of Gradation due to a profound epiphany, its strength nearing the Unscalable Wall of Extremity!]
[The Ash Tree of Gradation has reverted to become the Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity.]

Along with its trunks, the few branches of milky white stellar light that remained faded away as the remnant ash didn't fade away entirely, accumulating into a Singularity that caused a dazzling multicolored seed to appear once more.
Noah beckoned towards it as it landed in his hands once more, its weight feeling even heavier as a line of words rose from it.
[Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity]:: 0% Maturity...
The freebie was gone.
He now had to cultivate it himself!

And just as a means of probing, he pulled from his soul and reached into the Infinite Forge that had been expanded and elevated along with his soul, taking away all of the accumulated Loot Light within it that RUINATION hadn't devoured as he channeled all of it towards the seed within his hands.
BZZT!
The gold grandeur of loot light blazed in his hands and sank into the Sporos II of Extremity silently.
The seed barely vibrated as after it devoured every remaining Loot Light from the Infinite Forge...
[Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity]:: .0001% Maturity...
The percentage of maturity was barely moved.
Seeing the accumulated Loot Light from the Infinite Forge sink into the multi-colored seed and show the percentage of maturity reach .0001%, Noah affirmed he would need a crazy amount of Loot!
He would need to farm crazily over the next week if he was to succeed in attaining Extremity, Loot from terrifyingly powerful enemies was what he required the most.
Loot...from Hyperversal Extremities!
His eyes radiated a profound light of hunger as he communicated with Oraculum.
Some of his cautious moves and paths had to be changed.
It was time for him to take some calculated risks and target Extremities!

chapters.title: Chapter 2661 Preparations! I
paragraphs: Calculated risks.
Different beings could take different levels of risks as so far, Noah's level of risk he exposed himself to was really low.

His body was already beneath layers and layers and Recorded Histories as if wasn't even moving around in Reality, with his safety placed behind many doors that even Extremities would have a hard time getting to!

Seeing the sheer resources and immense clusters of loot that he would require if he was to achieve Extremity within 7 days, he would take just a little more risk as he moved forward with the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion.
A virus that targeted not just any Extremities- but the Vitalis Hyperversal Extremities who thrived under Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
Far outside the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, there were legions of the Vacuous Lineages about to wage a war as this was a source of loot within itself.
But this was only a possible source of loot.
And it was one where Noah's participation was filled with peril as many Tier 3 and Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity Authorities had their wills spread out and ready to act at any level of discrepancy!
So, he would also prepare his battlefield within the Vitalis Domains.
Within the Supernal Havens of Extremity, he had Hyperversal Extremities coming for him and hunting him down.
Now, it was time to turn the tables and ask whether he was the one truly being hunted!
WAA!
Quintessence shone with brilliance as Noah breathed in to assimilate the great advancement that he had just made.
"First of all..."
He turned his attention inwards.
The greatly strengthened soul and the Sixth Aletheian Haven of Extremity beginning its expansion fell under his gaze as he came to focus on the Perennial Weald of Extremity in his soul.
The massive illusory tree that had branching Yggdrasil of Extremity in the form of his Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!

With the advent of Noah's Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, he gained the Illuminating Light of Quintessence that allowed him as the Progenitor to converge up to 36 Boundaries into a single Dynamis of Extremity.
His current Dynamis that were barely breaking 21 Concepts in each...could undergo a profound elevation and have their authority raised further.

Especially so for Dynamis like Oraculum that was going through Recorded and Unrecorded Histories to provide Noah information and pathways, along with Lotra for the generation of even more Loot, and then Aletheian for his Origin!
The rest would also follow at this juncture, Noah breathed in.
It was a Quintessential Breath of Extremity as the authorities within him were roused.
The expansion of the Dynamis of Extremity would begin first as Noah was looking closely at Oraculum and Aletheian!
For Aletheian, it was time to pack more concepts and begin including what was already in his Origin- especially the Havenly Authorities he had collected so far as he looked forward to its changes.
HUUM!
The Perennial Weald of Extremity began to illuminate as its concepts were called upon to be altered.

While this began, the sharp eyes of his main body turned up and gazed past the Havens he was in, pricing across the veils of Records in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity and coming to see with the eyes of the Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable within the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
It was time for this part of his will to make some major moves!
He had shown a wondrous scene with the Golden Havenly Animalia Blood Source Seas as at this point in time, he couldn't be considered an Underdweller anymore!

He was currently being escorted out of the Ablation Center with Extremity Ruby and Laeta at the forefront as these beings were still gazing at him as if they could peel the layers of secrets and try to see through him.
This was especially so for Laeta as she felt the profound Havenly Authority emanating from Noah that showed just a glimpse of the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing in his Blood.
Laeta looked at this and blinked as a terrifying thought rose.
Why did this being before them...seem to hold the disposition and aura of a Havenly Noble, even if ever so briefly?
[Are you seeing the same thing as me?]
Laeta blinked as she asked while gazing at Noah's following figure.
Extremity Ruby had sharp eyes that gazed at Noah from all directions as their figures returned to the lobby.
Havenly Noble.
The existences distinguished at the top of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages as in their bodies flowed dense reserves of Havenly Authority.
All were those that had undergone their First Havenly Awakening!
They didn't entertain this though, but could this being...
"Hmm?"
While they pondered, they were roused from their thoughts by his voice as he gazed at the side opposite to the 81 kiosks where beings like Extremity Ruby were working.

There, illusory screens were displayed that showed the playing reality within multiple Challenger Arenas, only 1 being of a battle between Apex Aeonic Lifeforms while three screens showed clashes with Hyperversal Extremities!
And in one screen in particular...
[Hahaha! Yare yare!]
The maddened visage of Extremity Blue could be seen as she fought against a Tier 3 Saurischian Hyperversal Extremity- a Velociraptor!

An aurora of white wings stretched out behind the Tier 3 Velociraptor as it clashed with an endless sea of blue, the Extremity of Lunacy rising up and spreading her arms wide in a show of utmost grandeur as Extremity Ruby clicked her lips at this scene.
[More and more Underdwellers have been converging here since this is the first Obsidian Havenly Archipelago nearby.]

They were on the Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago that was overseen by a terrifying Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity, this place being a center of power for many light years as even a Branch of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity was established here- with many Havenly Lineages doing business and battling in the Challenger Rifts that when exciting matches began, their illusory screens would be displayed across the Archipelago for others to watch!

chapters.title: Chapter 2662 Preparations! II
paragraphs: While he underwent Bloodline Ablation and officially became someone from the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage, his enemies and other Underdwellers that had been entering had arrived towards the nearest Obsidian Havenly Archipelago as on the illusory screen showing Extremity Blue, Noah could see some faces of the Avernus Clan members watching the battle with rapt eyes.
He stroked his chin with a pondering gaze as he looked at the few Hyperversal Extremities there.
For what he wanted to do, they weren't nearly enough.

He was evading them before, but he now needed as many of them as possible to fall under the effects of the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion as after the first time, affecting them when their guard was up with knowledge of something like that being possible was going to be hard!
So he affirmed once more with Oraculum.

He closed his eyes momentarily and hummed as he perused multiple possible Unrecorded Histories in a matter of seconds as a moment later, he opened his eyes and focused on the two Extremities in front of him.
"Say, after becoming part of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage, what level of protection does one gain?"
His words were probing as when Laeta heard them, she raised her brows while looking at the visage of Extremity Blue on the illusory screen as she smiled.
[A member of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage cannot be touched. In the case you are killed, you will definitely be avenged!]
Noah smiled at her words as ideas slowly rose in his mind.
He had long since gone past relying on the strength of others and only hoping for the best as currently, he wanted to create his own deterrent.
To do this, he had to make even Hyperversal Extremities think twice about trying to come after him!

He would allow the deterrence of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage and the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity here to act as a buffer before he made his move, with a Golden path gradually unfolding in his soul as his body began to change.
The fair skin and radiant visage full of devilish beauty of none other than Noah Osmont was unveiled as for his plan to succeed, he needed to attract his enemies here!
"I'll be going out to have some fun."
He spoke with a smile as he began to walk out of the Bloodline Ablation Center, Laeta looking at his figure and voicing out before he disappeared beyond the door.

[The Havenly Master of this Archipelago maintains order, but if you antagonize your enemy Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity and she quickly makes a move against you, you will just become a case of a Havenly Animalia needing to get avenged. There's no harm in you staying hidden while you grow your strength.]
Extremity Laeta warned him to be cautious even while under the protection of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage as when an Extremity made a move, they could still die!
Even if their enemy faced consequences thereafter, so what? One was still dead!
But at this, Noah only smiled while leaving behind thunderous words.
"And what if it is someone of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage...who had undergone their First Havenly Awakening?"
BOOOM!
A calculated risk was taken after innumerable paths were looked at.
The pupils of the two Extremities behind Noah constricted as his figure disappeared before their eyes!
Laeta's gaze was incredulous as beside her, Extremity Ruby instantly became stern and took out a white gold medallion brimming with authority as she spoke into it hurriedly!

A moment later, these two Extremities finally reacted as they shot out of the Bloodline Ablation Center, coming into the swathes of Lineages moving about into different buildings and structures of this bustling Archipelago as even when they spread out their wills, they couldn't find Noah's figure anymore.

Their figures then rose as they gazed far past this region they were in- towards the area past illustrious mountains and stellar cosmic trees where the huge coliseum-like style of the Challenger Arenas were standing proudly!

His destination was likely there as while they were shocked at the fact they couldn't even find his figure, Ruby and Laeta shot out towards the Challenger Arena that contained the Underdweller known as Extremity Blue!
[I've alerted the Havenly Master...if you truly sponsored a being that has already undergone their First Havenly Awakening...]

Ruby left the rest of her words in the air as in both of their faces, the disbelief could not be hidden as even after they heard the words from his mouth, they still didn't believe it to be possible! But...it would explain everything so far!

Warping across space, Noah's figure had activated Obfuscation and became hidden from any existences at the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity and below, his soul buzzing with possibilities and change as he went towards the Challenger Arena where some of the forces of the Avernus Clan had already arrived.

His Vaults of Quintessence were already filled with dozens of Hyperversal Anomalous Virions as his Main Body made more even now, every single one seeming like a pure concentrated stream of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority as they were ready to be utilized!
SHAA!

Like flashes of lightning, the figures of Laeta and Ruby quickly passed by his figure without even knowing he was there, Noah's gaze calm as he planned to guarantee at least a few Tier 1 and 2 Hyperversal Extremities to be affected by the Hyperversal Anomalous Virions before he revealed himself.
He flew across the Obsidian Saurischian Archipelago as within moments, 9 massive colosseum-like structures radiated grandeur and light and they rose and fell in space like movable Titanic vessels.

9 Challenger Arenas for which most were packed with audiences watching terrifying battles, others being less filled and with a few Apex Aeonic Lifeforms rising to challenge each other every now and then!

But the biggest Challenger Arenas had waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority bustling around them as Noah headed towards the one that currently had half of its area painted with a maddening blue light.

On the millions of throned obsidian seats of this Arena that pulsed with weak tendrils of Dissolution, Apex Havenly Animalia Lineages filled them in humanoid forms while others grandly- retained their animalistic forms.

In a small area of this arena, a section of the forces of the Avernus Clan Noah had seen arrive in the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago was here as the maddeningly powerful Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity was nowhere to be seen!

Five Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities and Twenty Tier 2 and 1 Hyperversal Avernus Extremities stood in a cluster as they watched Extremity Blue's battle, all of them gaining knowledge of Units of Havenly Aurora and how one could attain the Havenly Treasures radiantly seen atop the Archipelagos as they also waited to battle and increase this resource themselves.

And all of them badly wanted to get their hands on a Golden or Obsidian Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi so they could begin drawing in Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and the Havenly Authority of Dissolution as Extremity Blue had described.

If they could begin to accumulate Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within their bodies, wouldn't the unreachable goal of Vitalis Awakening they only heard Records of from the most powerful forces within the Seven Havens and aspired to attain themselves come ever closer?
They badly sought Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
What they didn't know...was that streams of it prepared just for them were about to be unleashed in the form of a deadly plaque whose effects were yet to be recorded!

chapters.title: Chapter 2663 Merely the Avernus Clan! I
paragraphs: 2663 Merely the Avernus Clan! I

The 9 Challenger Arenas were massive circular colosseum-like structures arranged in a round formation, their architecture being built with wonders of technomancy as they floated up and moved serenely in a set motion- a terrifying gravitational force supporting them as an obsidian crystalline platform shone below with arcs of Dissolution.
Around them, tall ancient trees radiating traces of Vitalis and Dissolution rose to the skies as they towered over the Arenas.

Noah's obscured figure appeared in the Challenger Area whose walls radiated a gold and black light, millions of throned seats stretched all around as he bypassed the main gateway where an Apex Saurischian Tyrannosaurus Beast was collecting 1 Unit of Havenly Aurora as an entry fee into this Arena to watch the battles of Hyperversal Extremities up close!

The atmosphere was wild and lively as gorgeously dressed Smilodons and Saurischians in half-human half-beast forms could be seen as their animalistic curves paired with humanoid bodies were a feast for all beings.

They carried with them floating folded trays filled with multicolored liquids that carried infinitesimal traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, along with lavish roasted Dragonoid Necks, Wings, and Thighs stemming from the Draconian Farm on this Archipelago that cultivated the Rock Dragon Serpents in the thousands of Herds.
The trays carrying meals of Dragonoid Wings, Thighs, and even Brains carried trace amounts of Vitalis that were conducive to one's cultivation!

The fantastical meals and drinks could be purchased by exchanging different prices of Units of Havenly Aurora, with Apex Aeonic Workers carrying them between walkways on the throned seats and selling them to those who could afford to buy.

Waves of power, valor, and enjoyment echoed throughout as millions of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and at least a few hundred Extremities in this Arena enjoyed themselves while watching the grand battle between Extremity Blue and the Saurischian Hyperversal Extremity Velociraptor.

Noah glanced at this glorious atmosphere as while still obscured, his hand bypassed the weak field of Havenly Authority around an Apex Aeonic Saurischian as he grasped a golden chalice with vibrant multi-colored liquid.
He sipped on the drink while appreciating the lively environment here, his voice ringing out only for him to hear.
"Such a vibrant atmosphere...it's a shame with the chaos about to ensue!"
He spoke as if he was detached from it all- as if he wasn't just about to be the prime cause of the unfolding chaos!

He could see the figures of Extremity Laeta and Ruby looking in the surroundings with rapt eyes trying to find his figure, and he could even feel a rousing will of the existence all beings could faintly feel the pressure of at the center of this Archipelago begin to move silently!
The Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity known as the Havenly Master of this Archipelago had been informed of the possible appearance of an existence that had undergone Havenly Awakening.
Such beings were too pristine and full of potential, not to mention their intricate uses and possibilities within the Supernal Havens of Extremity that was filled with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
Even though Noah couldn't be easily discerned, he knew that this Tier 4 Entity would very quickly locate him.
He would begin making his moves before then!
SHAA!
He waved his hands lightly.
And from them, streams of gorgeous Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowed out like starry rivers.
Yet they weren't just streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
Inside them, Vacuous Hyperversal Authority was mixed in along with an altered Blood Source in addition to multiple other authorities!
It was the release of the Hyperversal Anomalous Virions.
Their target was the location that held the Tier 3 and 4 Hyperversal Extremities, with multiple streams floating towards Extremity Blue who had just become the victor of the Challenger Arena.
[WOOO!]
Her bellow of victory roused the wills of all those watching even though she was an Underdweller, her voice echoing out with valor.
[Who else?! Keep them coming...I hold 100,000 Units of Havenly Aurora now!]
She invited challenge.
Unless a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity came, she would not be defeated!
And even if a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity came...she would use them as a whetstone to see if she could make advancements and arrive at this height herself.

SHAA!

Around them, tall ancient trees radiating traces of Vitalis and Dissolution rose to the skies as they towered over the Arenas.

Noah's obscured figure appeared in the Challenger Area whose walls radiated a gold and black light, millions of throned seats stretched all around as he bypassed the main gateway where an Apex Saurischian Tyrannosaurus Beast was collecting 1 Unit of Havenly Aurora as an entry fee into this Arena to watch the battles of Hyperversal Extremities up close!

The atmosphere was wild and lively as gorgeously dressed Smilodons and Saurischians in half-human half-beast forms could be seen as their animalistic curves paired with humanoid bodies were a feast for all beings.

The trays carrying meals of Dragonoid Wings, Thighs, and even Brains carried trace amounts of Vitalis that were conducive to one's cultivation!

chapters.title: Chapter 2664 Merely the Avernus Clan! II
paragraphs: 2664 Merely the Avernus Clan! II
Extremity Ariana and the other Hyperversal Avernus Extremities gazed at the burst of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority in the distance in shock as before an instant passed...
SHAA!
An explosion of streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority burst into existence above their region.
Their souls pulsed as they sought this power.

Their very existence wanted to grasp into themselves as Extremity Ariana was the first to follow the need of her soul and raise her arms up to grasp onto the falling tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
An authority that was at the very center of the Havens of Extremity.

An authority that the ones who have crossed the Gradations of Extremity were hoping to attain and gain an Awakening through it, and they now had easier access to it in the Supernal Havens of Extremity!

So seeing the burst of streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority above them, the souls of the Avernus Extremities below only felt an attractive pull of this authority they had always sought so hard for as they even rose up quickly to absorb as many streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority as they could.
There was no warning.
There was no danger.
After all, their very existence sought for this authority!
Tier 2 and Tier 3 Extremities alike rose and took the streams of pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority into their bodies as they marveled at it.
Extremity Ariana's purple flames became even more roused and wild at this development!

As soon as she felt the vibrant Vitalis Hyperversal Authority sinking into her hands and revitalizing her very existence, Extremity Ariana's will that was about to revel in the euphoria buzzed for a moment as she was taken out of her reverie.
She gazed away from the skies sparking with a pure transparent authority.

Her eyes refocused as she blinked a few times, gazing towards a certain direction where she thought she saw the elusive figure of the being they were all looking for this whole time simply standing there while gazing towards Extremity Blue with a devilish smile!
And the more her will and eyes focused, the more she affirmed in shock and incredulousness that he really was the one they were seeking!
[Motherfucker, he's right there!]
Her words boomed out as the Hyperversal Extremities around her initially didn't understand what she was talking about.
It was only when they followed her gaze and saw Noah's calmly smiling figure did they stare in a dumbfounded fashion before a moment later, vibrant authority began to cycle in their bodies!
Extremity Ariana's body burned with purple flames as if she faced a great enemy, her whole body shining ever brighter as she bellowed out.
[Blue!]
In a shout that roused even the audiences in this Challenger Arena.

In a shout that drew the gazes of Laeta and Ruby in the distance as their wills gazed at them and where their eyes were, seeing Noah's figure there as their faces changed when they felt the astonishing hostility from 5 Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities and 20 Tier 1 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities on the stand!
At such a moment, the deeply cerulean eyes of Extremity Blue blinked on the center of the Challenger Arena as they turned towards the direction many gazes were gathering at this moment.
She saw Noah's figure as his eyes...were looking directly at hers.
She saw his devilish smile.
She saw the light of grandeur and confidence in his eyes.
She didn't erupt with power or lunch at such a moment as when she gazed at his smiling figure, her sharp eyes couldn't help but feel unease.
The moment such a thought rose in her mind, she felt a sense of incredulity rising with it!
Unease? From her stature as a Hyperversal Extremity against an existence who had yet to even achieve Extremity in a single concept?!
She found such a thought wild as before she could think anymore, she saw Noah's figure rising from the stands and beginning to float toward the vibrant arena she was in.
His eyes were filled with serenity as he spoke while floating with majesty.
"You were looking for a Challenger?"
WAA!
Shocking words that caused Extremity Blue to feel even more unease!
Her intuition was never wrong as at this moment, she felt something was truly off.
He had been evading them this whole time, so why did he suddenly appear here?
It was a logical question that would not yet receive an answer.
Because even though she had an astounding intuition marching her endless lunacy, others did not.
Because a moment later...
[Do not let him escape again!]
The voice of Extremity Ariana thundered out as a purple cage of flames rose with her descent, radiating a profound spatial authority that could even lock down the current reality.

The four Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities beside her had also arrived meters away from Noah, their Hyperversal Extremity Authority erupting out as their maddening power caused a tremendous pressure to rise!
All of this...was directed towards a single existence who had yet to even achieve Extremity.

The Extremities from the Havenly Animalia Lineages first looked at this scene with shock, which then soon turned into anger as they saw the Underdwellers actually surround and release such a power against one of their own- the glow of Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage vibrantly emanating from Noah as they all rose from their seats and prepared to act!
But they didn't have to.
BZZT!
The cage of flames called out by Extremity Ariana.
The pulsing Hyperversal Extremity Authority emanating from the other four Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities and the twenty Tier 1 and Tier 2 Extremities following right behind.
All of these vibrant authorities...instantly came to a halt as a grand, undeniable, and mighty authority coalesced from the skies and descended in the form of Hyperversal Haki of Extremity!
This authority far exceeded all of them as Extremity Ariana's cage of flames froze before it turned into dust an instant later.
The erupting authorities from the other Avernus Extremities were forcefully retracted into their bodies as they felt a profound sense of suffocation descend along with a magisterial voice!
[Barbarians.]
WAA!
[You are now in civilized lands...even if you are Underdwellers, you will act with some decorum.]
A voice filled with an undeniable authority they had only ever felt from a few beings in their lifetime.
One was the Avernus Extremity Overlord.
It was a pressure of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2665 Merely the Avernus Clan! III
paragraphs: 2665 Merely the Avernus Clan! III
The Challenger Arena felt a sense of suffocation unlike anything they had come across before.
It was the feeling a tiny little rabbit felt when a lion locked onto it and hunted it down.
A feeling of prey being stared at by a predator!
The gazes of Extremity Blue and other Avernus Extremities changed at such words as in the center of their encirclement, Noah remained utterly calm.
His eyes were gazing above.
There, cracks split across space and time as from within, the figure of a middle-aged man carrying the grandeur of an unparalleled Emperor appeared!
His body was adorned in an obsidian full body Armament of Extremity as on his head, an obsidian crown lazily hung down.
His hair was a simple dark color that faded on the sides while his fair face carried an enticing charm, his eyes seeming like endless black abyss singularities that emanated infinite power!
This illusion was caused by the status and grandeur of this being as an Existence that had reached the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!

His eyes carried a chilling and regal light as when he appeared, the masses of Apex Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineages and Extremity Havenly Animalia Lifeforms all became filled with respect as they bowed their heads silently.
This includes Laeta and Ruby who gazed at this scene from a distance!
This was the Havenly Master of this Saurischian Archipelago!
His true form was something they had only witnessed once during his coronation- a Titanosaurus that stood at the very peak of the Saurischian Lineage within Animalia.
The Abyssal gaze of this being was piercing as it moved from Extremity Ariana, Gayacus, Blue, and all the other Avernus Extremities as his mouth opened.

[The doors of the Supernal Havens of Extremity opened for others to seek Extremity, and for beings like you to ascend the Gradations of Extremity at a faster pace. Your purpose should have only been this as even at this moment, enemies are knocking at our doors. And yet supposedly esteemed beings like yourselves are here being roused and excited to burn down the records of an existence that has yet to even achieve Extremity?]
The Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification of the Last Haven!
It was meant for Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Extremities alike all for the sake of exceeding or going past Extremity!
His words were admonishing the Avernus Extremities for using such an opportunity to focus on hunting an Apex Aeonic Lifeform.
His words were telling them to quickly take a step back, and yet Ariana and the others were put in a difficult spot as they couldn't do this!
They knew the threat of this being.
They knew the orders from the Avernus Extremity Overlord!
On the other hand, Extremity Blue was eerily silent as her vibrant and talkative demeanor was nowhere to be seen, her figure continuing to gaze at Noah silently.
It was as if she could feel something was very, very wrong- and yet she couldn't put her finger on it.
Since she didn't speak, Extremity Ariana's eyes vibrated as she spoke slowly towards the Havenly Master.

[Esteemed Extremity...this being before you has a death feud with our Clan as it is either us or him on the road of Extremity. Our history extends far from the Nether Havens of Extremity as we simply wish to close things off and put this feud to rest.]
Her words were very careful as she felt her skin prickling and tense at every moment. The sheer pressure the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity above them displayed was just that obscene!
And his words were even more domineering.

[I don't give a damn if your history extends to the farthest reaches of Extremity. Drop it, or I will end the feud myself by eradicating all of you here...because it will definitely not be a Soldier of Vitalis that will perish from whatever inconsequential feud you all have.]
WAA!
A Soldier of Vitalis.
As he spoke, the Havenly Master's gaze came to lock onto Noah with scrutiny while the gazes of the Avernus Extremities changed!
They gazed towards Noah with complaints in their hearts as what had this being done in the last few hours that granted him the stout protection of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity?
But they truly couldn't step back as their silence caused the suffocating pressure to only increase.
But a moment later, a smile bloomed on Extremity Ariana's face as she gazed up.

Her gaze was followed by a descending voice that was just as astounding as the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity above them, this one feminine and filled with endless mystery and charm as it was someone who put ease in Ariana's heart!
[I will offer you the Millennium Nexus Records of a Zenith Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity if you simply look the other way on this matter.]
The voice was astounding as it didn't make a threat or begin by fighting, it instead began with an offer that caused the eyes of all Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities to flash with a shocked light!
It was a set of words that even caused the Havenly Master to raise his brows as he looked up.
Beings at their stage of Extremity had very few resources to aid their path forward.
There was a major reliance on Vitalis Hyperversal Authority among a few other things- one of these being the Records of Existences grander than them who had arrived at the place they wanted to go to!
It was basically akin to looking at a path another being had successfully walked on and making inferences on how to get there themselves.

The voice of the Entity who was gradually becoming apparent while bringing in towe dozens of Hyperversal Extremities had spoken about the Inheritance of the Millennium Nexus Records of a Zenith Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity as one had to wonder how she got her hands on it!
She was a being highly in tune with the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
She was the Right Hand of the Avernus Extremity Overlord.
It was Seer Amestris of the Avernus Clan!

paragraphs: 2666 Merely the Avernus Clan! IV
The Seer of the Avernus Clan.

Her body radiated purple grandeur as a veil made it so that her gorgeous face couldn't be seen by others draped over her head, and yet her body emanated stifling waves of power at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
Behind her, dozens of the Avernus Clan Extremities followed her arrival as they had received the news of Noah's appearance and made their way here right away!

The Havenly Master looked at this newly arriving being as the words she had spoken about the Millennium Nexus Records of a Zenith Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity caused his eyes to pulse with light, and yet this light was quickly squashed as he spoke with authority towards the incoming beings above.

[The rise in strength of one will not be critical on what is to come. Any gains I could make with such an Inheritance are inconsequential to the life of another Soldier of Vitalis. Turn back...whatever feud you have with this being needs to end now.]
His reply was staunch as the veiled purple visage of Seer Amestris remained calm!

Her power flowed and ebbed carefully as she almost seemed to be probing, the wills of two Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities pushing and pulling in the atmosphere of the surroundings as space creaked and shuddered!
And in the midst of this contest, the man at the center of it all made a move.

Noah's eyes flashed as he pulled from his main body, Primitive Vitalis Manipulation being overworked as for the first time, he called out nearly 80% of all of this reserves of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing within his Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians!

Over a hundred Hyperversal Anomalous Virions were already made as Noah mixed them among the vibrant streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, and his will then made an action through the Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable standing amidst Hyperversal Extremities on the Saurischian Archipelago.
And in the next moment...
BZZT!
The vibrating space where two Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities were competing with their wills creaked as above, there was an explosion of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!

An explosion of dense and austere streams of transparent white light that numbers in the hundreds exploded out at the very peak of the Challenger Arena as many thought it was the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities beginning to make a move against each other.
But even they sternly looked at this glimmer of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority as all beings nearby felt their souls cry out for it!

And since it exploded in the peak of the Challenger Arena, the dozens of Hyperversal Extremities that came with Seer Amestris were nearest to it as they felt the pristine authorities raining down around them.

Their very souls sought it as some of them raised their hands to feel this pristine authority, the moment it landed on their skin making their Aspects of Existence even in more need for it as they allowed it to enter their bodies and enjoy its inexplicable euphoria!

Other Hyperversal Extremities collected and contained the streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority while up front, the visage of Seer Amestris prevented anything from getting near her as her voice was authoritative!
[What is this? Dangling Vitalis Hyperversal Authority in front of us as if we would jump at its appearance?]

The streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority didn't seem natural as she thought it was the work of the existence below her wanting to show off his power, but this entity shook his head while feeling the pure streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that were very similar to the ones coursing through his veins, his eyes becoming brighter as his will silently focused on the Soldier of Vitalis below him!
And before any of them could continue their discussions...
"It seems like all those who should be here have made it."
The grandiose voice of none other than Noah rang out as he gazed at the Hyperversal Extremities around him.
His emotions were vibrant at this time as he had truly arranged things in a way where he arrived at a point in time where he was currently targeting Hyperversal Extremities!

Sighing at his brilliance, he felt the gazes of all Hyperversal Extremities turn towards him, along with the fewmillion Apex Aeonic Lifeforms quietly discussing amongst themselves on the throned seats of the Challenger Arena.
"I showed myself here to send a warning to the Avernus Clan as I tire of this cat-and-mouse game. I showed myself here to warn you all."
He spoke with authority and power as if he was on the same stage as them.

He gazed at the Extremities around him without an ounce of respect as the one nearest to him scoffed, Extremity Ariana's voice ringing out as she regained her bearings with the arrival of Seer Amestris!

[Warn us? The only thing you are doing is hiding behind the power of an Esteemed Extremity. You are the Master of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, yes? The one who promised to extend the War of Annihilation to the entirety of the Avernus Clan! Should we expect you to jump on the bandwagon of one Extremity after another for the years to come?]
Her rousing words were targeted at Noah as smiled at them and came to focus on her in particular.
Ariana.
She has 'killed' a part of him in the Cult of Endless Shadows while taking the Shadow Sword away.
It was time for such a debt to be paid.
"My warning to you all is a simple one."
As he spoke, he raised his right hand while pointing his index finger towards Extremity Ariana.
"It is a reminder that I am not someone you can freely hunt, and that if you are coming for me...be prepared for your own death."
His words caused a profound sense of suffocation to rise as in the next moment, he tapped his finger towards Extremity Ariana's direction.
A simple motion.
And nothing occurred.
Extremity Ariana's face pulsed with sternness as she began to speak.
[Was that supposed to do someth-]
BZZT!
Her words couldn't finish as her gaze very quickly changed.
She felt something billowing within the core of her existence as waves of shocking authorities instantly erupted out, her body beginning to convulse as her face instantly became utterly horrified!
This was because something drastic had occurred in her existence.

The trace of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that had sunk into her suddenly pulsed as layers of authority that were keeping it separated from the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority contained within it were released, these authorities mixing as Vitalis and Vacuous also mixed with the crimson obsidian blood source in addition to the other pathogenic tendrils of authority!
And the moment such a concoction came to be, it instantly exploded out as Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities clashed.

But they didn't just clash, with their impacts bathed by the crimson gold light of the blood source being carried over across the various parts of the entity they were in as it was seeking the Records of this being to affect!
It was the explosion of the first carpule of the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion.
It began with a spark as the moment it rose, it began to spread wildly as the body of a Hyperversal Extremity began to be ravaged by two austere Authorities!

chapters.title: Chapter 2667 Merely the Avernus Clan! V
paragraphs: 2667 Merely the Avernus Clan! V
The demarcation between Extremity and those who had not achieved Extremity was absolute.
It could not be crossed!
An existence that had not attained Extremity could never in their lifetime be able to overcome this wall.
A Non-Extremity could never kill a Hyperversal Extremity.
At this point in time, Noah wanted to violate this inviolable reality as his Hyperversal Anomalous Virion was his weapon to do so!
It wasn't his own power acting out, and he was actually borrowing the power of two Authorities he had just barely grasped- authorities that some Extremities had yet to grasp themselves.
This, paired with Havenly Blood Source that chased after the Records of the Existence, allowed for the targeted clash of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities!
It allowed for the scene where Noah pointed at an Extremity as next, under the eyes of astonished beings, various areas on the body parts of this Extremity vibrated as if bombs were exploding within.
BOOM! BOOM!
The impacts were enough to shake the hearts of listening Extremities and cause them to turn utterly somber.
Not just because an Apex Aeonic Lifeform had pointed their finger towards an Extremity and done something.
But at the fact that it was actually working!
And the eyes of Extremities knew this more than others as what their vision showed...was something that existences who had yet to reach Extremity would never see.
They saw...the breakdown of Extremity Ariana's Hyperversal Extremity Authority.

Noah and all others only saw the various parts of Ariana's body pulse as the skin became stretched out explosively before it retracted, but Extremities saw something break down that no Apex Aeonic Lifeform should be able to cause a breakdown of!
Ariana's face was utterly distressed and shocked as she gazed towards Noah.
[What did...how do you-GOOH!]

Her mouth uncontrollably opened as she spewed out tendrils of chaotic Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that fizzled out of existence the moment they were out of her body, but she couldn't keep talking as to stop the spread of the ravaging authority within her body, she had to place the focus of all of her authority inward!
Her goal was isolation and dispersion.
After all, she was a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
She faced a shocking predicament, but it was unknown whether she could solve it or not!
Yet Noah only gazed at this shocking development coldly as his finger remained up.
He looked like a young Emperor rising up and violating ancient laws as he tore down ancestral beings who could not be brought down to his level

Before the Hyperversal Extremities could fully react to this shocking phenomenon, he turned his eyes towards the floating figure of Extremity Blue who had shockingly already noticed something and acted at this moment.

She moved purely based on her intuition as after she saw Ariana spit out a storm of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, she recalled the streams of Vitalis that had sunk into her body as she first tried to expel them out.
But this was Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
She had not even undergone the First Vitalis Awakening, much less the second.
So how could she control this essence?

When she realized it was immovable even with her Hyperversal Extremity Authority, she moved for an even more drastic action because there were streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority in her left hand...
SHING!
Her right hand moved like a blade as she instantly bisected her whole hand from the shoulder.
And she didn't stop there as next, she ruthlessly used her right hand to slash at her curvaceous lower body from the waist down!
But...
"It is far too late."
BOOM!
Noah's voice felt like blazing thunder in the ears of the Avernus Extremities as his finger had pointed at Extremity Blue.
And her cold eyes filled with madness changed as near her heart, a Virion was activated and set loose.
Her body trembled and began to distort and deform a moment later!
The hearts of Extremities shook.
Before they could understand the situation any further, Noah's voice continued as he came to stare at the cluster of Extremities Ariana was with, as well as those that came with Seer Amestris!
"Ashes to ashes."
SNAP!
He snapped his fingers.
And multiple Avernus Extremities changed their gazes to shock as their bodies felt a storm exploding within them.
Noah's eyes lastly became locked onto the figure of Seer Amestris who was gazing at him with eyes that seemed to depict him dead in innumerable paths!
"Dust to dust...at the end of the day, I want to show you that even your high stature as Extremities does not mean you cannot turn from predator to prey."
He stared at the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity fearlessly as all around her, Avernus Extremities cried out and groaned as shocking storms erupted within their bodies.
The Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities seemed to have it the worst as they couldn't even support themselves to remain in the skies, beginning to fall like dying stars!
It was a scene of utter astonishment as the Havenly Animalia Extremities in the surroundings could only watch in disbelief.

The gaze of the Havenly Master was complex and filled with many thoughts at this astonishing scene, with Noah's dominant grandeur not done as there were Extremities behind Seer Amestris who didn't take any streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority into their bodies.
They weren't affected by the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion, even though their figures were tense with profound apprehension.
Yet in a show of power, Noah gazed at them as he raised his hand again- about to point towards their glorious figures.
And at the mere raise of his hand towards their direction, the Hyperversal Extremities of the Avernus Clan scattered and scrambled.
Genuine Extremities...moved away with apprehension from the mere raise of his hand!
It was such an incredulous reality unfolding at this moment as Noah shook his head while his voice rang out majestically.
"Merely Extremities..."
WAA!
"Merely the Avernus Clan...and you think you can act wildly before me?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2668 Forcing Extremities to Retreat!
paragraphs: 2668 Forcing Extremities to Retreat!
Merely.
A single word meant to demean and bring down the stature of their target.
Today, Noah demeaned the grandeur of the Avernus Clan before the eyes of the Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage in a shocking display of power!

Seer Amestris was the only one who didn't scramble back at the fear of the unknown as to how Noah was doing all of this, her body glimmering with waves of incandescent purple light that flew out like the fall of stars to land on the bodies of the Tier 1 Avernus Extremities who were fighting with everything they had and were even falling out of the skies.

Their bodies were stabilized as the Tier 2 and Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities were in a slightly better shape, their faces only convalescing as they battled with their own Aspects of Existence to stop a virus from spreading into their records and eating everything away!
Extremity was still Extremity.

They had shocking means and power that set them apart from prior Lifeforms as gradually, the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities seemed to be the first ones to have their states improve as they used all of their power to isolate the clashing Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities while trying to separate it from their existence.

The only issue was the Pathogenic Blood Source that latched onto their records and spread to other parts of their existence- this allowing more streams of Vitalis and Vacuous to follow as the flash continued in other parts of their existence!

Noah's will was observing the Pathogenicity and action of his Hyperversal Anomalous Virion closely as his will was contained in the capsules he had released into the bodies of Extremities, and he looked at their defense mechanisms and how they were currently reacting to see how he could improve this Virion even more in the future.

After using it now, Extremities would be careful against him as those with brains already felt the initial chain reaction start with the steam of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority they absorbed as their bodies were clashing with both Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities.
Tier 3 and Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities could now theoretically defend against this as they could notice Noah and the authorities he utilized.
As for Tier 2 and below...they couldn't discern him under his Obfuscation as this Virion would still be effective against them.
And he wanted it to continue being effective.

It had to because while the Virion was doing its work and destroying the Aspects of Existence of Extremities from within...there were the streams of Lotra that he had packed into the Hyperversal Anomalous Virions.
Glorious streams of loot that benefited from the destruction of the Aspects of Existence of Hyperversal Extremities!

When the storm of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority raged within the heads of the Avernus Extremities like exploding bombs as the eyes of these being deformed and were stretched outwards to nearly explode...
[2x Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity have been attained!]
When the two authorities flashed across the musculature and bones of the Avernus Extremities at Tier 1 and Tier 2...
[4x Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
And when they raged within Ariana, Blue, and other Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities...
[3x Obsidian Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
When the authorities clashed as his Pathogenic Blood Source surged towards different aspects of the Bloodline and soul...
[6x Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities have been attained!]
The more that his Virions laid destruction within the Hyperversal Extremities, the more Loot he received.
As they spread pathogenically while the Avernus Extremities tried to isolate and expel them out of their bodies, Noah affirmed that killing an Extremity in this manner had a very low chance.

It may have been possible with the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities if they were ravaged enough, but they were currently being supported by Seer Amestris as her authority coursed through them with the same purpose.
Isolation and expulsion.

They were all using such means as Extremity Blue in particular was even more ruthless, her body parts reforming as moments after, she isolated the storm of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities into her limbs before she cut them off again decisively.

The only thing that was left behind was traces of the Virion in her blood carrying small clashing streams of Vitalis and Vacuous which once they began spreading across their records again, other storms began to rise.
It was a cyclical process as no Extremities had yet to figure out a way to completely dispel it.

Extremity Ariana gazed at Noah with a ferocious gaze full of bloody murder as her arms had made a crack on her chest- pure golden blood mixed with pungent obsidian poisonous mixture being expelled constantly as she sought to eject the pathogenic blood source- but this constant outflow of her own Blood Source was gradually taking away her Vitality Values!
Receiving her deadly glare, Noah's eyes were sharp.
"Don't glare at me like that, otherwise I may be compelled to just..."
PAH!
Noah's finger tapped out again in Extremity Ariana's direction.
And an Inactivated Hyperversal Anomalous Virion became activated as Noah had allowed multiple Virions in the bodies of the Extremities that took them in!
He didn't activate them all at once as his deterrent tool continued to remain in control.

The moment he tapped out, the left side of Ariana's body ballooned out in a shocking explosion as if it were the first time once more, causing this regal Extremity to bellow out in utmost wrath as she moved back!
She wasn't the only one.

Seeing Noah's actions, the Avernus Extremities began moving away from him one after another, going towards the skies of the Saurischian Archipelago behind Seer Amestris as some moved even further away!
A tool of deterrence.
As Hyperversal Extremities moved away from him like flies, Noah showed that he could use his own power to defend himself!
"Run back to your caves and simmer in worry and hatred."
His voice echoed out grandly as he stood unfettered amidst retreating Extremities.
Even the figure of Extremity Blue gazed at him coldly as she continued cutting limbs and throwing them constantly, expelling as much of the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion as she could.
And the moment she left the Challenger Arena...streams of Units of Havenly Aurora left her being and surged towards Noah!
[You have gained 113,254 Units of Havenly Aurora!]
He appeared to challenge her.
She didn't damage him as she currently left in defeat after his machinations!
He was considered the victor against a Hyperversal Extremity in this Challenger Arena as his gains were stupendous!
"Appear before me again, and who knows what will happen to you. The Foundation and Records you've built up all these years...I may just tear them down!"
As he spoke, his Emperor's Robe fluttered as he floated up freely and without fear.
He went towards the dazzling singularity above the Saurischian Archipelago that had hundreds of thousands of halos of Havenly Treasures floating freely.
And no Extremity followed after him.
Seer Amestris had an utterly cold look as before she did anything, she felt the gaze of the Havenly Master. She also saw the states of the dozens of Avernus Hyperversal Extremities around her.
They had to be taken care of first as at this clash, they were truly defeated!

She didn't want any accidents of Hyperversal Extremities somehow meeting their end as her body glimmered with endless purple light, covering all Avernus Extremities here as they began to disappear silently.

All this while, Noah's figure didn't even look back as he floated towards a myriad of Havenly Treasures, his eyes still seeing prompts cascading down as his Vaults of Quintessence welcomed glorious loot.
Loot from Hyperversal Extremities!
[9x Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity have been attained!]
[18x Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
[8 Obsidian Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
[23x Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities have been attained!]
Loot pulsing of Hyperversal Extremity Authority flowed into his Vaults!

sentences.text: 2668 Forcing Extremities to Retreat!
Merely.
A single word meant to demean and bring down the stature of their target.
Today, Noah demeaned the grandeur of the Avernus Clan before the eyes of the Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage in a shocking display of power!

Seer Amestris was the only one who didn't scramble back at the fear of the unknown as to how Noah was doing all of this, her body glimmering with waves of incandescent purple light that flew out like the fall of stars to land on the bodies of the Tier 1 Avernus Extremities who were fighting with everything they had and were even falling out of the skies.

Their bodies were stabilized as the Tier 2 and Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities were in a slightly better shape, their faces only convalescing as they battled with their own Aspects of Existence to stop a virus from spreading into their records and eating everything away!
Extremity was still Extremity.

They had shocking means and power that set them apart from prior Lifeforms as gradually, the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities seemed to be the first ones to have their states improve as they used all of their power to isolate the clashing Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities while trying to separate it from their existence.

The only issue was the Pathogenic Blood Source that latched onto their records and spread to other parts of their existence- this allowing more streams of Vitalis and Vacuous to follow as the flash continued in other parts of their existence!

Noah's will was observing the Pathogenicity and action of his Hyperversal Anomalous Virion closely as his will was contained in the capsules he had released into the bodies of Extremities, and he looked at their defense mechanisms and how they were currently reacting to see how he could improve this Virion even more in the future.

After using it now, Extremities would be careful against him as those with brains already felt the initial chain reaction start with the steam of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority they absorbed as their bodies were clashing with both Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities.
Tier 3 and Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities could now theoretically defend against this as they could notice Noah and the authorities he utilized.
As for Tier 2 and below...they couldn't discern him under his Obfuscation as this Virion would still be effective against them.
And he wanted it to continue being effective.

It had to because while the Virion was doing its work and destroying the Aspects of Existence of Extremities from within...there were the streams of Lotra that he had packed into the Hyperversal Anomalous Virions.
Glorious streams of loot that benefited from the destruction of the Aspects of Existence of Hyperversal Extremities!

When the storm of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority raged within the heads of the Avernus Extremities like exploding bombs as the eyes of these being deformed and were stretched outwards to nearly explode...
[2x Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity have been attained!]
When the two authorities flashed across the musculature and bones of the Avernus Extremities at Tier 1 and Tier 2...
[4x Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
And when they raged within Ariana, Blue, and other Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities...
[3x Obsidian Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
When the authorities clashed as his Pathogenic Blood Source surged towards different aspects of the Bloodline and soul...
[6x Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities have been attained!]
The more that his Virions laid destruction within the Hyperversal Extremities, the more Loot he received.
As they spread pathogenically while the Avernus Extremities tried to isolate and expel them out of their bodies, Noah affirmed that killing an Extremity in this manner had a very low chance.

It may have been possible with the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities if they were ravaged enough, but they were currently being supported by Seer Amestris as her authority coursed through them with the same purpose.
Isolation and expulsion.

They were all using such means as Extremity Blue in particular was even more ruthless, her body parts reforming as moments after, she isolated the storm of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities into her limbs before she cut them off again decisively.

The only thing that was left behind was traces of the Virion in her blood carrying small clashing streams of Vitalis and Vacuous which once they began spreading across their records again, other storms began to rise.
It was a cyclical process as no Extremities had yet to figure out a way to completely dispel it.

Extremity Ariana gazed at Noah with a ferocious gaze full of bloody murder as her arms had made a crack on her chest- pure golden blood mixed with pungent obsidian poisonous mixture being expelled constantly as she sought to eject the pathogenic blood source- but this constant outflow of her own Blood Source was gradually taking away her Vitality Values!
Receiving her deadly glare, Noah's eyes were sharp.
"Don't glare at me like that, otherwise I may be compelled to just..."
PAH!
Noah's finger tapped out again in Extremity Ariana's direction.
And an Inactivated Hyperversal Anomalous Virion became activated as Noah had allowed multiple Virions in the bodies of the Extremities that took them in!
He didn't activate them all at once as his deterrent tool continued to remain in control.

The moment he tapped out, the left side of Ariana's body ballooned out in a shocking explosion as if it were the first time once more, causing this regal Extremity to bellow out in utmost wrath as she moved back!
She wasn't the only one.

Seeing Noah's actions, the Avernus Extremities began moving away from him one after another, going towards the skies of the Saurischian Archipelago behind Seer Amestris as some moved even further away!
A tool of deterrence.
As Hyperversal Extremities moved away from him like flies, Noah showed that he could use his own power to defend himself!
"Run back to your caves and simmer in worry and hatred."
His voice echoed out grandly as he stood unfettered amidst retreating Extremities.
Even the figure of Extremity Blue gazed at him coldly as she continued cutting limbs and throwing them constantly, expelling as much of the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion as she could.
And the moment she left the Challenger Arena...streams of Units of Havenly Aurora left her being and surged towards Noah!
[You have gained 113,254 Units of Havenly Aurora!]
He appeared to challenge her.
She didn't damage him as she currently left in defeat after his machinations!
He was considered the victor against a Hyperversal Extremity in this Challenger Arena as his gains were stupendous!
"Appear before me again, and who knows what will happen to you.
The Foundation and Records you've built up all these years...I may just tear them down!"
As he spoke, his Emperor's Robe fluttered as he floated up freely and without fear.
He went towards the dazzling singularity above the Saurischian Archipelago that had hundreds of thousands of halos of Havenly Treasures floating freely.
And no Extremity followed after him.
Seer Amestris had an utterly cold look as before she did anything, she felt the gaze of the Havenly Master.
She also saw the states of the dozens of Avernus Hyperversal Extremities around her.
They had to be taken care of first as at this clash, they were truly defeated!

She didn't want any accidents of Hyperversal Extremities somehow meeting their end as her body glimmered with endless purple light, covering all Avernus Extremities here as they began to disappear silently.

All this while, Noah's figure didn't even look back as he floated towards a myriad of Havenly Treasures, his eyes still seeing prompts cascading down as his Vaults of Quintessence welcomed glorious loot.
Loot from Hyperversal Extremities!
[9x Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity have been attained!]
[18x Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
[8 Obsidian Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
[23x Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities have been attained!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2669 The Establishment of the Infernal Havenly Commerce! I
paragraphs: 2669 The Establishment of the Infernal Havenly Commerce! I
As Noah rose towards the precipice of the Saurischian Archipelago, he left behind shock and awe- as well as the retreating figures of Avernus Hyperversal Extremities.
Light years away from the Saurischian Archipelago.
[Haha...this is fucking ridiculous! An Apex Aeonic Lifeform...an Apex Aeon-]
Before Extremity Ariana's voice finished, her mouth spat out a storm of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities as she released what all other Extremities here were feeling!
They couldn't believe what had just occurred as they actually retreated, with Seer Amestris' face being utterly cold as her voice authoritatively rang out.
[Forget anything else and stabilize yourselves. ]
The most powerful among them had extremely cold gazes.

Apart from Seer Amestris, Extremity Blue had an utterly frosty expression as her body battled the storm of authorities inside here, their eyes simmering with a light of unimaginable wrath after today's event!
Their eyes foretold their thoughts as this...was far from over!
In front of the endless wall of Dissolution near the Golden Havenly Smilodon Archipelago, right at the entry point past the Vein Rifts.

The figures of the powerhouses of the Cult of Endless Shadows could be seen as after they had attained the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, their combat power rose by a notch as 80% of them were able to gain entry into the Supernal Havens of Extremity!

Not too far behind them, the magnificent figures of Henry, Aurelia, Orion, Kazuhiko, and many other Commanders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven could also be seen as after their acquisition of his Lineage, Noah also released them into the Supernal Havens of Extremity.

His voice was light and yet filled with firm power as he spoke towards the Shadow Extremity Overlord who seemed to be conflicted at the power being expressed by the lineage his people obtained and its connection towards this being before them.

"I have gravely injured and put dozens of Avernus Extremities in compromising conditions light years from this location. If you all were powerful enough, I would tell you this would be the best time to attack them!"
[What?!]
Words of utmost disbelief rang out from Noah's mouth as even Orion and others stared at him blankly- not being able to believe what he just said at this juncture.
He gravely injured multiple Extremities? How did that even make sense?
And yet Noah nodded as if he was speaking about the most common thing in the world.

"Yes. The only caveat is that they're likely still being protected by a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity who is still tending to their injuries. Because of our own weakness, that wall cannot yet be scaled. So for now...you all can acclimate to the Supernal Haven of Dissolution and begin accumulating Havenly Treasures that will take you towards and further past Extremity. On the Archipelago in front of us alone...you can even claim Shards of an Armament of Extremity!"
The stronger the beings who attained his Lineage became, the stronger he became.
Thus, he would let them run free as at this moment, Noah was actively moving to expand his Lineage in unique ways that only he would be able to do!
Much of this...involved him putting to use his Clones and Reified Sources of Extremity, and even the Reified Wealdian Sources of Extremity.

He had them obscure their auras and gain entry across multiple different Vein Rifts that led to entry regions far from the Havely Smilodon Lands, with all of them arriving in regions with variations of the Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineages.

His eyes were sharp as gazed to his right, where millions of light years from here, another one of his bodies had gone past a Golden Havenly Komodo Archipelago as a hundred light years away, he stopped and tapped his feet in the space below him as a dreamy golden landmass formed.

It spread out only for a few thousand miles as it was the size of a small world, with sandy waves of dreams moving across its earth as in the center of this island, this figure of Noah's body transformed into the visage of a mysterious old man whose aura could not be felt by anyone.

Due to his authority as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable Existence, what he portrayed outwardly was what any being saw- regardless of their stage of power, as he transformed himself into an unknown existence filled with age and mystery, and he allowed the Havenly Authority of his Lineage to freely overflow from his body as its grandeur of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within it radiated outwardly!

Next, he laid down a simple crystalline golden table that began to be filled up with Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources, causing the whole region to pulse with a light of glory and treasure that even exceeded the Halos of Havenly Treasures in the Archipelago light years ahead of him.

Noah had deployed 36 of his bodies currently into different Vein Rifts to test out just how fantastical this path he was taking would play out, with each one adopting an image of a mysterious entity whose aura couldn't even be felt as thereafter, they set up treasured stalls that laid out Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources!
Thereafter, his bodies waited.
And within minutes, light years away from the Komodo Archipelago, Noah's first customers arrived.

The auras of 32 Hyperversal Extremities followed by a few hundred Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who had gained entry could be seen flying forward, the leading Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity turning his head far in the distance where he felt the pulsing waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority as he motioned with his hands and turned this whole party in this direction.

As they appeared Noah's figure gradually became apparent to them, their gazes changing when they felt the aura of the crimson gold Singularities on his table and the aura they gave off as these beings landed on his dreamy floating landmass.
They were all adorned in silver robes that had the symbol of a crescent moon, this group being part of the Havenly Moon Clan of the Aeonic Havens of Extremity!
One of the powers of the Seven Clans.

The Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity took the lead as seeing the glow of Havenly Authority on Noah they had only discerned on the bodies of Extremities they saw in the Archipelago behind them, they naturally knew that the being before them was a native of the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
One that held an extremely potent Bloodline at that as the grave of Vitalis was particularly domineering around him!
The Zenith Tier 3 Extremity of the Havenly Moon Clan nodded towards Noah's figure that he couldn't sense any aura of as he spoke with calmness.
[What would Esteemed Extremity be doing here with a display of these Havenly Treasures?]
While being referred to as an Esteemed Extremity, Noah's first customers arrived before him in the Supernal Havens of Extremity!
