chapters.title: Chapter 2670 The Establishment of the Infernal Havenly Commerce! II
paragraphs: 2670 The Establishment of the Infernal Havenly Commerce! II

The Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity had to motion with his hands behind him to make sure his people didn't surge forward- the allure of the crimson gold Singularities on the table ahead of them being so strong that their souls seemed to innately want to devour them as quickly as possible!
The Apex Aeonic Lifeforms behind them were already breathing hard, their Circulation Modus Operandi moving rapidly as their very cells sought for the treasure ahead.
Noah's visage as an old man was calm at this as he spoke out lazily, filling his voice with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
[Vacuous Malignancies are at our gates as you Underdwellers are not as prepared as the Havenly Lineages for what is to come. Very few of you have even undergone your First Vitalis Awakening...]

His words were explosive as the Extremities before him trembled, the leading Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity who was known as Extremity Brightsword gazing at Noah with a complex gaze as he continued!
[What I have here are some things to change your abysmal fates and little connection to Vitalis Hyperversal Authority...]

As he spoke, he picked up one of the crimson gold Singularities on the table and pinched it causing the hearts of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms behind to drop as if they wanted him to be more careful with it.

[...it is something that will allow traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to flow in your blood, increase your rate of progression towards and past Extremity, allow you to form Absolute Dynamis of Extremity with ease...
among other things. You can trade Extremity Treasures, Relics, Herbs,Havenly Treasures, or even Units of Havenly Aurora if you all aren't too poor for it.]
WAA!
The eyes of the Extremities behind Extremity Brightsword shone as they already slapped their Extremity Relics to release treasures from their storage spaces to pay!
Their souls shuddered when the Entity before them spoke of what these singularities before them could grant.
Their Extremity Souls innately knew the words to be true as this was a boon they truly needed!

The authority of Extremity Brightsword still reigned all of his people in as he nodded towards Noah and waved his hands to reveal a few thousand strands of Havenly Aurora that he had gained by defeating a Zenith Tier 3 Komodo before entering here.
[What is the Esteemed Extremity's Title? I have 13,455 Units of Havenly Aurora here, I wonder how many of the...treasures before us we can buy?]
Everything around Noah was too mysterious.

The glow of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority around him was too glorious as the fact that none of them could sense his aura...either meant he was a monstrous Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity, or something far above this!
Before they affirmed things, they couldn't afford to offend him as they had already seen the cohesiveness of the Havenly Lineages from the Archipelagos they just came from.
At his question, Noah waved his hands to cause 13 crimson gold beads to rise up as he spoke calmly.
[You can call this old man the 9th Infernal Lord. A single Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Source can trade for 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora or equivalent Extremity Treasures.]
Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources.
For any beings who attained them from here on out, this would be the name they see as even the Lineage they attained would show itself as the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage!
The distinction of Quintessence was hidden from them as Noah could do this much as the Progenitor of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.

Extremity Brightsword nodded at his words while sending the strands of 13,000 Units of Havenly Aurora over, 13 Blood Sources arriving in his hands as under the watch of the Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who were watching him intently, he motioned one of the Blood Sources to enter his mouth.

Everybody watched with bated breaths as an instant later, the pupils of Extremity Brightsword constricted as his body began to glow with terrifying grandeur, a glorious aura erupting around his body soon after as an astounding change occurred in his Lineage- impurities being burnt away as his soul and Concepts cheered when a new lineage carrying traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority occupied his existence!
Information flowed into his mind as he truly affirmed all the words this mysterious entity had spoken of before them, not being able to help but laugh gloriously.

[Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage...capable of easily forming Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, increased rate of progression towards and past Extremity...haha, with this, my Havenly Moon Clan can produce astounding geniuses en masse!]
The eyes of Extremity Brightsword radiated even greater power than before as his words caused the Extremities behind him to get restless.
They all looked at the Blood Sources before them as the voice of Extremity Brightsword echoed out in their minds.
'Empty out your storages or any Units of Havenly Aurora you have...we must attain as many Blood Sources as we can!'
The group of beings gazed at the Blood Sources with a light of greed as next, scintillating lights of Treasures of Extremity rose along with dozens of Extremity Relics.
Noah looked at the piles of Loot about to fall in his hands with a veiled smile as he kept his lazily mysterious look outside, the voice of Brightsword continuing to ring out at this moment.
[9th Infernal Lord, I wonder if you also accept Treasures of Extremity conducive in aiding one towards the 18th Layer? They may not be worth much to you...]

[Treasures are treasures...] Noah waved his hands dismissively at the words of this Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity and continued. [...they will only require a higher number, but they will be accepted regardless.]
A moment after these words, scintillating Aeonic Treasures of Extremity in the form of Herbs and other stellar oddities appeared as they formed into a gorgeous mountain above this region!

Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources began to rise as Noah made his first trades- granting existences his Lineage as this gave him fantastical boons to his own power, and he also got a myriad of Loot in return as for the sake of the cultivation of the Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity, vast and endless sources of Loot would be made to flow in!
This was only one of the 36 bodies Noah had released into different Vein Rifts to arrive in 36 different regions of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.

There would undoubtedly be some risks if an Entity somehow didn't respect the terrifying glow of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority right after seeing how cohesive the Havenly Lineages were, but this risk was currently low as Noah planned to spread his Blood Sources wide while attaining loot for as long as possible.
He would be planting seeds of his power across many Extremities and those about to be Extremities as the more powerful they became...the more powerful he would become!
This...was only the start.

Extremity Brightsword nodded at his words while sending the strands of 13,000 Units of Havenly Aurora over, 13 Blood Sources arriving in his hands as under the watch of the Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who were watching him intently, he motioned one of the Blood Sources to enter his mouth.

Everybody watched with bated breaths as an instant later, the pupils of Extremity Brightsword constricted as his body began to glow with terrifying grandeur, a glorious aura erupting around his body soon after as an astounding change occurred in his Lineage- impurities being burnt away as his soul and Concepts cheered when a new lineage carrying traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority occupied his existence!
Information flowed into his mind as he truly affirmed all the words this mysterious entity had spoken of before them, not being able to help but laugh gloriously.

[Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage...capable of easily forming Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, increased rate of progression towards and past Extremity...haha, with this, my Havenly Moon Clan can produce astounding geniuses en masse!]
The eyes of Extremity Brightsword radiated even greater power than before as his words caused the Extremities behind him to get restless.
They all looked at the Blood Sources before them as the voice of Extremity Brightsword echoed out in their minds.
'Empty out your storages or any Units of Havenly Aurora you have...we must attain as many Blood Sources as we can!'
The group of beings gazed at the Blood Sources with a light of greed as next, scintillating lights of Treasures of Extremity rose along with dozens of Extremity Relics.
Noah looked at the piles of Loot about to fall in his hands with a veiled smile as he kept his lazily mysterious look outside, the voice of Brightsword continuing to ring out at this moment.
[9th Infernal Lord, I wonder if you also accept Treasures of Extremity conducive in aiding one towards the 18th Layer?
They may not be worth much to you...]
[Treasures are treasures...] Noah waved his hands dismissively at the words of this Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity and continued.
[...they will only require a higher number, but they will be accepted regardless.]
A moment after these words, scintillating Aeonic Treasures of Extremity in the form of Herbs and other stellar oddities appeared as they formed into a gorgeous mountain above this region!

Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources began to rise as Noah made his first trades- granting existences his Lineage as this gave him fantastical boons to his own power, and he also got a myriad of Loot in return as for the sake of the cultivation of the Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity, vast and endless sources of Loot would be made to flow in!
This was only one of the 36 bodies Noah had released into different Vein Rifts to arrive in 36 different regions of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.

There would undoubtedly be some risks if an Entity somehow didn't respect the terrifying glow of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority right after seeing how cohesive the Havenly Lineages were, but this risk was currently low as Noah planned to spread his Blood Sources wide while attaining loot for as long as possible.
He would be planting seeds of his power across many Extremities and those about to be Extremities as the more powerful they became...the more powerful he would become!
This...was only the start.

chapters.title: Chapter 2671 The Establishment of the Infernal Havenly Commerce! III
paragraphs: 2671 The Establishment of the Infernal Havenly Commerce! III
Atop a starry golden floating island swirling with the essence of dreams, a trade was made.
Noah was given an influx of prompts for all the new treasures he obtained into his Vaults of Quintessence as thousands of golden lines of words rained down.
[You have gained the Soul Nourishing Herb of Extremity.]
[You have gained the Extremity Relic- Glass Cannon.]
[You have gained the Extremity Relic- Earring of the Deceiver.]
Aeonic Treasures of Extremity, Extremity Relics, and much more flowed into his pockets as this...was only the first step.

After Extremity Brightsword secured enough Havenly Blood Sources and the Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms behind him now radiated a Havenly glow of a lineage that was filled with traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, he affirmed just how revolutionary this power would be for their Clan as he already sent his thoughts into a Communication Medallion to pass the word to the other groups of his Havenly Moon Clan, and even towards the Havenly Moon Extremity Overlord whose main body was in the Bastions of Vitalis facing Vacuous Malignancies!
Extremity Brightsword turned towards Noah's mysterious visage as he spoke hesitatingly.
[Will the Esteemed 9th Infernal Lord continue to be here for the foreseeable days? I will have some more members of my Clan come by to exchange for the Havenly Treasures here...]
9th Infernal Lord.
As he said this title, Brightsword theorized how shocking of a backing and history this being had!
The 9th.
This number always held a profound uniqueness as one of the major questions was...what about the Infernal Lords preceding him? Just how terrifying were they?

At his question, Noah only nodded dismissively as he leaned back on the simple throne he was on, staring out into the vastness with utmost profundity as streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority began to swirl around him!

It was a scene that caused utter shock and awe from the mind of Extremity Brightsword who had reached Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity and knew that even having Vitalis Hyperversal Authority in one's body was already nearly impossible, much less to be capable of controlling it.
This being before them...had to have already undergone the untouchable Vitalis Awakenings!

The image Noah built to scam others was utterly profound as after linking with one of the clusters of one of the Seven Clans, he may as well have gained access to the forces of this whole clan to trade with him as he only had to wait.
More would come, and Loot would flow into him while he freely spread his Lineage!
The first trade was with one of the Seven Clans who were rich in resources, but it wasn't always like this.
After some more time passed, in another region of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution- behind a Havenly Mammoth Archipelago.

One of his clones in this region had members of an Inheritance of Extremity come to his landmass that were much poorer- an inheritance hidden under the eyes of many but holding powerful combatants who managed to gain entry!
They were known as the Extremity Cicada Inheritance.

The most powerful among them was a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity who gazed at Noah's austere figure with a gaze of hesitation after only being capable of obtaining 20 Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources, blinding eyes of greed of a dozen other Extremities and 28 powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms behind him.
This being also addressed Noah as he introduced himself to them.

[Esteemed 9th Infernal Lord, are there any other methods we can use to obtain more Havenly Blood Sources...? We've alerted our forces in the Nether Haven of Dissolution to open up the Vaults to trade even more, but if there are other methods...]
The Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity was actually trying to reason and wiggle around with Noah as he hid his brilliant smile while looking at another path that Oraculum had seen!
He laid this path out now as he spoke with serenity.

[Since you all are too poor, you can also be employed and gain remuneration for your services. My wares are only being sold in the Supernal Havens of Extremity as if you all head back into the Nether Havens and trade on my behalf, you will gain commission of a few Blood Sources depending on your performance. ]
His words caused the eyes of the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity from the Extremity Cicada Inheritance to constrict as he continued.
[To be employed under my Infernal Havenly Commerce, you just need to be an Extremity and accept this...]
Noah waved his hands to reveal a shockingly Pure stream of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that caused many gazes to change.
They saw something astounding, not knowing that Vacuous Hyperversal Authority and many more pathogenic authorities were hidden in here!

[This is something to ensure my peace of mind- and the tool to make your employment possible. It will be able to monitor the trades you do and to make sure you act accordingly. If anyone tries anything unsavory past their employment...do not blame me for what happens next. Anyone who becomes part of my Infernal Havenly Commerce will automatically obtain 3 Havenly Blood Sources, with future remuneration depending on performance.]
His words buzzed in the minds of the Extremities as all the ones here found themselves stepping forward with seriousness.

Noah's devilish smile was hidden from them as he waved his hands to cause over a dozen Hyperversal Anomalous Virions to appear, going towards the bodies of the Extremities that could not turn down such an opportunity to obtain more of these resources to provide for their Inheritance!
After they were successfully implanted with the Virions, Noah provided them simple golden blue robes with a lemniscate infinity symbol shining with a crimson flaming light.

His voice was majestic as he employed Hyperversal Extremities to spread his Lineage for him, the threat of the Hyperversal Anomalous Virions falling on them should they ever violate any terms as with the air of mystery he had already built- it was hard to say if, or when, an employee of his newly enacted Infernal Havenly Commerce would try to violate his terms.

The Hyperversal Anomalous Virion would also serve as the Nexus of the trades as since it held his authorities and a trace of his will, he could easily take out Blood Sources through it or take in other Loot into his Vaults of Quintessence through this Virion!
This was something he affirmed with Oraculum as with the authority of Lotra and Quintessence flowing in the Virion among many others, achieving something like this was not an impossibility.

[The Infernal Havenly Stream I've placed inside of your Aspects of Existence will grant you the Blood Sources you will need to trade, and any Extremity Treasures you obtain will be taken into the Infernal Havenly Stream.]

As if to express his words in action, his will activated within the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion as it didn't erase the layers of Authority between Vacuous and Vitalis Authorities, it instead utilized Quintessence to transfer three Havenly Blood Sources from his Vaults of Quintessence and into their Aspects of Existence!

The Extremities before him who had undergone a change in their lineage to attain his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage took out the three Blood Sources with shining eyes as Noah spoke while waving his hands dismissively.
[3 Blood Sources for becoming employees of the Infernal Havenly Commerce. Use whatever means you have trade as this will decide how much more you receive in remuneration...work hard.]
He...truly began putting Hyperversal Extremities he had never met before to use.

With shining eyes, they communicated amidst each other as over 80% of the Extremities from the Cicada Inheritance turned around and headed back towards the misty wall of Dissolution that led into the Nether Havens of Extremity!
Only Noah could make such a grand thing possible!

chapters.title: Chapter 2672 A Refulgence of Loot! I
paragraphs: 2672 A Refulgence of Loot! I
The Infernal Havenly Commerce.
Noah established it and employed the first set of Extremities from the Cicada Inheritance, this being yet another pathway for him to quickly gain a stream of constant loot.
Another one...was through his already established connections with another Clan of the Seven Clans and a powerful Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity!
In the Vaults of the Sima Clan.

Noah's figure had moved away from the Iron Heart that he couldn't make any more gains from, the Extremity of Foundation laughing freely while appreciating the fact that Noah was able to even touch the Armament of Extremity!
[Coming in contact with it means you've already attained the 17th Layer if not close to it. You must have your own secrets and fortune that brought you here so I won't pry...]
Both he and Erikson were looking at Noah like the monstrous being he was as he waved his hands freely.
"No, I have to thank you for the opportunity. To that end...I can share with you something critical that I obtained with my body that first stepped into the Supernal Havens of Extremity."
As he spoke, Noah waved his hands to reveal 10 dazzling Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources that instantly caused the Extremity of Foundation to become somber!
He could feel the silent yet ever-present glow of Vitalis on these crimson-
gold singularities as Noah spoke with a grave tone.

[For being the first existence to step into the Supernal Havens of Extremity, I gained these at a much cheaper cost compared to others from a Havenly Archipelago under the banner of something called the Infernal Havenly Commerce. It is a Blood Source that alters your Lineage to increase your rate of progression towards and past Extremity, form Absolute Dynamis of Extremity easily...]

Noah listed just some of the boons of the Blood Sources as the figure of Extremity of Foundation became more somber at every word, motioning as one of the Blood Sources fell into his hands as he studied it closely!
His soul was much more reserved than others as he asked in a grave tone.
[You've taken it yourself?]
"Mmm." Noah nodded lightly as he motioned the rest of the 9 Blood Sources to float towards father and son.
"I've shared them with my own people too, so I'll use these as thanks."

Lies were woven with truths as Noah spoke with a straight face, Erikson and the Extremity of Foundation grasping the Blood Sources and looking at them closely as the latter voiced out in a powerful tone.

[I'll have the Seer of Sima take a look and confirm if there are any detrimental effects. If they're everything you say...they will change the course of power for those who consume them! You said you got them from the Supernal Haven of Dissolution?]
The Extremity of Foundation asked in a heavy tone as Noah smiled.
This was another one of the Seven Clans latching on to the bait as Noah only had to wait until they also began attaining his Lineage speedily!

It wasn't just the Sima Clan as in the periphery of the Infinite Oni Haven, Noah was beside a heavily breathing Ayame who was trying to get ever closer to the Bow of Helios, 10 Blood Sources also stretched out before her as Noah spun a similar story.
The Aeonic Inheritance of Infinite Extremity would also soon gain access to his Blood Sources as their terrifying Entities were bound to be connected to Noah's Lineage one way or another.
And then, there was one last avenue that Noah was currently pursuing.
In the Nether Haven of Dissolution.

One of his bodies had appeared far from the dense number of Vein Rifts that had more and more forces entering, his figure above the lands of the Planeswalkers as he gazed at the endlessly dark skies while calling out.
"O Adjudicator of Dissolution."
WAA!
His voice didn't travel far.

And yet within the next second, pristine waves of Hyperversal Extremity of Dissolution descended and wrapped around him, and his figure appeared in the unique space that seemed to be overlooking the stretches of planes and light years of Dissolution, the scene of Vein Rifts and the endlessly extending Extremity Vein being seen far in the distance.

Noah didn't pay attention to this as his eyes were on the Extremity Clone of the Adjudicator of Dissolution, their deal of him siphoning her aura of Extremity still standing, but he arrived while waving his hands to reveal 10 dazzling Blood Sources!
With a smile, he spoke out.
"I wonder what the Curagulus of Extremity would think about a treasure like this..."

Another pathway he had foreseen was with the Adjudicator of Dissolution and the Curagulus of Extremity she was connected to, this being a major network of powerhouses extending across multiple Clans and Inheritances as some of them were even secretly Members of the Senatus of Extremity!
An example was the Adjudicator of Dissolution...she was elected to be the Adjudicator of the Haven of Dissolution as of course, she was a Member of the Senatus of Extremity.
And yet she also had her secret identity as a member of the Curagulus of Extremity.

Her veiled face at the sight of the Blood Source was extremely stern, where even though she was veiled, Noah noticed a much more pronounced reaction from her compared to other Extremities that caused him to raise his brows.
But all this faded an instant later as she motioned and took one of the Blood Sources into her hands.
[...Where did you get this?]
Her gorgeous voice rang out with authority as Noah's eyes turned into devilish crescent smiles.
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, Noah stared at a Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity while waves of Quintessence and other Havenly Authorities coalesced around him.

He had moved away from the Apollyon Aletheian Haven as he now stood at the center of the newly built Havens of Dissolution, Helios, and Genesis that Noah didn't create in multiple separate layers- but he had instead begun the construction of these havens as if they were pieces of a large pie, with the Havenly Authorities of Dissolution, Helios, and Genesis meeting at the very center where an overabundance of Quintessence flourished.

The land itself shone with a stellar multicolored radiance as above Noah, obsidian, crimson gold, and white Cosmos of massive stature spun in the skies, with the earth filled with paradisiacal mountains and small floating islands gushing Dissolution, Helios, and Genesis freely.

In the center of such a landmass, Noah sat down on the stellar multicolored grassland as he motioned his hands towards the Sporos II of Extremity, a stream of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity and other types of Loot he had gained from the Havenly Moon Clan and Inheritances that his body were currently meeting...all this loot was flowing towards this dazzling set to aid in its maturity.

Many sources of Loot were established as Noah now enjoyed a steady stream, with the Loot entering his Vaults of Quintessence cycled to go into his Infinite Forge where they were multiplied by Ruination by a varying factor that so far ranged from 10x to 20x depending on the type of Loot!
This was how stupendous her capabilities to multiply loot had become as she sought to exceed her limitations as an Extremity Relic and become an Armament of Extremity.

After the loot was multiplied by Ruination, it was cycled back to his Vaults of Quintessence where Noah's will sorted through it to see whether some could be designated towards his people, or if all of it flowed towards the Sporos II of Extremity.

Then, apart from all this, there was the continued Refulgence of Loot that was coming from the raging storms of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities that the Avernus Extremities were still unable to solve!
Noah stared at the shocking piles of three mountainous waves of pulsating Hyperversal Extremity as their details rose before him.

[Shard of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity]:: Those who have not attained Extremity can never truly understand what Extremity is or what it entails. Through your authorities raging within the Aspects of Existence of an existence that has attained Extremity, you have discerned some of the truths and gained the Shard of Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity. 100 of such Shards will allow you to gain the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity that grants you the authority to observe and see the higher dimension of power known as Havenly Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures that are the backbone of the power of Existences that attained Extremity. The Extremity Rune Scriptures are only born when a concept reaches Extremity, and being capable of at least viewing this higher form of power may aid you in achieving Extremity yourself, or aid you in comprehending how to destroy Extremity Rune Scriptures of your enemies...
The first Loot to come from damaging Hyperversal Extremities was an astounding one!
100 Shards of such loot were required, and in his Vaults of Quintessence...
there lay 76 currently.
And the Avernus Extremities had yet to overcome his Hyperversal Anomalous Virion as steadily, more of such Loot continued to come!

In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, Noah stared at a Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity while waves of Quintessence and other Havenly Authorities coalesced around him.

He had moved away from the Apollyon Aletheian Haven as he now stood at the center of the newly built Havens of Dissolution, Helios, and Genesis that Noah didn't create in multiple separate layers- but he had instead begun the construction of these havens as if they were pieces of a large pie, with the Havenly Authorities of Dissolution, Helios, and Genesis meeting at the very center where an overabundance of Quintessence flourished.

The land itself shone with a stellar multicolored radiance as above Noah, obsidian, crimson gold, and white Cosmos of massive stature spun in the skies, with the earth filled with paradisiacal mountains and small floating islands gushing Dissolution, Helios, and Genesis freely.

In the center of such a landmass, Noah sat down on the stellar multicolored grassland as he motioned his hands towards the Sporos II of Extremity, a stream of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity and other types of Loot he had gained from the Havenly Moon Clan and Inheritances that his body were currently meeting...all this loot was flowing towards this dazzling set to aid in its maturity.

Many sources of Loot were established as Noah now enjoyed a steady stream, with the Loot entering his Vaults of Quintessence cycled to go into his Infinite Forge where they were multiplied by Ruination by a varying factor that so far ranged from 10x to 20x depending on the type of Loot!
This was how stupendous her capabilities to multiply loot had become as she sought to exceed her limitations as an Extremity Relic and become an Armament of Extremity.

After the loot was multiplied by Ruination, it was cycled back to his Vaults of Quintessence where Noah's will sorted through it to see whether some could be designated towards his people, or if all of it flowed towards the Sporos II of Extremity.

Then, apart from all this, there was the continued Refulgence of Loot that was coming from the raging storms of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities that the Avernus Extremities were still unable to solve!
Noah stared at the shocking piles of three mountainous waves of pulsating Hyperversal Extremity as their details rose before him.
[Shard of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity]:: Those who have not attained Extremity can never truly understand what Extremity is or what it entails.

Through your authorities raging within the Aspects of Existence of an existence that has attained Extremity, you have discerned some of the truths and gained the Shard of Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity.

100 of such Shards will allow you to gain the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity that grants you the authority to observe and see the higher dimension of power known as Havenly Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures that are the backbone of the power of Existences that attained Extremity.

The Extremity Rune Scriptures are only born when a concept reaches Extremity, and being capable of at least viewing this higher form of power may aid you in achieving Extremity yourself, or aid you in comprehending how to destroy Extremity Rune Scriptures of your enemies...
The first Loot to come from damaging Hyperversal Extremities was an astounding one!
100 Shards of such loot were required, and in his Vaults of Quintessence...
there lay 76 currently.
And the Avernus Extremities had yet to overcome his Hyperversal Anomalous Virion as steadily, more of such Loot continued to come!

chapters.title: Chapter 2673 A Refulgence of Loot! II
paragraphs: 2673 A Refulgence of Loot! II

The Shard of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity looked like a piece of an ancient pupil filled with a profound splendor- the 76 pieces Noah had collected acting like pieces of a puzzle that were gradually coming together to reveal a multicolored pupil with an astonishing runic character etched in unique strokes that translated to [EXTREMITY].
It was literally an Eye to allow one to gaze upon Extremity.
To see the Havenly Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures that made the core strength of Extremities!
And this was only one of the three types of Loot Noah had attained from the bodies of Hyperversal Extremities.
The other ones...were even more astonishing.

[Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation]:: The very structure of a Hyperversal Extremity is filled with grand Extremity Rune Scriptures, and your actions shook these very scriptures in a show of a grand achievement. The product of shaking the foundation of a Hyperversal Extremity made way for the Hyperversal Bones of Gradation- tools that once you absorb the authority of, your bones will begin a process of being forged to become Hyperversal Extremity Bones of Gradation. If your whole skeleton can be forged to become filled with Hyperversal Extremity Bones of Gradation, you're halfway towards Extremity as you will already have the skeletal structure to support it...

[Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities]:: The very structure of a Hyperversal Extremity is filled with grand Extremity Rune Scriptures, and your actions shook these very scriptures in a show of a grand achievement. The product of shaking the Soul of a Hyperversal Extremity made way for the Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities that once absorbed, your soul will be forged to become a Hyperversal Extremity Soul...
The former was a cluster of golden stellar bones releasing an air of ancientness and majesty, each of them seeming like Titanic skeletal realities that could not belong to a single being!

About 98 Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation came from Tier 1 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities, with 22 Obsidian bones on the side that stemmed from Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities that were affected by Noah's Virion- their effectiveness being that much greater in their description.

The latter was shaped like an ever spinning dew that radiated waves of pure Hyperversal Authority- their purpose being similar to what Noah's Sporos II of Extremity would achieve, but to a lesser extent as they would only grant him a Hyperversal Extremity Soul.
The Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity would grant Noah a Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul that was one of a kind!
So Noah wasn't at all prompted to use this loot as he asked the most important question.
"What do you think?"
His words were directed to a single entity as her light of grandeur flashed over the Loot from Hyperversal Extremities.
And her reply was a magisterial one.

[They carry a semblance of Extremity as since I haven't reached it myself, the effectiveness of multiplying them had been reduced greatly. I may be able to double or triple them at the very least, but an upside of this is that my own tier will continue to rise by processing loot like this and multiplying it- since it means things that carry a semblance of Extremity are being processed through me. Once I achieve the qualitative change to become an Armament of Extremity, I should be able to multiply loot like this by a factor of 10 or even 20.]
Her words were sweet ones that could act like a lullaby to Noah if ever he wanted to doze off.
Even though she hadn't achieved the stage of an Armament of Extremity, she could still multiply the times before him- albeit in a very limited fashion!
But this was more than enough for Noah as he spoke while Quintessence radiated from his body.
[Start with the Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity, and then proceed with the rest.]
HUUM!
As soon as he spoke, it was like an engine came to life.

The dazzling shards forming a pupil before him were sucked into his soul towards the Infinite Forge, Noah observed the crimson gold humanoid figure of RUINATION wave her hands calmly while her body radiated a profound power!
She looked like an artificer from eons ago as she worked her wonders, a Shard being taken between her palms as a blast of a Singularity bloomed from thereafter, and one became two.
These two were then out aside as another shard came between her palms, a singularity exploding forth as this time, three shards in total appeared!
An approximate product of 2 or 3 loot from a single one- loot that carried traces of Extremity at that!
It was why that in real time, Noah watched the 76 Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity he had attained begin to scale upwards as within a minute...
SHAA!
188 Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity appeared!

Noah waved his hand to collect 100 that came together to complete a dazzling pupil with a runic character of Extremity, the other 88 Shards being taken out of the forge and funneled towards the Sporos II of Extremity that after a steady stream of multiplied Loot Noah had already given...this seed had only moved from .0001 to .01 Maturity.
But when the first Shard of Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity was devoured by this endlessly hungering seed...
[Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity]:: .11% Maturity...
It moved from .01 to .11!
Noah smiled at such a scene as he affirmed the crucial reality of Loot.
"Destroying Extremities is the most profitable..."
His eyes pulsed with a light of tyrannical greed as the other 87 Shards flowed into the Sporos II of Extremity, the maturity rising all the way to 8.81% in a single swoop.
Nearly a tenth of the way there for a completely cultivated seed that would birth an Ash Tree of Gradation to grant Noah yet another completed Aletheian Haven and a baptism of his Soul!

chapters.title: Chapter 2674 A Refulgence of Loot! III
paragraphs: 2674 A Refulgence of Loot! III

After the seed swallowed up the Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity, Noah observed RUINATION begin to multiply the Obsidian and Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation along with the Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities as while this process was underway, he took the completed wonder of 100 Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity into his Aspects of Existence.

An incandescent beam of light was what manifested first from his eyes- his nine pupils that rotated like ancient engines all blaring out with maddening grandeur as the pupils of the character of [EXTREMITY] was merged into them.
Nothing was taken away as they only added on to the majesty swirling within Noah's eyes, with his soul feeling like a branding was being burnt into his very pupils as the pain was immeasurable!
And yet Noah only observed closely as gradually, what he was actively seeing changed.
[You have obtained the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity!]
His Nine-Pupiled Eyes shone with an iridescent light as in their very center, the character of EXTREMITY was carved in with valor and glory!
He gained a sight that would allow him to see things he hadn't been able to see before.
When he gazed at an Extremity now...just what wondrous sight would he see?

The authority within his eyes was branded onto his soul and carried over across his bodies, his Existence being capable of ascertaining a glimpse of what Extremity truly was as he was able to quickly focus his gaze on such beings right away!
Above the Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago.

Noah's figure had rebuffed the Avernus Extremities as he was floating amidst dazzling Halos of Havenly Treasures, over 100,000 Units of Havenly Aurora pocketed by him from forcing Extremity Blue to retreat along with other Avernus Extremities.

He glanced at the expansive light of Halos all around him as Loot capable of aiding one across the Boundary Layers, Extremity Relics, Fragments of Armaments of Extremity, and many more wonders lay before him, but before he could grab any of them...
[Let's talk.]
The grandiose voice of none other than a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity rang out behind him.
The Havenly Master of this Archipelago.
A Havenly Titanosaurus!
When turned around and laid his eyes on this being...he had to squint and almost turn away at the shocking brightness he emanated.

His whole existence seemed like a swirling storm of utmost majesty and power as this grandness didn't just remain in his body, with Noah observing the Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures for the first time as the being before him held so much that they spilled out from his body and affected the nearby space around him!
As Noah laid his eyes truly on Extremity for the first time, a significant event was taking place innumerable light years away- towards the very center of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
The speed of some Existences was vastly different compared to others.
The speed of a unique Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity...was utterly monstrous as one such being was among the first to gain entry into the Supernal Havens of Extremity!

Emperor Shao had crossed the Supernal Haven of Dissolution as if he had an intent and direction of exactly where he wanted to go, crossing over countless light years and passing across many Golden and Obsidian Havenly Archipelagos.
He crossed regions where the Hyperversal Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineages were common, until he entered regions governed by the Hyperversal Havenly Plantae and Riboviria.
Ultimately, he reached a titanic Crimson Haven Archipelago that was filled with terrifying auras across it, its size alone being something akin to hundreds of thousands of minor Havens.
Such a landmass was one that held representatives of all the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages, and the Main Branch of the Havenly Vaults of Extremity in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!
Complex and innovative structures, vessels, and wonders floated across it as 20% of it was filled with archaic vegetation and forests that vibrated with life.
Emperor Shao arrived at such a location as he gazed at the beginnings of the floating landmass with utmost coldness.
He didn't enter, instead pulling out a golden paper talisman that began to burn with a brilliant white flame in his hands.
Halfway through this burning talisman, the space in front of Emperor Shao fluctuated as a terrifying aura warped in!

It had to at the very minimum be a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity as a burning golden misty light covered everything about them, their face barely becoming visible to show halcyon colored skin and white-gold strands of hair flowing gorgeously past her shoulders.
Golden colored skin!

She had glazed eyes that contained an uncountable number of Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, their gaze piercing as if they could see through the vast majority of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Her body radiated the Havenly Authority of the Hyperversal Havenly Celestia Extremity Lineage as around her skin, streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority freely flowed.
This was an Existence that had at the very least undergone their Second Vitalis Awakening!
A crescent smile covered her lips as her eyes could be the downfall of entire Havens, her words profoundly resonant as she spoke while gazing at Emperor Shao.
[The Son of Celestia cast from Haven and into hell is finally able to return...it is good to see you again, Shao.]
Her eyes held a myriad of complex emotions at the coldness that this man before her displayed, but Emperor Shao kept his gaze as he nodded and freely spoke to this Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!
[I'm assuming what is mine has been prepared and is ready for me?]
His words were calm, his tone as if he were talking to someone of his own level or even slightly below him!
And yet the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity Celestia only smiled and nodded at his words as a blinding light rose from her to wrap around the both of them.
[Everything that was promised on the Oath. Come...]
With a glimmer of light, the two Existences disappeared into the grandiose Archipelago behind them.
An Archipelago that had many auras of Existences at Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity, not to mention the unknown number of Existences radiating the grandeur of Tier 4!

chapters.title: Chapter 2675 An Endless War! I
paragraphs: 2675 An Endless War! I
Inside the Crimson Havenly Archipelago that Emperor Shao had just disappeared into.
Within its depths, layers of pockets of planes of existence were stretched across the massive structures and complex architecture.

Across the many planes of this Archipelago, there was a small one that was constructed entirely of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, the space within it simmering with a pristine transparent white light as it seemed spotless and utterly empty of any filth!

In such a domain, a simple hut radiating age and vicissitude floated, the figure of a middle aged man with iridescent golden skin and white gold hair sitting outside of this hut as when he breathed in, Vitalis flowed into his nose.
When he breathed out, even more waves of Vitalis flowed out as the surroundings became that much richer!
He adorned a simple white robe that pulsed with the silent light of an Armament of Extremity
His body itself didn't emanate any waves of power as one couldn't be sure if he was at Tier 1 of Extremity, Tier 4...or even possibly beyond it.
He seemed to stare out into nothingness, and yet he could see things that other Extremities could not even imagine with his gaze alone!

At this moment, the calm area around him was interrupted as another figure warped in, bowing respectfully with her curvaceous figure as her golden skin smoothly absorbed the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority in the surroundings.
[Shao has returned, Master.]
Her coming to inform him of this was only protocol as this being had long since foreseen this many years ago when he was perusing Unrecorded Histories!
Seeing his calm response, the woman bowing towards him and emanating profound waves of power at the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity level had a difficult expression arise.
She sighed in her heart, but as if this being before her could read her soul, his words rang out.

[You question why I rebuked him so harshly and sent him to the Nether Havens of Extremity all those years ago. It had to happen this way. What we need are not coddled children, but Champions. Now that he has returned, he won't lose out much from not being here all these years as an inheritance worth billions of Units of Havenly Aurora is being accepted by him. What remains to be seen is what his years worth of work will amount to once his potential explodes all at once...]
His voice was serene and filled with ancientness.
Vitalis Hyperversal Authority seemed to become more active at his words as the woman bowing towards him became all that more respectful!
Outside the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Atop a Bastion of Vitalis, a white robed Emperor Shao was in a seated position while stroking his sword.

Around him, the scene was constantly changing as waves of Extremities proficient in Vacuous Hyperversal Authority were being deployed, while those who hand grasped this authority yet stayed within the bounds of Vitalis as reinforcements and support.

All of them stared gravely at the massive and numerous Hyperversal Savior's Arks that were made of 9 spinning wheels of exterminating light, a dense number of Extremities protecting the depths of this Ark as around it- a terrific domain was released that pushed away Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
In the field of this domain, tens of millions of Apex Vacuous Lifeforms brimmed with power, while within the Savior's Arks themselves, 100 Hyperversal Extremities remained with grandeur!
They had gotten ever closer as it seemed a flash was imminent, these massive vessels already entering the gray field where Vitalis and Vacuous constantly repulsed each other.

The visage of Emperor Shao gazed at all this as he spoke towards the blazing aura at the center of this particular Bastion of Vitalis- the aura of the Esteemed Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity overseeing this defensive like!
[Since the day I was born, I was told that Vacuous Malignancies were our greatest enemies that were seeking our very Annihilation. Even then, we were at war.]
As he spoke, his seated figure began to rise.
His simple rising motion caused the surrounding reality to begin trembling, the nearby Extremities beginning to feel a heavy pressure rousing from him as he became alarmed!
The Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity his words were directed to radiated light as he entirely focused on Emperor Shao who continued at this moment.
[Before I was born, Vacuous Malignancies were still our enemies as a war was being fought even then. Cornelius...do you remember when we weren't at war?]
WAA!
His word caused the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity to pulse with a grandiose light as he didn't reply!
This was because before he was even born, there was a war. And after he came to be, he simply became another being to fight in this war!

At this point, Emperor Shao had entirely stood up as the pressure he radiated caused the surroundings to shake even more, the nearby Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities feeling a stifling pressure as they moved away in shock.
He grasped the sword he had been stroking this whole time as from his hands, transparent white streams of light began to gather and flow into the sword.
[This...!]
Seeing this scene, Esteemed Cornelius was shocked as the words of Shao continued!

[It seems that we have always been at war, and we will continue to be at war. Even me...I do not think I will be significant enough to stop this war. I do not know what or who needs to rise...in order to finally put this war to rest.]
HOOONG!
His body exploded with horrific and fantastical power.

The streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority around him became denser and denser as they transformed into a raging river of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that wrapped around the sword and roared out with maddening grandeur!

His caramel-colored skin began to be tinted with a golden hue as his dark hair gained traces of white gold, a glorious Havenly Authority erupting around him as every single action he took caused great alarm and shock to rise.
What was this?
Was this the same being who had not even undergone his First Vitalis Awakening minutes ago?
Why was he now controlling Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, and in such an obscene fashion at that?!

sentences.text: 2675 An Endless War!
I
Inside the Crimson Havenly Archipelago that Emperor Shao had just disappeared into.
Within its depths, layers of pockets of planes of existence were stretched across the massive structures and complex architecture.

Across the many planes of this Archipelago, there was a small one that was constructed entirely of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, the space within it simmering with a pristine transparent white light as it seemed spotless and utterly empty of any filth!

In such a domain, a simple hut radiating age and vicissitude floated, the figure of a middle aged man with iridescent golden skin and white gold hair sitting outside of this hut as when he breathed in, Vitalis flowed into his nose.
When he breathed out, even more waves of Vitalis flowed out as the surroundings became that much richer!
He adorned a simple white robe that pulsed with the silent light of an Armament of Extremity
His body itself didn't emanate any waves of power as one couldn't be sure if he was at Tier 1 of Extremity, Tier 4...or even possibly beyond it.
He seemed to stare out into nothingness, and yet he could see things that other Extremities could not even imagine with his gaze alone!

At this moment, the calm area around him was interrupted as another figure warped in, bowing respectfully with her curvaceous figure as her golden skin smoothly absorbed the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority in the surroundings.
[Shao has returned, Master.]
Her coming to inform him of this was only protocol as this being had long since foreseen this many years ago when he was perusing Unrecorded Histories!
Seeing his calm response, the woman bowing towards him and emanating profound waves of power at the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity level had a difficult expression arise.
She sighed in her heart, but as if this being before her could read her soul, his words rang out.
[You question why I rebuked him so harshly and sent him to the Nether Havens of Extremity all those years ago.
It had to happen this way.
What we need are not coddled children, but Champions.
Now that he has returned, he won't lose out much from not being here all these years as an inheritance worth billions of Units of Havenly Aurora is being accepted by him.
What remains to be seen is what his years worth of work will amount to once his potential explodes all at once...]
His voice was serene and filled with ancientness.
Vitalis Hyperversal Authority seemed to become more active at his words as the woman bowing towards him became all that more respectful!
Outside the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Atop a Bastion of Vitalis, a white robed Emperor Shao was in a seated position while stroking his sword.

Around him, the scene was constantly changing as waves of Extremities proficient in Vacuous Hyperversal Authority were being deployed, while those who hand grasped this authority yet stayed within the bounds of Vitalis as reinforcements and support.

All of them stared gravely at the massive and numerous Hyperversal Savior's Arks that were made of 9 spinning wheels of exterminating light, a dense number of Extremities protecting the depths of this Ark as around it- a terrific domain was released that pushed away Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
In the field of this domain, tens of millions of Apex Vacuous Lifeforms brimmed with power, while within the Savior's Arks themselves, 100 Hyperversal Extremities remained with grandeur!
They had gotten ever closer as it seemed a flash was imminent, these massive vessels already entering the gray field where Vitalis and Vacuous constantly repulsed each other.

The visage of Emperor Shao gazed at all this as he spoke towards the blazing aura at the center of this particular Bastion of Vitalis- the aura of the Esteemed Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity overseeing this defensive like!
[Since the day I was born, I was told that Vacuous Malignancies were our greatest enemies that were seeking our very Annihilation.
Even then, we were at war.]
As he spoke, his seated figure began to rise.
His simple rising motion caused the surrounding reality to begin trembling, the nearby Extremities beginning to feel a heavy pressure rousing from him as he became alarmed!
The Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity his words were directed to radiated light as he entirely focused on Emperor Shao who continued at this moment.
[Before I was born, Vacuous Malignancies were still our enemies as a war was being fought even then.
Cornelius...do you remember when we weren't at war?]
WAA!
His word caused the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity to pulse with a grandiose light as he didn't reply!
This was because before he was even born, there was a war.
And after he came to be, he simply became another being to fight in this war!

At this point, Emperor Shao had entirely stood up as the pressure he radiated caused the surroundings to shake even more, the nearby Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities feeling a stifling pressure as they moved away in shock.
He grasped the sword he had been stroking this whole time as from his hands, transparent white streams of light began to gather and flow into the sword.
[This...!]
Seeing this scene, Esteemed Cornelius was shocked as the words of Shao continued!
[It seems that we have always been at war, and we will continue to be at war.
Even me...I do not think I will be significant enough to stop this war.
I do not know what or who needs to rise...in order to finally put this war to rest.]
HOOONG!
His body exploded with horrific and fantastical power.

The streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority around him became denser and denser as they transformed into a raging river of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that wrapped around the sword and roared out with maddening grandeur!

His caramel-colored skin began to be tinted with a golden hue as his dark hair gained traces of white gold, a glorious Havenly Authority erupting around him as every single action he took caused great alarm and shock to rise.
What was this?
Was this the same being who had not even undergone his First Vitalis Awakening minutes ago?
Why was he now controlling Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, and in such an obscene fashion at that?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2676 An Endless War! II
paragraphs: 2676 An Endless War! II

The pressure alone that Emperor Shao released caused other Hyperversal Extremities to scramble away from him in shock, not able to bear the sheer pressure he emanated as his whole body seemingly became a sharp sword of Vitalis!
The pressure was so maddening as it continued to build up that in no time...
this expansion Bastion of Vitalis they stood on no longer had a single blaring aura that stood excellently at Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
An unknown and spectacular change was occurring within Emperor Shao in real time as the pressure he released rose from the Zenith of Tier 3 to Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!
His body resonated with the sword in his right hand.
A resplendent glow of transparent white light engulfed him and everything nearby as the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that was always immovable was freely wrapped around his sword!
KAAA!
A fearsome cry thundered out from the sword that now revealed itself to be an Armament of Extremity, and Emperor Shao spoke out calmly as he swung the sword down.
[On this day, I shall join the ranks of innumerable fodder that have been ground down by this endless war..hoping that before every part of me is gone, I may be able to see an end.]
With a light wave of his sword, brilliance unfolded.
The Extremities nearby felt their souls shudder as if their records were being erased from existence just by being near this sword strike!
A Sword of Vitalis!
Many of them couldn't break out of this illusion instantly as only after some time passed did they come back to attention- just in time to capture the shocking effects of Emperor Shao's simple swing.
Across the gray region where Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities clashed, a dazzling sword light of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority struck out as it stretched out for light years!

It was so quick that it traversed the gray region and instantly entered the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, cutting apart the obsidian authority as if it were tearing through musculature as in a matter of moments- the sword light arrived before a Hyperversal Savior's Ark.

And with a flash of brilliance, the tens of millions of Apex Vacuous Lifeforms in front of the domain released by the Ark were illuminated by the sword light as countless sword marks instantly bloomed over their bodies, and an instant later...they flickered to ash as every record about them was eradicated.
The sword light then struck on the rings of the Savior's Ark as only now did the reactions of the 100 Extremities protecting it bloom!
And the result, was utter terror as if these Extremities were akin to meat on a chopping block, the sword light swung forth!
[Ah!]

Aspects of Existence and Records alike were filled with innumerable sword wounds dripping with Vitalis as a dozen of the forefront Extremities had their bodies turn into flickers of sword dust in an instant.

The Sword of Vitalis smashed into the Hyperversal Savior's Ark in a shocking fashion as a jagger wound instantly formed, the sword light seeming unstoppable as it was bound to cut right through this Ark within the next moments!
But this was when a sea of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority descended from the depths of the endless legions of Vacuous Malignancies.

It radiated the grandeur of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity as this Sea intently surged to block the Sword of Vitalis, the visage of a gorgeous dark-haired woman appearing in front of it as her hand gushed out Abyssal waves of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
BZZT!

And yet the Sword of Vitalis still buzzed and cracked as her gaze changed, the nothingness to her left side warping as yet another figure appeared- a man radiating the same power as her at Tier 4 as his hand swung down, manifesting a massive illusory obsidian hand from above that grabbed on to the Sword of Vitalis!

The flicker of sword lights roared out with glory and wonder as only after the massive illusory hand and sea of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority from two Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities wrapped around it...did it weaken its brilliance before moments after, it was swallowed up into nothingness.
The battlefield was silent.

The dark haired Vacuous Malignancy had a somber gaze as she stared at the Hyperversal Savior's Ark they had stopped the destruction of- half of it being cleaved as Vacuous Hyperversal Authority was flowing into it en masse to heal its structures.

Her gaze and the gazes of many then turned to the innumerable Bastions of Extremity in the distance, focusing on the Bastion that had the visage of a single man with a white haired robe and a sword in his hands.
Emperor Shao!

His single Sword strike had ushered forth a shocking start to this battle as two Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities had to come together to stop it, such a start rousing the wrath of all Vacuous Malignancies as beginning with the dark haired woman...
[OOOOH!]

She released a horrific bellow as her jaws opened wider and wider, millions of tentacles sprouting from them as her whole body soon enlarged into a massive monstrosity, a sea of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority following her as she thundered forth towards the gray region!
Behind her, swathes of Legions of Vacuous Malignancies followed as the Hyperversal Savior's Ark carried their forces forward!
And in the midst of this unfolding battle...there was a man who gazed at everything with Quintessence and tyranny.

Mixed in an Ark that was only 1 away from the target Emperor Shao, Noah marveled at the transparent white sword light that nearly tore apart a Hyperversal Savior's Ark had it not been for the interference of two Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities!
The source of the sword light could be seen clearly even from this distance as he...was shining so brightly.
Noah's Eyes of Extremity were now able to see so much more as from what wasn't veiled to him and others, he was able to see what the Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures really were.
Each one had its own unique identity as a single Extremity Rune Scripture had its glorious strokes representing a concept that had achieved Extremity!
The Extremity Rune Scripture Noah could see the most of around Emperor Shao...was a crimson colored scripture reading [SWORD].

And such a scripture wasn't alone as innumerable clusters of Scriptures of the [SWORD] seemed to fill all of Emperor Shao's existence- with Noah only being able to discern those outside of him as he actively used them!
But it seemed that within his body, Extremity Rune Scriptures of the [SWORD] and an unknown number of other concepts that had achieved Extremity were what made up his entire existence.
His existence and the existence of all Extremities...were supported by the very concepts they took to Extremity in the form of Extremity Rune Scriptures!
Even though he found it hard not to, Noah pulled his eyes away from this being as he glanced at the other Extremities.

The female Vacuous Hyperversal Extremity who had erupted with endless tentacles from her mouth was now a circular monstrosity with tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority all around it, seeming like a cosmic devourer as around her figure, Noah saw crimson colored Extremity Rune Scriptures that read [VACUOUS] in abundance, as well as obsidian Extremity Rune Scriptures that read [ANNIHILATION], [VOID], [TITAN], and more.
He turned his head to all the myriad of Extremities around him as he gradually peeled back the secrecy of Extremity.
The Vacuous Malignancies.
The Vitalis Malignancies.
He saw different things between all of these beings.
He saw crimson, obsidian, and on the bodies of Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities...he saw Golden Extremity Rune Scriptures.
Every single Scripture represented a concept at Extremity...and yet some of these concepts were colored gold, obsidian, and the most pristine ones were crimson!

chapters.title: Chapter 2677 An Endless War! III
paragraphs: 2677 An Endless War! III

The grandeur of Golden, Obsidian, and Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures was astounding to gaze upon, and simply being able to view it gave one a glimpse of just how powerful the Extremity was.
Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities held dim Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, and there weren't all that many in abundance around their bodies.

Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities were the beings Noah began seeing Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures around, the glow of their dim Golden Scriptures being slightly brighter as their obsidian ones overshadowed everything they held.
Then there were the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity who shone with a crimson glow around some of their Scriptures.
Then, there were beings like the one who had struck out with his sword.
Vitalis Hyperversal Authority coiled around him like a snake as the potency and sheer number of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures were blinding to look at.

And as Noah and the others watched the forces of the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions thunder forward while the Bastions of Vitalis sent out their own forces, the more prominent forces on both sides noticed how the aura of the being who had thrown out the first strike continued to rise!

He was watching and observing this being with scrutiny as his records were barely visible even to him now, the Annals of Extremity seemingly resounding and booming his name across them at this moment!
[Shao...! Shao...! Shao...!]
It was a surreal scene even for Noah as he had done astounding feats and gotten awarded with waves of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that led to his First Awakenings.
But what he was seeing now was utterly ridiculous as the very Aeonic Annals of Extremity recording the currently playing realityseemed to be chanting this being's name!
Emperor Shao!
His aura and majesty reached a precipice at such a juncture as Noah watched his Scriptures radiate a blinding light, and an instant thereafter...
WAA!
His radiance instantly vanished.
No more Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures could be seen from him.
When Noah gazed at his again, the Scriptures pulsing and swirling around him had seemingly all disappeared as under the eyes of all, so did his aura!
He no longer gave off the pressure and majesty of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.

And yet his mere existence to the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions seemed to become that much more immense, multiple Tier 4 Hyperversal Vacuous Extremities gathering in front of the Hyperversal Savior's Ark coming directly before the path of Emperor Shao as if they had met one of the more terrifying combatants on this battlefield!

Noah observed this scene closely as it seemed after reaching a certain level, the auras existences radiated outwards could be forcefully reigned in as one wouldn't be able to tell of their shocking level of power.
This was something that would bode well for him who was an Inscrutable Existence who also held the capabilities of Obfuscation!
Nobody could see through him as when it came to keeping his mystery as the 9th Infernal Lord of the Infernal Havenly Commerce, no immediate problems should arise.
These were his thoughts, but he still couldn't fully turn his will away from the terrifying being that even the Aeonic Annals of Extremity were resonating accolades of!
And with such an entrance and start to the battle, the forces of both sides finally came close enough within the gray region as they were about to clash.
At such a juncture, Noah focused and breathed out as his body mixed in with the tens of millions of Apex Vacuous Lifeforms was pulled along the path of the Savior's Ark he was in.
Others made their grand entrances into this battle as he...would make a silent one!
He wouldn't be showy.
At least, not now.
His body brimmed with a unique power as he felt the soul that had gotten baptized with the Ash Tree of Gradation once.

His thought process and everything else regarding the control of his authorities and essence reached an immaculate level as at this moment, streams of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority rose out of his body and silently joined the waves of nothingness all around him.
And yet within these streams of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, there were thousands of Hyperversal Anomalous Virions that Noah had already altered to fit this battle!

Beforehand, the Virions had Vacuous Hyperversal Authority hidden within, and they had a layer of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority outside that made the Extremities within the Seven Havens feel an Innate need to take it in.

Now, Noah had flipped this around and placed Vitalis in and utilized Vacuous as the cover, his Soul having been rapidly producing these Virions in this unique absence of time and space as tens of thousands of Virions were being produced every moment!

And now, they needed into the waves of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority in the surroundings as Noah directed his poisonous will towards a Hyperversal Savior's Ark to the right of the massive one he was in.
100 Million Apex Vacuous Lifeforms and 100 Extremities were within this Savior's Ark.

Every so silently and without notice, the streams of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority all around them became permeated with tens of thousands of Virions that were quickly blooming up towards Hundreds of Thousands, Noah's soul moving like a vast and endless engine as he mass produced Virions carrying Lotra and Quintessence among other authorities, his altered Blood Source bringing it all together as he prepared for a massive incursion!
It was all for the sake of Loot that would make his pathway of achieving Extremity within 7 days possible.
A pathway of loot was opened through his Infernal Havenly Commerce.
Another one through the Avernus Extremities affected by the Hyperversal Anomalous Virions.
His Infinite Forge continued to release waves of Loot Light as within it, RUINATION multiplied all received loot to even more alarming levels.
Now...Noah would create another pathway of loot through the war occurring against legions of Vacuous Malignancies!
He chose a side as his blade did not point towards the Vitals Malignancies!

Another one through the Avernus Extremities affected by the Hyperversal Anomalous Virions.
His Infinite Forge continued to release waves of Loot Light as within it, RUINATION multiplied all received loot to even more alarming levels.
Now...Noah would create another pathway of loot through the war occurring against legions of Vacuous Malignancies!
He chose a side as his blade did not point towards the Vitals Malignancies!

chapters.title: Chapter 2678 An Endless War! IV
paragraphs: 2678 An Endless War! IV
He carried both the Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians and Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians as to others, he could be considered an abomination of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities.
But many of his interests lay in the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains currently.
In the Seven Aeonic Havens where he had just begun devouring the Planes of Existence into his Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
He had not yet arrived into the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains nor had he devoured any of their lands.
At this moment, the ties with Vitalis were much, much stronger as his Quintessential blade pointed itself towards Vacuous Lifeforms.

His Virions silently permeated across the waves of nothingness and began entering the bodies of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, and the even more specifically targeted 100 Extremities protecting the Hyperversal Savior's Ark.
Silent and deadly.
These were his current means as by the time that the two sides clashed, his Virions were spread across 50% of the existences within the single Savior's Ark!
[Your soul is mass producing the altered Hyperversal Anomalous Virions at a Quintessential pace.]
[Your proficiency in the production of Hyperversal Anomalous Virions is quintessentially rising!]
Majesty begets even more majesty.
Power allows one to attain even more power!
Millions of Virions were mass produced by Noah as within moments, 100 Million Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and 100 Extremities ranging from Tier 1 to Tier 3 were infected!

In between the Domain Fields of the Savior's Arks, the brilliant auras of Vacuous Malignancies at Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity could be felt, with Noah's senses sending him warnings that similar to Seer Amestris, they would be unsuccessful- and there was an even greater chance of his methodologies being discovered early.
There was no doubt it would be discovered.
It was a matter of when a connection would be made as until then...
'Let the play unfold...'
His thoughts vibrated with tyranny as he closed his eyes.
He felt the streams of tens of millions of Hyperversal Anomalous Virions he had released and infected Vacuous Lifeforms as he breathed in Quintessence.
And a moment later...he triggered all of them!
BOOM!

It coincided with the many clashes that were beginning across stretches of light years as the Savior's Ark to Noah's right had just had its Apex Vacuous Lifeforms and Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities release waves of output of their power to flash against the Vitalis Lifeforms.
And at such a juncture, a horrid reality unfolded for the tens of millions of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.

The extremely pathogenic Hyperversal Anomalous Virion was activated as the spark of Vitalis and Vacuous instantly mixed, only to be wildly spread by the altered Blood Source across their records along with Lotra and Quintessence as with their level of power...
It was utter devastation.
Without Hyperversal Extremity Authority protecting one's Records and existence- without being surrounded by Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures...Noah's pathogenic tool was cataclysmic!

This was because the reality playing out thereafter showed the bodies of all 100 Million Apex Vacuous Lifeforms affected within the Savior's Ark...balloon outwards in an explosive force of shock and horror as a storming clash of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities tore apart their unprotected aspects of Existence and eradicated everything.

The scene of 100 Million Lifeforms imploding thereafter unfolded as their bodies- whether small or massive, became utterly shredded apart before being swallowed by the erupting storm and turned to ashes.
A single Hyperversal Savior's Ark became eerily quiet and empty in an instant.
Noah's vision flashed with seizure inducing lights as tens of millions of Prompts flashed, his Vaults of Quintessence crackling as seas of Loot instantly began to manifest and rain down from above!
He kept his eyes closed.
This was 100 Million lives he had reaped in an instant.
The sheer brevity and weight of such an action were not taken lightly by Noah.
After a moment, his eyes opened.

They opened to see the utter shock of the surrounding Vacuous Hyperversal Legions as before those nearby could even register the silent eradication of a force of 100 Million without being able to pinpoint the enemy, the 100 Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities within this Savior's Ark also had their gazes change as various parts of their bodies stretched from heavy storms erupting inside of them.
Storms of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as for Vacuous Lifeforms...such a storm seemed to be much deadlier.

The mere inclusion of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within their bodies caused such an astounding rejection within their existence as unlike the Avernus Extremities Noah had affected before, he saw the Vacuous Extremities uncontrollably have their limbs explode out to release the raging storms as it seemed they would have a much harder time containing it!

100 Vacuous Extremities within this Ark instantly roared out as they battled a shocking battle within, and this was when Noah's eyes turned towards the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity whose body was fused with the Hyperversal Savior's Ark.
The one who provided it power.
He calmly gazed and activated the Virion within this entity as an instant later...
BZZT!

The nine spinning wheels of this Savior's Ark buzzed as with the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity at the center, a heavy explosive force erupted out and spread as cracks began to form on this glorious construct!
It was unknown just what grand of a design had to be made for them to be forged.
Tools that allowed Vacuous Lifeforms to repulse and be capable of fighting against Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
As such an authority attacked from within, there was heavy friction and impacts as the nine wheels of the Ark vibrated and roared out.
The Extremities within it were in shambles while the Ark itself Was buzzing with cracks!
It was such a sudden phenomenon that only now did a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity arrive as his authority gushed down like waves to envelop everything.

His figure was a Titanic humanoid with six arms and three heads as devilish horns rose on each one. Each of their faces were currently somber as so far, the battle had not begun well for the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions!
First, there was a sword strike that nearly cleaved a Hyperversal Savior's Ark.
Now, a silent attack that seemed to be even more deadly had all Apex Vacuous Lifeforms erased while their Extremities were fighting for their very existence- the Ark itself buzzing with cracks!

Two terrifying enemies had made their own moves, with the most recent one being extremely sinister in their methods as while watching the bursting storms of Vitalis within the bodies of 100 Extremities, the Tier 4 Vacuous Hyperversal Extremity wondered...which existence of the same level as him did this that he had to counter and prevent any more deadly attacks like these?!
