chapters.title: Chapter 2679 The First Extremity Falls to Quintessence! I
paragraphs: 2679 The First Extremity Falls to Quintessence! I

Whatever distinction that was required to attain Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity granted a tremendous level of power as the moment such an entity became involved, the buzzing Ark stopped fracturing and slowly stabilized itself as Noah felt Oraculum buzz with warnings.
He had to move with care.

He observed the shocking happenings as the entity with six arms and three heads who had appeared had a gaze of seriousness and anger, his authority moving to wrap around all affected Extremities as he couldn't help but change his gazes when he sensed the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that had somehow managed to enter the bodies of the Vacuous Extremities.
At the same time, his terrifying will spread out and covered a dozen nearby Arks as he came to observe every minute thing happening.
Every movement of authority.
Every tendrils of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!

Feeling the intense will pressing down all around, Noah stopped at one affected Ark for now as he knew any more than this in rapid progression while under watch, and he would run a chance of exposing himself or deal a level of damage that would warrant even more terrifying Vacuous Lifeforms to seek the source of such wanton destruction with scrutiny.
It would draw gazes towards him that he could not handle currently!

There were beings in the far back of the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions who felt like pillars holding up nothingness as none of them had made a move, only Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities like the entity with six arms and three heads beginning to flow above or in front of the Hyperversal Savior's Ark.
So, slow and steady.

No drawing unwarranted attention as after nearly decimating an entire Hyperversal Savior's Ark and getting a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity to tightly observe everything while sending seas of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority into the bodies of the 100 affected Extremities, Noah slowly began sending his Hyperversal Anomalous Virions to target widespread Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities in other Arks.
The very flow of Authority was being tracked as he let his streams of Vacuous Authority follow the flow of nothingness all around and simply spread out for now.
He wasn't worried about slowing down and going steady to maximize the potential returns.
This was because a terrifying quantity of Loot was flowing in even now!
This was because he could see a possible Unrecorded History of epic proportions about to unfold in this reality before him.
A future where instead of just heavily injuring a Hyperversal Extremity constantly with his Hyperversal Anomalous Virion...one may just fall entirely due to it.

Before he attained Extremity...he may just be capable of crossing the vast and impossible wall of demarcation through his unique means and actually kill a Hyperversal Extremity in these chaotic times of war!
Now, what would come from entirely eradicating the Recorded History of a Hyperversal Extremity and not merely just injuring them?
It was a question without an answer, but Noah was intent on finding out!
[66x Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity have been attained!]
[45x Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
[20x Obsidian Hyperversal Bones of Gradation have been attained!]
[77x Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities have been attained!]
[13x Shards...]
Prompts and prompts of loot cascaded as Noah's main body only glanced at them while the Loot was multiplied by RUINATION before being funneled to the Sporos II of Extremity.

He wouldn't normally get redundant loot like the Shards of the Hyperversal Havenly Eye of Extremity after he already attained enough to obtain the Eye of Extremity, but since their purpose was to be devoured by the multicolored seed radiating an intense light before him, they still came!

And after funneling the Shards of the Eye of Extremity, Bones of Gradation, and Marrow Soul Singularities from the Avernus Extremities in addition to the multiplied Loot from 100 Million Apex Vacuous Lifeforms that he had just eradicated...
It caused a wonderful scene to unfold.
[Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity]:: 99.8% Maturity...
The second seed was near maturity!

It was all due to Noah's terrifying Accumulation as in addition to all of this, the scene above him in this region that pulsed with the Havenly Authorities of different Havens and Quintessence was a frightful one.

Above him, one could see a funnel of extremely pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority spinning and flowing into his Aspects of Existence as his work with the Infernal Havenly Commerce continued to produce astounding results- more and more Tier 1 to Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities joining the ranks of his Lineage from the Blood Sources he was selling!
It was such an alarming amount that...
[The potency of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority in your existence is reaching a critical threshold.]
[You are approaching your Second Vitalis Awakening!]
[The Vacuous Hyperversal Authority within your existence is spurred as your body absorbs and refines more of it!]
He was making progress on all sides.
And yet he didn't allow himself to enter a state of pride for his current accomplishments as there was still much more to be done!
In a moment, after the recently obtained loot was processed by RUINATION and fed into the Sporos II of Extremity...
[The Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos II of Extremity has reached complete maturity!]
Refulgent multicolored light erupted all around as when Noah breathed in the sheer light and aura of the dazzling seed in front of him, his whole existence brimmed with life and power.
His will surged into it as he initiated the next profound step, choosing the direction of what this seed would bloom into!
[The Quintessential Hyperversal Ash Tree II of Gradation has begun to bloom.]
[The chosen Havenly Authority is Oceanus.]
The dazzling seed became anchored in space before it began to sprout with a dazzling and gorgeous cerulean light.

Noah's Origin pulsed with joy and almost a trace of reverence that was quickly controlled as Five Aletheian Havens were completed with the Sixth Aletheian Haven started, all the lands and cosmos of this Haven simmering with the golden light of Helios.

Now...a blooming Ash Tree II of Gradation that would be enough to complete the entire Sixth Aletheian Haven had arrived- its sheer magnitude being so grand that out of the vastness of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the sprouting of a cerulean illusory tree took center stage!
